article_content: Navigating the business world as a developer pitching ideas to partners can feel like a rollercoaster. Some days, you're on top of the world, crushing goals. Other times, market obstacles can make you want to quit. Here are insights from 20 Forbes Business Development Council members, offering tips to help leaders and teams stay focused during economic challenges. 1. Stay Driven: In both good and bad times, keep pushing forward. Don't dwell on setbacks. Maintain your drive, and you'll see results. Be patient as contacts shift roles or face internal hurdles. Be aware of what others are experiencing too. - Jack Wagner, Hawk Ventures 2. Seek Mentorship: Find an experienced mentor who can offer advice during ups and downs. They've likely seen similar situations and can motivate you. A good mentor also holds you accountable. - Hayden Stafford, Seismic 3. Build Resilience: Don't abandon goals during tough times. Setbacks are inevitable. Resilience is about bouncing back from disappointments, adapting, and staying committed. Be flexible, adjust strategies, and keep your long-term vision. - Sarah Dant, 7Factor Software 4. Prioritize Value: Focus on creating value. It's easy to get discouraged when budgets shrink and deals take longer. Providing value to customers is key. Understand their priorities and craft solutions offering ROI, efficiency, or strategic advantage. - Somnath Roy, Google Cloud 5. Commit to Your Mission: History shows that valuable commodities appreciate over time. Stay focused on your mission. - Shahzad Anwar, Modern Aesthetics & Wellness 6. Play the Long Game: The best biz dev pros focus on long-term strategies, especially during downturns. Reinvent your approach. Pitch new solutions, collaborate, and innovate. - Christina Noble, Medikarma Inc. 7. Invest in Your Team: Businesses that invest during tough times emerge stronger. Invest in your people with training. Consistent and persistent professionals succeed long-term. - Julie Thomas, ValueSelling Associates 8. Expand Globally: Expanding into new markets and industries diversifies revenue and future-proofs your business. Focus on customer outcomes, lead with empathy, and understand their needs. - Tirtha Chavan, Salesforce 9. Find Hobbies, Exercise, and Network: Develop coping mechanisms to handle ups and downs. Find a hobby, exercise, and build a strong network. These breaks benefit your mind and keep you sharp. Also, ensure you get enough sleep. - Darsh Singh Mann, StartX 10. Explore Stable Sectors: In tough times, explore sectors like energy or healthcare. Adapting your focus protects your goals. Flexibility and resilience are crucial. - Kyle Pukylo, NuCycle Energy 11. Adjust, Innovate, and Focus on Customers: Stay adaptable. Revisiting strategies, embracing innovation, and focusing on customer needs can reveal new opportunities. - Tomer Warschauer Nuni, Pink Moon Studio Ltd 12. Create Long-Term Incentives: When crises hit, create contingency plans and adjust your basic plan. Use long-term incentives and rewards to motivate your team. - Gyehyon Andrea Jo, MVLASF 13. Accept the Uncontrollable: Don't try to control the uncontrollable, like an unstable economy. Forecast and factor in tough conditions. Giving up wastes time and resources and invites competition. - Mustansir Paliwala, Zomara Group & EQUANS 14. Read Biographies: Learn from legends' experiences navigating tough times. Keep a dashboard of goals, focus on quick wins, and be realistic about survival. Optimism helps. - Folasade Femi-Lawal, FirstBank of Nigeria Ltd 15. Level Up with Attitude: Level up your game. Understand client pain, build trust, be a true partner, and show value for every dollar. Attitude and grit are key. - Alex Llorens, Contentsquare 16. Sharpen Your Skills: A tough economy separates the skilled from the unprepared. Top sales professionals rise while others struggle. - Vincent Burruano, Vince Burruano Consulting Services, LLC 17. Be Adaptable and Persistent: Be adaptable and persistent, regardless of the economy. Expect setbacks and adjust your course as needed. - Wayne Elsey, The Funds2Orgs Group 18. Stay Disciplined: Economic trends are cyclical. Avoid unfavorable cost structures that will disadvantage you later. - Jim Mizouni, Sage Dental 19. Keep Clients Happy: Prospecting pays off later. Capturing market share in a downturn leads to growth. Keep clients happy and maximize biz dev efforts. - David Mattson, Sandler 20. Stay Confident: Maintain focus and self-belief during tough times. Stay positive and surround yourself with positive energy. Avoid shortcuts that will hurt you later. - Roshan Kumar Shetty, Tech Mahindra Limited
translated_content: Äriarendajana ideede müümine partneritele võib olla nagu ameerika mäed. Mõnikord tunned end maailma tipus, purustades eesmärke. Teinekord võivad turu takistused tekitada tunde, et tahaksid alla anda. Siin on 20 Forbesi äriarendusnõukogu liikme nõuannet, et aidata juhtidel ja meeskondadel majanduslike väljakutsete ajal keskenduda. 1. Ole motiveeritud: Nii headel kui ka halbadel aegadel pinguta edasi. Ära keskendu tagasilöökidele. Säilita oma motivatsioon ja sa näed tulemusi. Ole kannatlik, kuna kontaktid võivad vahetada rolle või seista silmitsi sisemiste takistustega. Ole teadlik ka sellest, mida teised kogevad. - Jack Wagner, Hawk Ventures 2. Otsi mentorit: Leia kogenud mentor, kes oskab nõu anda nii tõusude kui ka mõõnade ajal. Nad on tõenäoliselt näinud sarnaseid olukordi ja saavad sind motiveerida. Hea mentor hoiab sind ka vastutavana. - Hayden Stafford, Seismic 3. Ehita vastupidavust: Ära jäta eesmärke raskel ajal. Tagasilöögid on vältimatud. Vastupidavus tähendab pettumustest taastumist, kohanemist ja pühendumist. Ole paindlik, kohanda strateegiaid ja säilita oma pikaajaline visioon. - Sarah Dant, 7Factor Software 4. Sea prioriteediks väärtus: Keskendu väärtuse loomisele. On lihtne heituda, kui eelarved vähenevad ja tehingute sõlmimine võtab kauem aega. Klientidele väärtuse pakkumine on võti. Mõista nende prioriteete ja loo lahendusi, mis pakuvad investeeringutasuvust, tõhusust või strateegilist eelist. - Somnath Roy, Google Cloud 5. Pühendu oma missioonile: Ajalugu näitab, et väärtuslikud kaubad aja jooksul kallinevad. Keskendu oma missioonile. - Shahzad Anwar, Modern Aesthetics & Wellness 6. Mängi pikka mängu: Parimad äriarendajad keskenduvad pikaajalistele strateegiatele, eriti languse ajal. Leiuta oma lähenemine uuesti. Paku uusi lahendusi, tee koostööd ja uuenda. - Christina Noble, Medikarma Inc. 7. Investeeri oma meeskonda: Ettevõtted, kes investeerivad rasketel aegadel, tulevad tugevamana välja. Investeeri oma inimestesse koolitusega. Järjepidevad ja püsivad spetsialistid saavutavad pikaajalist edu. - Julie Thomas, ValueSelling Associates 8. Laienda globaalselt: Uutele turgudele ja tööstusharudele laienemine mitmekesistab tulu ja kindlustab äri tuleviku. Keskendu klientide tulemustele, ole empaatiline ja mõista nende vajadusi. - Tirtha Chavan, Salesforce 9. Leia hobid, tee trenni ja loo võrgustik: Arenda toimetulekumehhanisme tõusude ja mõõnadega toimetulemiseks. Leia hobi, tee trenni ja loo tugev võrgustik. Need pausid on sinu vaimule kasulikud ja hoiavad sind teravana. Samuti veendu, et sa magad piisavalt. - Darsh Singh Mann, StartX 10. Uuri stabiilseid sektoreid: Rasketel aegadel uuri selliseid sektoreid nagu energeetika või tervishoid. Oma fookuse kohandamine kaitseb sinu eesmärke. Paindlikkus ja vastupidavus on üliolulised. - Kyle Pukylo, NuCycle Energy 11. Kohanda, uuenda ja keskendu klientidele: Ole kohanemisvõimeline. Strateegiate ümbervaatamine, uuenduste omaksvõtmine ja klientide vajadustele keskendumine võivad avada uusi võimalusi. - Tomer Warschauer Nuni, Pink Moon Studio Ltd 12. Loo pikaajalised stiimulid: Kriiside korral loo hädaolukorra plaanid ja kohanda oma põhiplaani. Kasuta pikaajalisi stiimuleid ja preemiaid, et oma meeskonda motiveerida. - Gyehyon Andrea Jo, MVLASF 13. Aktsepteeri kontrollimatut: Ära püüa kontrollida kontrollimatut, näiteks ebastabiilset majandust. Prognoosi ja arvesta raskete tingimustega. Allaandmine raiskab aega ja ressursse ning kutsub esile konkurentsi. - Mustansir Paliwala, Zomara Group & EQUANS 14. Loe elulugusid: Õpi legendide kogemustest rasketel aegadel navigeerimisel. Hoia eesmärkide juhtpaneeli, keskendu kiiretele võitudele ja ole ellujäämise suhtes realistlik. Optimism aitab. - Folasade Femi-Lawal, FirstBank of Nigeria Ltd 15. Tõsta oma taset suhtumisega: Tõsta oma mängu taset. Mõista klientide valu, loo usaldust, ole tõeline partner ja näita väärtust iga dollari eest. Suhtumine ja sitkus on võtmetähtsusega. - Alex Llorens, Contentsquare 16. Teravda oma oskusi: Raske majandus eraldab oskajad ettevalmistamatutest. Parimad müügispetsialistid tõusevad esile, samas kui teised näevad vaeva. - Vincent Burruano, Vince Burruano Consulting Services, LLC 17. Ole kohanemisvõimeline ja püsiv: Ole kohanemisvõimeline ja püsiv, olenemata majandusest. Oota tagasilööke ja kohanda oma kurssi vastavalt vajadusele. - Wayne Elsey, The Funds2Orgs Group 18. Ole distsiplineeritud: Majandustrendid on tsüklilised. Väldi ebasoodsaid kulustruktuure, mis sind hiljem kahjustavad. - Jim Mizouni, Sage Dental 19. Hoia kliendid rahul: Prospekteerimine tasub end hiljem ära. Turuosa hõivamine languse ajal toob kaasa kasvu. Hoia kliendid rahul ja maksimeeri äriarendustegevust. - David Mattson, Sandler 20. Ole enesekindel: Säilita keskendumine ja eneseusk rasketel aegadel. Jää positiivseks ja ümbritse end positiivse energiaga. Väldi otseteid, mis sind hiljem kahjustavad. - Roshan Kumar Shetty, Tech Mahindra Limited

article_content: A graphic image depicting a tumor growing from a cigarette is central to the Government's latest initiative to encourage millions of Britons to quit smoking. Launched today by the Department of Health, the campaign responds to statistics indicating that over a third of smokers believe the health risks of smoking are significantly exaggerated. This perception persists despite smoking remaining the primary cause of premature death, claiming over 100,000 lives annually in the UK. A video advertisement accompanies the campaign. The Department of Health hopes that the tumor imagery will motivate some of Britain's eight million smokers to quit. Dr. Harpal Kumar, chief executive of Cancer Research UK, asserted the necessity of these stark images. The campaign highlights that every 15 cigarettes smoked can cause a mutation leading to cancer, according to the DoH. Chief Medical Officer Professor Dame Sally Davies likened smoking to playing Russian roulette. 'This is a hard-hitting campaign designed to expose the hidden dangers of smoking,' she stated. 'People will see a man smoking, followed by the visual of cancer growing out of the cigarette. This is a representation of what occurs within their bodies.' She added, 'One in two smokers will die from smoking, primarily from cancer. We understand that individuals often fail to personalize the risks and lack awareness of the internal damage. This campaign aims to illustrate these effects.' The initiative also emphasizes that smoking just 15 cigarettes can trigger cancer-causing mutations. Approximately two-thirds of Britain's eight million smokers express a desire to quit, and the campaign encourages them to obtain a free NHS Quit Kit from pharmacies. Previous graphic advertisements, such as those in 2004 featuring fatty deposits being squeezed from a smoker's artery and fat dripping from cigarettes, were followed by milder campaigns over the subsequent eight years. However, the DoH now believes a stronger message is warranted. Dame Sally commented, 'It is extremely concerning that people continue to underestimate the serious health risks associated with smoking. We want smokers to realize that each packet of cigarettes increases their cancer risk.' The £2.7 million campaign is scheduled to run for nine weeks across television, billboards, and online platforms. Dr. Harpal Kumar reiterated the necessity of the campaign's startling images. He stated, 'We must lessen the impact of tobacco on the lives of many. Smoking is not merely a lifestyle choice; it's an addiction that infiltrates lives, leading to death and disease.' 'Quitting smoking can be exceptionally challenging, so providing additional motivation and reminding people of the profound harm it causes can assist smokers in taking the initial step toward quitting for good.'
translated_content: Pilt vähkkasvajast, mis kasvab sigaretist, on keskne osa valitsuse uusimast algatusest, et julgustada miljoneid britte suitsetamisest loobuma. Täna tervishoiuministeeriumi poolt käivitatud kampaania on vastus statistikale, mis näitab, et rohkem kui kolmandik suitsetajatest usub, et suitsetamise terviseriskid on oluliselt üle hinnatud. See arusaam püsib, hoolimata sellest, et suitsetamine on endiselt peamine enneaegse surma põhjus, nõudes Ühendkuningriigis igal aastal üle 100 000 elu. Kampaaniaga kaasneb videoreklaam. Tervishoiuministeerium loodab, et kasvaja kujutis motiveerib mõnda Suurbritannia kaheksast miljonist suitsetajast loobuma. Dr. Harpal Kumar, Cancer Research UK tegevjuht, kinnitas nende teravate piltide vajalikkust. Kampaania rõhutab, et iga 15 suitsetatud sigaretti võib põhjustada mutatsiooni, mis viib vähini, vastavalt tervishoiuministeeriumile. Peaarst professor Dame Sally Davies võrdles suitsetamist vene ruletiga. 'See on karm kampaania, mille eesmärk on paljastada suitsetamise varjatud ohud,' ütles ta. 'Inimesed näevad suitsetavat meest, millele järgneb vähkkasvaja kasvamine sigaretist. See on esitus sellest, mis toimub nende kehas.' Ta lisas: 'Üks kahest suitsetajast sureb suitsetamise tagajärjel, peamiselt vähki. Me mõistame, et inimesed ei suuda sageli riske isikustada ega ole teadlikud sisekahjustustest. See kampaania on mõeldud nende mõjude illustreerimiseks.' Algatus rõhutab ka, et suitsetamine vaid 15 sigaretti võib vallandada vähki tekitavaid mutatsioone. Ligikaudu kaks kolmandikku Suurbritannia kaheksast miljonist suitsetajast väljendab soovi loobuda ja kampaania julgustab neid hankima apteekidest tasuta NHS Quit Kit'i. Varasematele graafilistele reklaamidele, näiteks 2004. aastal avaldatud reklaamidele, kus suitsetaja arterist pigistati rasvaladestusi ja sigarettidest tilkus rasv, järgnesid järgneva kaheksa aasta jooksul leebemad kampaaniad. Kuid tervishoiuministeerium usub nüüd, et on vaja tugevamat sõnumit. Dame Sally kommenteeris: 'On äärmiselt murettekitav, et inimesed alahindavad jätkuvalt suitsetamisega seotud tõsiseid terviseriske. Me soovime, et suitsetajad mõistaksid, et iga sigaretipakk suurendab nende vähiriski.' 2,7 miljoni naelsterlingi suurune kampaania on kavas kestma üheksa nädalat televisioonis, reklaamtahvlitel ja veebiplatvormidel. Dr. Harpal Kumar kordas kampaania jahmatavate piltide vajalikkust. Ta ütles: 'Me peame vähendama tubaka mõju liiga paljude inimeste eludele. Suitsetamine ei ole lihtsalt elustiili valik; see on sõltuvus, mis tungib inimeste ellu, põhjustades surma ja haigusi.' 'Suitsetamisest loobumine võib olla erakordselt keeruline, seega võib täiendava motivatsiooni pakkumine ja inimestele meelde tuletamine, kui suurt kahju see tekitab, aidata suitsetajatel astuda esimene samm lõplikult loobumise suunas.'

article_content: Few road vehicles could hope to outpace an aeroplane. However, the rocket-propelled 'Flash Fire Chevy', boasting a 12,000 horsepower engine and a top speed of nearly 400mph, achieves this feat. The 'Flash Fire Chevy' is the creation of Neal Darnell, a retired businessman from Springfield, Missouri, who embarked on the project after his retirement. Neal Darnell, along with his son Chris, repurposed an engine from a US Navy fighter jet, constructing the vehicle around it. This allows it to accelerate from 0 to 60 mph in just 1.5 seconds. The vehicle's exceptional speed enables Mr. Darnell to race against aeroplanes, often surpassing them thanks to its powerful engine. Specifically, the engine is a Pratt and Whitney model from a T-2 Buckeye, a US Navy trainer jet. The Chevy's rocket power enables rapid acceleration, subjecting the driver to up to 6 G-Force. It effortlessly reaches 350mph and has achieved a recorded top speed of 375mph at airshows, where it captivates audiences by overtaking light aeroplanes flying a few meters above. Mr. Darnell, 65, explained, 'The truck replicates a Chevy S-10. The body mould is derived from an actual Chevy S-10.' He continued, 'To construct such a vehicle, you essentially position the engine and then build the truck to accommodate it.' 'The frame consists of chrome alloy steel, formed around the engine to fit the body. It's a project spanning two years and requiring significant investment.' Mr. Darnell showcases the car at U.S. airshows, impressing spectators by outpacing light aeroplanes in flight. The vehicle, constructed by Mr. Darnell and his son Chris, readily achieves 350mph and has attained a peak speed of 375mph. The truck, a Chevy S-10 replica, is built around the fighter jet engine, with a chrome alloy steel frame. Mr. Darnell, who also races Shockwave, the World's Fastest Jet-Powered Truck, transitioned from a 20-year career in motor sports show production to becoming a driver himself upon retiring. He elaborated, 'Before my airshow involvement, we promoted monster-truck races, truck and tractor pulls, and motocross events. This felt like a natural progression.' 'I have always been involved in racing, including motorcycles, sand dragsters, and funny cars. Retirement presented the opportunity to pursue something fun and exciting.' He concluded, 'Everyone appreciates speed. I will always cherish speed. And this vehicle epitomizes ultimate speed.'
translated_content: Vähesed maismaasõidukid suudaksid lennukist kiiremad olla. Kuid rakettmootoriga 'Flash Fire Chevy', millel on 12 000 hobujõudu ja tippkiirus ligi 640 km/h, saavutab selle. 'Flash Fire Chevy' on Neal Darnelli looming, pensionile läinud ärimees Springfieldist, Missourist, kes asus projekti kallale pärast pensionile jäämist. Neal Darnell koos oma poja Chrisiga kasutasid ümber USA mereväe hävitaja mootori, ehitades sõiduki selle ümber. See võimaldab sel kiirendada 0-lt 96 km/h-ni vaid 1,5 sekundiga. Sõiduki erakordne kiirus võimaldab Darnellil võistelda lennukitega, ületades neid sageli tänu oma võimsale mootorile. Täpsemalt, mootor on Pratt ja Whitney mudel, pärit USA mereväe treeninglennukilt T-2 Buckeye. Chevy rakettmootor võimaldab kiiret kiirendust, pannes juhi proovile kuni 6 G-jõuga. See saavutab hõlpsasti 563 km/h ja on saavutanud õhušõudel registreeritud tippkiiruse 603 km/h, kus see köidab publikut, möödudes mõne meetri kõrgusel lendavatest kerglennukitest. Darnell, 65, selgitas: 'Veoauto on Chevy S-10 koopia. Kerevorm on võetud päris Chevy S-10-lt.' Ta jätkas: 'Sellise sõiduki ehitamiseks paigutad mootori ja ehitad seejärel veoauto selle ümber.' 'Raam on valmistatud kroomitud legeerterasest ja vormitud ümber mootori, et see sobiks kerega. See on kaheaastane projekt, mis nõuab märkimisväärset investeeringut.' Darnell esitleb autot USA õhušõudel, avaldades pealtvaatajatele muljet lennu ajal kerglennukitest möödumisega. Sõiduk, mille ehitasid Darnell ja tema poeg Chris, saavutab hõlpsasti 563 km/h ja on saavutanud tippkiiruse 603 km/h. Veoauto, Chevy S-10 koopia, on ehitatud hävitaja mootori ümber, raam valmistatud kroomitud legeerterasest. Darnell, kes võistleb ka Shockwave'iga, maailma kiireima reaktiivmootoriga veoautoga, vahetas 20 aastat kestnud mootorispordi etenduste tootmise karjääri pensionipõlve vastu ise juhiks hakates. Ta selgitas: 'Enne minu õhušõudel osalemist propageerisime me monsterautode võidusõite, veoautode ja traktorite jõuproove ning motokrossi üritusi. See tundus loogilise jätkuna.' 'Olen alati tegelenud võidusõiduga, sealhulgas mootorratastega, liivadräägsteritega ja naljakate autodega. Pensionile jäämine andis võimaluse tegeleda millegi lõbusa ja põnevaga.' Ta lõpetas: 'Kõik hindavad kiirust. Mina hindan alati kiirust. Ja see sõiduk on ülim kiiruse kehastus.'

article_content: Efe Ambrose will fly to Maribor on Wednesday to rejoin his Celtic teammates. Parkhead officials initially excluded the defender from their Champions League squad due to fears of a Legia Warsaw-style administrative error. The Nigerian international was sent off during the first leg against Legia Warsaw, a 4-1 defeat, and was suspended for the return match at Murrayfield. However, Legia's 2-0 victory was nullified because they fielded a suspended player. This led to Celtic's concern that Ambrose's suspension might not have been fully served. Confusion also arose regarding whether Ambrose received a one- or two-match ban. Despite being absent from the team's departure from Glasgow Airport to Slovenia on Tuesday morning, a call to UEFA headquarters in Nyon confirmed Ambrose's eligibility to play. Coach Ronny Deila attributed the mix-up to 'communication problems.' He stated, 'Efe didn’t travel today; he is arriving tomorrow morning.' 'Initially, there were some communication problems regarding his availability. We believed he had a two-match ban, but ultimately it was one. So, he is coming, and I’m very pleased because we need defenders.' Deila acknowledged that Celtic is unlikely to finalize the loan signing of Ghanaian winger Wakaso Mubarak before tonight's crucial match. Despite hopes of completing a 12-month loan deal before Tuesday night’s 11 pm deadline, Deila commented, 'It’s ongoing, but it doesn’t seem likely to happen today. The paperwork is proving difficult to finalize.' Deila challenged his Celtic team to demonstrate they are more than Champions League 'lucky losers'. After a defeat to Legia, subsequent league victories against St Johnstone and Dundee United have provided a reprieve. Deila urged his team to prove their Champions League worth. 'Everyone wants to prove that,' Deila stated. 'They want to remain in the Champions League, and the players are eager to do so.' 'Against Legia, many players were overeager, and there were numerous new elements affecting their energy.' 'However, we performed well on Saturday, and the players appear sharp in training. If we perform well, we will achieve our desired results. If not, we won’t progress to the next stage. Therefore, our performance must be significantly improved compared to the Legia match.' 'A positive result here will give us the home crowd’s support at Celtic Park for the next game, and everyone understands the significance of that.' Mubarak’s potential absence is compounded by injuries to James Forrest, Adam Matthews, and Aleksander Tonev, limiting Deila’s options in wide positions. Regarding the potential arrival, Deila stated, 'He will be an important addition to the squad, especially with James (Forrest) out. We need him.' 'He is versatile, capable of playing on both sides and as a No. 8 in a 4-3-3 formation.' Concerns have been raised about the 24-year-old's temperament, given his 18 yellow cards and two red cards while at Espanyol before joining Rubin Kazan. 'I haven’t considered that extensively, but I understand African players,' Deila added. 'They adapt when they live in Europe – he isn’t arriving directly from Africa.' 'He previously played in Russia. African players often come from challenging backgrounds, and the initial years in Europe can be difficult.' Celtic is also seeking a striker, but Deila emphasized there is no urgency to complete a £1.8 million deal for Stoke’s Cameron Jerome. 'We’ve been actively trying to sign one, but I won’t sign players unless I’m certain about them. I need to be sure,' he insisted. 'The worst thing would be to sign a player now and later discover he isn’t as good as we hoped. Opportunities can arise in the final two weeks of the transfer window.' 'Even the biggest clubs with the largest budgets are still active in the transfer market. Eventually, they need to offload players.' 'So, I’ll preserve our funds and ensure we spend them wisely. The last 14 days are crucial. I have a positive feeling we’re doing the right things. It feels right.'
translated_content: Efe Ambrose lendab kolmapäeval Mariborisse, et oma Celticu meeskonnakaaslastega taasühineda. Parkheadi ametnikud jätsid kaitsja esialgu Meistrite liiga koosseisust välja, kartes Legia Varssavi sarnast haldusviga. Nigeeria internatsionaal eemaldati esimeses mängus Legia Varssavi vastu, mis kaotati 4:1, ja ta oli Murrayfieldil peetavaks korduskohtumiseks diskvalifitseeritud. Legia 2:0 võit tühistati aga seetõttu, et nad kasutasid diskvalifitseeritud mängijat. See tekitas Celticus muret, et Ambrose'i karistus ei pruugi olla täielikult kantud. Segadus tekkis ka selles, kas Ambrose'ile määrati ühe- või kahemänguline keeld. Vaatamata sellele, et ta puudus teisipäeva hommikul Glasgow' lennujaamast Sloveeniasse suunduvalt meeskonna reisilt, kinnitas kõne UEFA peakorterisse Nyonis Ambrose'i mänguõiguse. Treener Ronny Deila põhjendas segadust 'kommunikatsiooniprobleemidega'. Ta ütles: 'Efe ei reisinud täna; ta saabub homme hommikul.' 'Alguses oli tema saadavusega seotud kommunikatsiooniprobleeme. Arvasime, et tal on kahemänguline keeld, kuid lõpuks oli see üks mäng. Seega ta tuleb ja mul on väga hea meel, sest me vajame kaitsjaid.' Deila tunnistas, et Celtic ei jõua tõenäoliselt enne tänast tähtsat mängu sõlmida laenulepingut Ghana ääremängija Wakaso Mubarakiga. Vaatamata lootusele sõlmida 12-kuuline laenuleping enne teisipäeva õhtul kell 23:00 saabuvat tähtaega, kommenteeris Deila: 'See on töös, kuid tundub, et täna midagi ei juhtu. Paberimajanduse kordaajamine on osutunud keeruliseks.' Deila esitas oma Celticu meeskonnale väljakutse tõestada, et nad on enamat kui Meistrite liiga 'õnnelikud kaotajad'. Pärast Legiale saadud kaotust on järgnenud liigavõidud St. Johnstone'i ja Dundee Unitedi üle pakkunud kergendust. Deila kutsus oma meeskonda üles tõestama oma väärtust Meistrite liigas. 'Kõik tahavad seda tõestada,' ütles Deila. 'Nad tahavad jätkata mängimist Meistrite liigas ja mängijad on innukad seda tegema.' 'Legia vastu olid paljud mängijad üliagarad ja oli palju uusi asju, mis mõjutasid nende energiat.' 'Kuid me mängisime laupäeval hästi ja mängijad näivad treeningutel teravad. Kui me mängime hästi, saavutame soovitud tulemused. Kui ei, siis me ei pääse järgmisse etappi. Seetõttu peab meie esitus olema oluliselt parem kui Legia vastu.' 'Positiivne tulemus siin tagab meile kodupubliku toetuse Celtic Parkis järgmiseks mänguks ja kõik mõistavad selle tähtsust.' Mubaraki võimalik puudumine on veelgi raskendatud James Forresti, Adam Matthewsi ja Aleksander Tonevi vigastustega, mis piiravad Deila valikuid äärepoolkaitses. Potentsiaalse saabumise kohta ütles Deila: 'Ta on oluline täiendus meeskonnale, eriti kuna James (Forrest) on väljas. Me vajame teda.' 'Ta on mitmekülgne, suutes mängida mõlemal äärel ja number 8 positsioonil 4-3-3 formatsioonis.' Muret on tekitanud 24-aastase mängija temperament, arvestades tema 18 kollast ja kahte punast kaarti Espanyolis enne Rubin Kazaniga liitumist. 'Ma pole sellele palju mõelnud, aga ma mõistan Aafrika mängijaid,' lisas Deila. 'Nad kohanevad, kui nad elavad Euroopas – ta ei tule otse Aafrikast.' 'Ta mängis varem Venemaal. Aafrika mängijad on sageli pärit keerulistest oludest ja esimesed aastad Euroopas võivad olla rasked.' Celtic otsib ka ründajat, kuid Deila rõhutas, et Stoke'i mängija Cameron Jerome'i 1,8 miljoni naelsterlingi suuruse lepingu sõlmimisega pole kiiret. 'Oleme aktiivselt proovinud teda värvata, kuid ma ei värba mängijaid, kui ma pole neis kindel. Ma pean olema kindel,' kinnitas ta. 'Kõige hullem oleks mängija praegu värbamine ja hiljem avastamine, et ta pole nii hea, kui lootsime. Üleminekuakna viimased kaks nädalat võivad tuua häid võimalusi.' 'Isegi suurimad klubid, kellel on suurimad eelarved, on endiselt üleminekuturul aktiivsed. Lõpuks peavad nad mängijatest vabanema.' 'Seega hoian ma oma raha alles ja tagan, et me kulutame selle targalt. Viimased 14 päeva on kõige olulisemad. Mul on hea tunne, et me teeme õigeid asju. See tundub õige.'

article_content: The UK will conclude its military presence in Germany, which has been continuous since 1945, by 2020, withdrawing all 20,000 troops. This decision follows the Strategic Defence and Security Review, partly prompted by budget streamlining. Initially, British troops were stationed in Germany post-World War II to ensure stability, later serving as a deterrent against Soviet expansion during the Cold War. The withdrawal will be phased. The initial contingent departs in January, with a substantial number leaving by 2015. Key British bases in Celle and Munster will be returned to German authorities. While initial expenses are expected to restore the land and property used, the UK anticipates long-term savings exceeding £1 billion because of this drawdown.

See otsus on tingitud strateegilisest kaitse- ja julgeoleku ülevaatest, osaliselt eelarve kärbete tõttu. Algselt paigutati Briti väed Saksamaale pärast Teist maailmasõda, et tagada stabiilsus. Hiljem oli nende ülesanne heidutada Nõukogude Liidu laienemist külma sõja ajal. Vägede väljaviimine toimub järk-järgult. Esimene osa vägesid lahkub jaanuaris ja suurem osa aastaks 2015. Peamised Briti sõjaväebaasid Celles ja Münsteris antakse üle Saksa võimudele. Kuigi alguses on vaja investeerida maa-ala ja kinnistute taastamisse, loodab Suurbritannia selle sammuga pikas perspektiivis säästa üle 1 miljardi naela.

article_content: The picture-perfect holiday island of Giglio was once blighted by the tragedy of the Costa Concordia shipwreck. However, romance has returned to the Mediterranean isle, with many salvage workers striking up relationships with local women, leading residents to jokingly rename their home 'Love Island'. As the giant cruise liner prepares to leave Giglio forever, a British 'wrecker' and the local woman he fell in love with are expecting a baby, a symbol of healing for the tragic island. After meeting Simon Jackson, a handsome 36-year-old welder, while he was working to salvage the Costa Concordia, Virginia D'Elia, 22, has moved to his home in Kent. Virginia D'Elia is expected to give birth to a baby boy in mid-August. The baby will be named Filippo, after Virginia's grandfather who lived on Giglio and died around the time of the shipwreck. Relatives on the island express joy that something positive has emerged from the tragedy. Meanwhile, other local women are preparing to bid farewell to their salvage worker lovers as they depart with the ship. For the past two years, residents of Giglio have described an almost wartime atmosphere on the island, with approximately 2000 predominantly male salvage workers moving in, bringing money and heightened energy. Simon’s superior on the island, South African salvage master Nick Sloane, now considered a national hero in Italy, is known for his humor and for showering outdoors at his villa. The island has a permanent winter population of only 800, providing local women with numerous options among the foreign workers. Virginia’s aunt, Liliana Fanciulli, who owns the hotel on Giglio where Virginia worked when she met Simon, said: ‘The baby is due in mid-August. It is a boy, and they are going to name him Filippo.’ ‘They are deeply in love and make a beautiful couple. There are no immediate plans for marriage, but he is a wonderful man, she loves him, and they are having a baby together. That is enough.’ ‘The family is very happy. It’s wonderful that this has happened, that something good has come out of this tragedy. It helps us to move forward.’ Simon Jackson, a salvage expert who manages a family welding business in Sussex, is Virginia D'Elia's first serious boyfriend, according to her relatives. Virginia's relatives on the island are pleased that something positive has finally resulted from the Costa Concordia tragedy. The pair met in a bar and soon began taking romantic walks around the island. Initially, communication was challenging as she spoke limited English and he spoke only basic Italian. When Simon was not working, they would socialize with friends and colleagues at the port's nightspots. On the night of the parbuckling operation in September, when the ship was successfully righted from the rocks in an unprecedented engineering feat, the couple was seen embracing emotionally before Simon boarded the wreck for a dangerous mission. Shortly after the successful mission, the couple moved to the UK, where Virginia began an English course. The couple has since returned twice to visit relatives but decided against visiting for the ship's removal, given Virginia's approaching due date. However, other couples will soon be saying their goodbyes. One of Simon’s former colleagues at salvage company Titan stated: ‘We will be sad to leave. There have been dozens of romances, though not all serious. Nearly all the single men have had a local girlfriend.’ Donatella Botti, a friend of Virginia’s who runs a local bar in the town of Castello, said: ‘All over Giglio, the women are sad today because the salvage workers are leaving.’ ‘Here on this island, we know everyone by name. They have become part of our family and have changed our lives.’ ‘We don’t want them to leave. The night of the wreck was a tragedy, but it changed all our lives forever.’

Kuid romantika on Vahemere saarele tagasi pöördunud, kuna paljud päästetöötajad on loonud suhteid kohalike naistega, mis on viinud selleni, et elanikud on oma kodu naljatamisi ümber nimetanud 'Love Islandiks'. Kui hiiglaslik kruiisilaev valmistub Gigliost igaveseks lahkuma, ootavad Briti 'lammutaja' ja kohalik naine, kellesse ta armus, last, mis on tragöödiasaare jaoks tervenemise sümbol. Pärast kohtumist võluva 36-aastase keevitaja Simon Jacksoniga, kui ta töötas Costa Concordia päästmise nimel, on Virginia D'Elia, 22, kolinud tema koju Kenti. Virginia D'Elia peaks sünnitama poisslapse augusti keskel. Lapsele pannakse nimeks Filippo Virginia vanaisa järgi, kes elas Giglios ja suri umbes laevahuku ajal. Viimased kaks aastat on Giglio elanikud kirjeldanud saarel peaaegu sõjaaegset atmosfääri, kus umbes 2000 peamiselt meessoost päästetöötajat kolis sisse, tuues kaasa raha ja suurenenud energia. Simoni ülemus saarel, Lõuna-Aafrika päästemeester Nick Sloane, keda Itaalias peetakse nüüd rahvuskangelaseks, on tuntud oma huumori ja selle poolest, et ta käib oma villas õues duši all. Saarel on püsivalt vaid 800 elanikku, mis pakub kohalikele naistele palju valikuvõimalusi välismaiste töötajate seas. Sellest piisab.' „Perekond on väga õnnelik. On imeline, et see on juhtunud, et sellest tragöödiast on midagi head sündinud. See aitab meil edasi liikuda.' Simon Jackson, päästeekspert, kes juhib pere keevitusettevõtet Sussexis, on Virginia D'Elia sugulaste sõnul Virginia D'Elia esimene tõsine poiss-sõber. Virginia sugulased saarel on rahul, et Costa Concordia tragöödiast on lõpuks midagi positiivset välja tulnud. Paar kohtus baaris ja hakkas peagi saarel romantilisi jalutuskäike tegema. Alguses oli suhtlemine keeruline, kuna Virgina rääkis piiratud inglise keelt ja Simon rääkis ainult elementaarset itaalia keelt. Kui Simon ei töötanud, suhtlesid nad sõprade ja kolleegidega sadama ööklubides. Parbucklingu operatsiooni õhtul septembris, kui laev pretsedenditu insenertehnilise saavutusega edukalt kividelt püsti tõsteti, nähti paari emotsionaalselt embamas, enne kui Simon ohtlikule missioonile vraki pardale läks. Varsti pärast edukat missiooni kolis paar Suurbritanniasse, kus Virginia alustas inglise keele kursust. Paar on sellest ajast peale kaks korda sugulastele külla tulnud, kuid otsustas laeva eemaldamise ajaks mitte külastada, arvestades Virginia lähenevat tähtaega. Kuid teised paarid ütlevad peagi hüvasti. Üks Simoni endistest kolleegidest päästefirmas Titan teatas: „Meil on kurb lahkuda. Romaane on olnud kümneid, kui mitte sadu, kuigi mitte kõik neist pole tõsised. Peaaegu kõigil vallalistel meestel on olnud kohalik tüdruksõber.’ Donatella Botti, Virginia sõber, kes peab Castello linnas kohalikku baari, ütles: „Kogu Giglios on naised täna kurvad, sest päästetöötajad lahkuvad.’ „Siin saarel teame me kõiki nimepidi. Nad on saanud osaks meie perest ja on muutnud meie elu.’ „Me ei taha, et nad lahkuksid. Laevahuku öö oli tragöödia, kuid see muutis kogu meie elu igaveseks.’

article_content: By Mark Duell. Last updated: October 25, 2011, 6:46 PM. A mother allegedly shot and killed her two sons, ex-husband, and stepmother, then attempted to stage the scene to implicate her son, according to police. Susan Hendricks, 48, of Pickens County, South Carolina, purportedly sought to collect life insurance payouts on all victims. She was present at one of the two homes where the shootings occurred and initially told police that her youngest son had a history of drug use and suicidal tendencies. 'Cover-up': Susan Hendricks allegedly murdered her two sons, ex-husband, and stepmother and tried to frame her son for the crime, police stated. Officers discovered a firearm near the body of Matthew Hendricks, 23, who was found dead in bed. Hendricks claimed he left a note for her on the kitchen table. However, investigators revealed on Tuesday that the scene was staged. Her stepmother, Linda Ann Burns, 64, was found deceased in another bedroom within the same home. According to Greenville County Solicitor Walt Wilkins, 'Her statements were inconsistent with the scientific and forensic evidence.' Next door, authorities discovered her ex-husband, Mark Hendricks, 52, and her other son, Marshall Wayne Hendricks, 20, both fatally shot in the chest. The residences are situated approximately five miles outside Liberty, in a mixed farming and suburban area in western South Carolina. Pickens County Sheriff David Stone defended his decision to delay Hendricks's arrest until nine days after the killings. Prosecutors declined to disclose the total amount of insurance involved but indicated it was substantial. This is not the first fatal shooting at Hendricks's residence. In April 2006, Doyle ‘Brian’ Teague, 36, was fatally shot after entering the house uninvited and allegedly threatening someone inside, as reported by the coroner's office. At the time, investigators determined that Hendricks acted in self-defense. Sheriff Stone explained, 'In a case of this magnitude, where there appears to be no significant risk to the public and the suspect can be readily monitored, it is prudent to conduct thorough forensic tests before making an arrest.' Hendricks was arrested on Monday night and charged with four counts of murder. It was not immediately known whether she had legal representation.

article_content: U.S. Rep. Paul Ryan, a fiscal deal maker? This is the latest iteration of the Wisconsin congressman, who has transitioned from fiscal expert to 2012 Republican vice presidential candidate and potential 2016 presidential contender. Ryan co-authored a bipartisan budget agreement unveiled Tuesday evening, establishing spending parameters for the subsequent two years, just days before a critical deadline. 'This agreement ensures we avoid a government shutdown in January and October. It prevents us from lurching from one crisis to another,' Ryan stated. Budget deal seeks to avert another shutdown. The compromise is significant because agreement was achieved, a difficult feat given the deep partisan divisions in Congress, where budget accords have repeatedly failed since 2011, including a 16-day government shutdown in October. Low profile. Following the presidential defeat, Ryan maintained a low profile. He remained largely silent during the October Republican-Democrat clashes over a federal shutdown and a government funding bill. His silence was noticeable, as prominent fiscal matters highlighted his expertise. He is known in Congress as a budget expert, highly knowledgeable about the federal government and spending, and his colleagues seek his guidance. In recent years, Ryan introduced controversial budget plans that significantly cut spending and altered entitlement programs like Social Security and Medicare. His budgets, titled 'Path to Prosperity,' became defining documents for Republican fiscal policy. Silence broken. Ryan began to re-engage when his party struggled during the government shutdown. He broke his silence with an October Wall Street Journal opinion piece, urging both sides to negotiate. Patty Murray emerges as a bipartisan figure after budget deal. After the government reopened, Ryan seemed to follow his own advice. As head of the House Budget Committee, he negotiated with his Senate counterpart to reach a government spending deal for the remainder of fiscal year 2014. While the budget did not address benefit programs such as Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid, which Ryan wants to reform, it averted another government management crisis. With this deal, Ryan has reemerged as a key figure in the GOP. The question now is: Will the GOP still follow him? The dilemma. As recently as last year, Ryan was considered a true conservative, bridging the gap between the two GOP factions. He gained praise from tea party supporters and had the ear of party leaders because he is a true conservative. Twenty years ago, he worked for Empower America, a conservative organization that later became FreedomWorks. Since then, the organization has evolved from promoting traditional fiscal conservatism and neoconservative foreign policies into a limited-government, tea party-aligned group. However, his support may be wavering. FreedomWorks advised Republican lawmakers Tuesday to vote against Ryan's deal, and many Republican members have already criticized it. Rep. Tim Huelskamp, R-Kansas, said he would not vote for it because it 'raises spending. There's no way around it.' The budget deal in plain English. 'I don't know how a deal is good for conservatives or for America if the spending is going to go up,' Huelskamp said on CNN's 'Crossfire.' Republican strategist and former Mitt Romney spokesman Ryan Williams said that Ryan's October op-ed shows that he's 'the adult in the room.' 'He felt that it was important for him to speak up to address the seemingly never-ending stalemate that we're witnessing in Washington,' Williams added. 2016 ambitions? While speculation grew about Ryan running for the Republican presidential nomination, with recent trips to Iowa and New Hampshire, the first presidential nominating states, a high-profile role in Congress as a deal maker could be a political risk and benefit, depending on the national mood and the influence of the Republican right. CNN's Chelsea J. Carter contributed to this report.

Esindajatekoja eelarvekomisjoni juhina juhtis ta läbirääkimisi oma kolleegiga Senatis, et saavutada valitsuse kulutuste lepe ülejäänud 2014. majandusaastaks. Kuigi eelarve ei käsitlenud hüvitiste programme, nagu sotsiaalkindlustus, Medicare ja Medicaid, mida Ryan soovib reformida, hoidis see ära järjekordse valitsuse juhtimiskriisi. Selle leppega on Ryan taas esile kerkinud kui GOPi keskne tegelane. Küsimus on nüüd selles: kas GOP järgib teda endiselt? Dilemma. Veel eelmisel aastal peeti Ryani tõeliseks konservatiiviks, kes ületas lõhe kahe GOPi fraktsiooni vahel. Ta pälvis kiitust teejoojate toetajatelt ja tal oli parteiliidrite kõrv, sest ta on tõeline konservatiiv. Kakskümmend aastat tagasi töötas ta konservatiivses organisatsioonis Empower America, millest hiljem sai FreedomWorks. Sellest ajast alates on organisatsioon arenenud traditsioonilise eelarvekonservatismi ja neokonservatiivse välispoliitika propageerijast piiratud valitsusega, nn 'teejoojatega' seotud rühmituseks. Kuid tema toetus võib kõikuda. FreedomWorks soovitas Vabariikliku partei seadusandjatele teisipäeval Ryani leppe vastu hääletada ja paljud Vabariikliku partei liikmed on seda juba kritiseerinud. Esindaja Tim Huelskamp, R-Kansas, ütles, et ta ei hääleta selle poolt, sest see 'suurendab kulutusi. Sellest ei saa mööda vaadata.' Eelarvelepe lihtsas keeles. 'Ma ei tea, kuidas on lepe hea konservatiividele või Ameerikale, kui kulutused suurenevad,' ütles Huelskamp CNNi saates 'Crossfire'. Vabariikliku partei strateeg ja endine Mitt Romney pressiesindaja Ryan Williams ütles, et Ryani oktoobri arvamusartikkel näitab, et ta on 'täiskasvanu toas'. 'Ta tundis, et on oluline sõna võtta, et tegeleda näiliselt lõputu ummikseisuga, mida me Washingtonis näeme,' lisas Williams. 2016. aasta ambitsioonid? Kuigi spekulatsioonid Ryani kandideerimise kohta Vabariikliku partei presidendikandidaadiks kasvasid, koos hiljutiste reisidega Iowasse ja New Hampshire'i, esimestesse presidendikandidaate nimetavatesse osariikidesse, võib kõrgetasemeline roll Kongressis lepingute sõlmijana olla nii poliitiline risk kui ka eelis, sõltuvalt riigi meeleolust ja Vabariikliku partei parempoolsete mõjust. article_content: Indonesian authorities discovered 198 refugees from Myanmar early Tuesday off Indonesia's west coast. The refugees reported that the Thai military had towed them out to sea, and they had been drifting in a wooden boat for three weeks. A picture provided to CNN purportedly shows the Thai army towing refugees out to sea. An Indonesian immigration official, Iwan Riyanto, stated that a survivor reported his boat was among a group of boats carrying approximately 1,200 people. The Thai military forces allegedly set them adrift after finding them. The survivor also claimed that 22 of the 220 people on his boat died during the ordeal. An official from the Sabang Region Navy confirmed to CNN that survivors claimed the Thai military set them adrift. Iwan Riyanto also stated that "They were part of nine boats containing Rohingya refugees from Myanmar and Bangladesh that Thai security forces set adrift." A Thai foreign ministry spokesman, Tharit Charungwat, told CNN on Tuesday that his government was aware of the report from Indonesia. "We have to listen to that, but we need to verify, and there shall be no judgment made yet," Charungwat said. Delegates from five countries – Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Myanmar – visited Thailand's Ranong province on Tuesday following the allegations. Allegations surfaced a month prior that the Thai military had dumped a group of Myanmar's Rohingya minority at sea. The Rohingya have been fleeing Myanmar for years, citing persecution by its military government. A recent CNN investigation presented evidence of such activity. Photos obtained by CNN included one showing the Thai army towing a boat carrying approximately 190 refugees. CNN also interviewed a refugee who claimed to be a survivor from a group of six boats towed back to sea and abandoned by Thai authorities earlier this month. The Thai government has initiated an inquiry. The Thai army has denied the allegations. However, after extensive questioning by CNN, a source within the Thai military confirmed the existence of a 'dump-at-sea' policy. The source defended the policy, stating that each boatload of refugees received sufficient food and water. The source added that Thai villagers had become fearful of the hundreds of Rohingya arriving each month, accusing them of theft and threats. The Thai government has stated that "there is no reasonable ground to believe" that the Rohingya were fleeing Myanmar due to persecution. "Their profile and their seasonal travel further support the picture that they are illegal migrants, and not those requiring international protection," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement issued in late January. One of the refugees who arrived in late January stated that they would be killed if returned to Myanmar due to their minority status. He said the Rohingya are stateless because they lack the funds to bribe officials for identification cards in Myanmar. The discovery occurred nearly a week after a judge in Thailand fined dozens of Rohingya refugees from Myanmar who pleaded guilty to illegal entry after fleeing Myanmar in December. CNN's Andy Saputra and Dan Rivers contributed to this report.
translated_content: Indoneesia võimud avastasid teisipäeva varahommikul Indoneesia lääneranniku lähedalt 198 Myanmari pagulast. Pagulased teatasid, et Tai sõjavägi oli nad merele pukseerinud ning nad olid kolm nädalat puupaadis triivinud. CNN-ile esitatud pilt väidetavalt näitab Tai armeed pagulasi merele pukseerimas. Indoneesia immigratsiooniametnik Iwan Riyanto teatas, et ellujäänu sõnul oli tema paat osa paatide grupist, mis vedas umbes 1200 inimest. Väidetavalt jättis Tai sõjavägi nad pärast leidmist triivima. Ellujäänu väitis ka, et 22 tema paadil olnud 220 inimesest suri selle katsumuse ajal. Sabangi piirkonna mereväe ametnik kinnitas CNN-ile, et ellujääjad väitsid, et Tai sõjavägi jättis nad triivima. Iwan Riyanto teatas ka: "Nad olid osa üheksast paadist, mis sisaldasid Myanmarist ja Bangladeshist pärit rohingja pagulasi, mille Tai julgeolekujõud triivima jätsid." Tai välisministeeriumi pressiesindaja Tharit Charungwat ütles teisipäeval CNN-ile, et tema valitsus on Indoneesiast tulnud raportist teadlik. "Me peame seda kuulama, kuid me peame seda kontrollima ja ühtegi otsust ei tohiks veel teha," ütles Charungwat. Pärast neid süüdistusi külastasid viie riigi – Bangladeshi, India, Indoneesia, Malaisia ja Myanmari – delegaadid teisipäeval Tai Ranongi provintsi. Umbes kuu aega tagasi ilmnesid süüdistused, et Tai sõjavägi oli merele hüljanud rühma Myanmari rohingja vähemusrahvusest inimesi. Rohingjad on aastaid Myanmarist põgenenud, viidates sõjaväelise valitsusepoolsele tagakiusamisele. Hiljutine CNN-i uurimine esitas tõendeid sellise tegevuse kohta. CNN-i saadud fotode hulgas oli üks, mis näitas Tai armeed pukseerimas paati umbes 190 pagulasega. CNN intervjueeris ka ühte pagulast, kes väitis, et ta oli üks ellujäänutest kuuest paadist, mille Tai võimud tagasi merele pukseerisid ja maha jätsid varem sel kuul. Tai valitsus on algatanud uurimise. Tai armee on need süüdistused tagasi lükanud. Kuid pärast CNN-i põhjalikku küsitlemist kinnitas Tai sõjaväe allikas "merre hüljamise" poliitika olemasolu. Allikas kaitses seda poliitikat, väites, et igale paaditäiele pagulastele anti piisavalt toitu ja vett. Allikas lisas, et Tai külaelanikud olid hakanud kartma iga kuu saabuvate sadade rohingjade pärast, süüdistades neid vargustes ja ähvardustes. Tai valitsus on teatanud, et "puudub mõistlik põhjus uskuda", et rohingjad põgenesid Myanmarist tagakiusamise tõttu. "Nende profiil ja hooajaline reisikäitumine toetavad pigem pilti, et nad on illegaalsed migrandid, mitte need, kes vajavad rahvusvahelist kaitset," teatas välisministeerium jaanuaris avaldatud avalduses. Üks jaanuaris saabunud pagulane ütles, et nad tapetakse, kui nad Myanmari tagasi saadetakse, kuna nad on vähemusrahvusest. Ta ütles, et rohingjad on kodakondsuseta, kuna neil pole piisavalt raha, et Myanmaris isikutunnistuste saamiseks altkäemaksu maksta. See avastus tehti peaaegu nädal pärast seda, kui Tai kohtunik trahvis kümneid Myanmari rohingja pagulasi, kes tunnistasid end süüdi ebaseaduslikus riiki sisenemises pärast Myanmarist põgenemist detsembris. CNN-i ajakirjanikud Andy Saputra ja Dan Rivers panustasid sellesse raportisse.

article_content: A new mobile payment system called Paym is streamlining how we send money, potentially linking every UK bank account to a phone number. Imagine transferring funds as easily as sending a text! Forget the days of needing bank details; sending money to friends and family is becoming much simpler. The Paym service aims to connect every current account nationwide to a mobile number. Launched recently, Paym is initially accessible to 30 million people across the UK. It allows users to send money using just mobile phone numbers and is supported by major banks like Bank of Scotland, Barclays, and HSBC. By year's end, Paym's reach will expand to 40 million users as more banks join. This means Paym will be available for over 90% of UK current accounts. Paym, pronounced 'pay em,' is hailed as a groundbreaking industry collaboration, potentially uniting all bank accounts with mobile numbers. Users can transfer at least £250 daily, with some banks offering higher limits. Registration, linking your mobile number to a bank account, is needed to receive payments. To use Paym, just update your banking app. When sending money, confirm the recipient's name and amount before hitting send. Both sender and receiver get payment notifications. At launch, customers of Bank of Scotland, Barclays, Cumberland Building Society, Halifax, HSBC, Lloyds Bank, Santander, TSB and Danske Bank can use the service. Already, over 300,000 people have signed up. While registration isn't mandatory for sending money, the sender's bank must participate. Paym lets you send cash using the recipient's phone number, removing the need for bank details. It's integrated into existing mobile banking apps. To pay someone, select a contact or enter their number. The app confirms the recipient's name and amount before sending the money. Adrian Kamellard from the Payments Council highlights Paym as a safe and easy way to repay friends and family. Payments happen at the same speed as current online and mobile banking. Experts predict around £1 billion in payments through Paym by 2018, with some suggesting it could replace cash and traditional banks. With over 94% of adults owning a mobile phone, mobile payment technology is booming. Barclays' Pingit app gained 2.5 million users shortly after its launch. Pingit allows anyone to make payments using just phone numbers. Zapp, another mobile payment scheme, is launching this autumn. Nationwide Building Society plans to join Paym in early 2015. The Payments Council also announced that by the end of next month, those who mistakenly send money to the wrong account will receive better assistance in recovering it. A new code will ensure quicker and more consistent help, though recovery isn't guaranteed. Carphone Warehouse notes a growing demand for smartphones with payment options, highlighting the future of mobile payments.

article_content: Ronald Citarelli, a 49-year-old homeless handyman from Florida, has been arrested and charged with the murder of Barbara Minardi, an 85-year-old widow. Her daughter and son-in-law discovered her body inside her Deltona, Florida home. Authorities apprehended Citarelli on Tuesday, charging him with first-degree murder and burglary related to Barbara Minardi's death. The Volusia County Sheriff's Office released a distressing 911 call made by Minardi's son-in-law. He and his wife discovered the elderly woman deceased at her Omaha Drive residence just before 9pm on Monday. Reports indicate Minardi died from blunt-force trauma; an autopsy will provide further details on the exact cause of death. Citarelli was apprehended following a tip concerning Minardi's stolen 2010 grey Nissan Altima, located seven miles from the crime scene. The vehicle was parked near the home of Citarelli's acquaintances on Comstock Drive. Sheriff Ben Johnson voiced strong opinions, advocating for the death penalty for Citarelli. Johnson described Minardi as a dedicated volunteer of the department. Minardi's family revealed she had been living alone since her husband's death in 1999. She remained active through social clubs and volunteering at the sheriff’s office since 2001, performing tasks like filing and answering phones. The family, including daughter Cindy Callison and her husband Don, expressed shock at Citarelli's arrest, recalling him as a 'smooth talker' who had previously installed flooring for Minardi.

Võimud vahistasid Citarelli teisipäeval, süüdistades teda esimese astme mõrvas ja sissemurdmises seoses Barbara Minardi surmaga. article_content: In Baghdad, Iraq, a U.S. military official reported that a verbal dispute among four U.S. soldiers preceded the fatal shooting of two soldiers and the wounding of a third. Spc. Neftaly Platero is in pre-trial confinement, suspected in the deaths of Spc. John Carrillo Jr. and Pfc. Gebrah P. Noonan, according to a military statement. Carrillo, 20, from Stockton, California, and Noonan, 26, from Watertown, Connecticut, died on Friday from injuries sustained in a "non-combat" incident the previous day, as stated by the U.S. Department of Defense. Both soldiers were assigned to the 3rd Battalion, 15th Infantry Regiment, 4th Infantry Brigade Combat Team, 3rd Infantry Division, based out of Fort Stewart, Georgia. "The families of the victims were informed that a verbal altercation occurred involving four soldiers, after which the suspect allegedly used his weapon to shoot the other soldiers," a military official said. "The Army is conducting an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the deaths." Desiree Carrillo, John Carrillo's mother, shared that her son was a devoted father to his 3-year-old and 3-month-old children. "He was a very young father who joined the military to better provide for his family, while also pursuing his education," she said. Desiree Carrillo also mentioned that the military informed them of Carrillo's death on Friday, after family members had already heard through the media that their son might have been killed by another soldier. Dane Street, Noonan's former track coach, told WFSB that Noonan was well-loved. "His striking hair reflected his vibrant personality," Street commented. "He embraced life wholeheartedly, and it was a joy to witness." Numerous individuals posted rest-in-peace messages on what seems to be Noonan's Facebook page. The Facebook page of "Gebrah Noonan" also lists "Neftaly Platero" -- the suspect's name -- as a Facebook friend. CNN's Mohammed Tawfeeq contributed to this report.

Mõlemad sõdurid kuulusid 3. pataljoni, 15. jalaväerügementi, 4. jalaväebrigaadi lahingugruppi, 3. jalaväediviisi, mis asub Fort Stewartis, Georgia osariigis. article_content: In the immediate aftermath of the final whistle, a Derby County fan jumped the barriers and charged towards Nottingham Forest's celebrating players, throwing punches. The fan aimed two blows at defender Kelvin Wilson, neither of which connected, before being tackled to the ground by Jamaal Lascelles and subsequently escorted away by stewards. This East Midlands derby is renowned as one of British football's most intense rivalries, but such actions are unwelcome. The individual was arrested and faces potential penalties. Stuart Pearce celebrated enthusiastically following Ben Osborn's late winning goal, securing a 2-1 victory for Forest against their rivals. The home supporters experienced a disappointing afternoon as their team relinquished a lead – a rare occurrence for Derby this season – and suffered a defeat against their fiercest rivals. Such losses are deeply felt, and the animosity between the two clubs intensifies with each passing year. The roots of this rivalry are often traced back to the Industrial Revolution when John Heathcoat of Derby invented a machine replicating handmade lace, only for Nottingham entrepreneurs to allegedly exploit the idea once the patent expired. The late Brian Clough famously fueled the rivalry. In 1983, while managing Forest, Clough told defender Willie Young: ‘Just do one thing for me, Willie. Play well in this match, and I won’t ask anything else of you.’ Watford, under Slavisa Jokanovic, continued their impressive form with a 5-0 victory. Odion Ighalo scored twice, with additional goals from Craig Cathcart, Troy Deeney, and Daniel Tozser. The Hornets now sit within the top six, having won five of their last seven Championship games. Forest also suffered a 2-0 defeat against a team led by Clough’s old ally Peter Taylor and Pearce reportedly expressed his displeasure in the dressing room. On that day, Derby players were targeted with coins and bottles by fans, leading to skirmishes near the train station. While security measures have improved, this fixture remains particularly significant for Forest manager Stuart Pearce, reminiscent of its importance to Clough. Pearce, who identifies strongly with Nottingham, famously stated in 1989 that he would rather claim unemployment benefits than play for Derby: ‘No disrespect but I could never work for that club in any capacity.’ He maintained a more composed demeanor at the iPro Stadium on Saturday, witnessing his players respond positively to an impassioned pre-match speech. ‘You’ve either got to play for me to hear a team talk or you’ve got to pay a lot of money to come and listen to me at a leadership conference!’ he joked when questioned about the content of his speech. ‘Otherwise I’m not telling you.’ Pearce’s position at Forest had been precarious before his players mounted a comeback. They had only won twice since September and showed little sign of improvement. Following the late winner, Pearce, for once, didn’t have to resolve a crisis. Pearce was facing considerable pressure after a string of poor results that had seen them drop to 13th in the league. ‘In some ways we might have to build and emulate Derby,’ he conceded. ‘They are an outstanding side, built over five years, from Nigel Clough’s days. Steve (McClaren) has taken the team on, and they are a very good side. They have a fantastic setup at this club.’ Forest owner Fawaz Al-Hasawi discovered that his car tyres had been deflated and a number plate removed after the game. ‘I don’t mind at all. The three points are more important,’ he stated, although Forest may seek compensation for the damage. The visitors, however, displayed resilience, indicating that they may possess the determination to match their manager’s passion. Pearce opted not to celebrate after the game, explaining: ‘I just go inside myself, enjoy the moment, then look to go and win a game on Wednesday. I don’t drink, I gave up 11 years ago.’ He could have benefited from a drink after pulling himself back from the brink. Derby might consider themselves fortunate not to have conceded an early goal. With the score at 0-0, Jake Buxton's tackle on Michail Antonio, more reminiscent of a rugby challenge, went unpunished by the referee. Scunthorpe suffered the misfortune of losing first-choice goalkeeper Sam Slocombe to a broken arm in their 2-0 defeat against Bristol City, only for substitute James Severn to suffer the same injury before half-time. Defender Andrew Boyce played in goal for 48 minutes, and City only scored their second goal late in the game. Yeovil finally secured a victory. Their previous win was on December 13, but a debut goal from Gozie Ugwu secured an impressive win against Bradford for Gary Johnson’s team. The chant of the weekend goes to the Oldham fans at Fleetwood Town. The hosts were taunted about their fishing industry heritage, with Oldham supporters singing: ‘Pies are sustainable.’ It worsened for Graham Alexander’s Cod Army, who lost 2-0 and risk drifting into mid-table.
translated_content: Kohe pärast lõpuvilet hüppas Derby County fänn üle barjääride ja tormas Nottingham Foresti tähistavate mängijate poole, loopides rusikatega. Fänn sihtis kaks lööki kaitsja Kelvin Wilsoni pihta, millest kumbki ei tabanud, enne kui Jamaal Lascelles ta maha niitis ja seejärel turvameeste poolt ära eskorditi. See Ida-Midlandi derbi on tuntud kui üks Briti jalgpalli kõige pingelisemaid rivaalitsemisi, kuid sellised tegevused on taunitavad. Isik arreteeriti ja teda ootavad võimalikud karistused. Stuart Pearce tähistas entusiastlikult pärast Ben Osborni hilist võiduväravat, kindlustades Forestile 2:1 võidu oma rivaalide üle. Kodupublik koges pettumust valmistavat pärastlõunat, kuna nende meeskond loovutas eduseisu – Derby jaoks sel hooajal haruldane sündmus – ja sai lüüa oma ägedaima rivaali käest. Sellised kaotused on valusad ja vaen kahe klubi vahel kasvab iga aastaga. Selle rivaalitsemise juured ulatuvad sageli tagasi tööstusrevolutsiooni, kui John Heathcoat Derbyst leiutas masina, mis kopeeris käsitsi valmistatud pitsi, kuid Nottinghami ettevõtjad väidetavalt kasutasid seda ideed ära pärast patendi aegumist. Hiline Brian Clough õhutas kuulsalt rivaalitsemist. 1983. aastal, Foresti peatreenerina, ütles Clough kaitsja Willie Youngile: „Tee minu heaks ainult üks asi, Willie. Mängi selles mängus hästi ja ma ei küsi sinult midagi muud.’ Watford, Slavisa Jokanovici juhendamisel, jätkas oma muljetavaldavat vormi 5:0 võiduga. Odion Ighalo lõi kaks väravat, lisaks väravad Craig Cathcartilt, Troy Deeneylt ja Daniel Tozserilt. Hornets on nüüd esikuuikus, olles võitnud viis oma viimasest seitsmest meistrivõistluste mängust. Forest kannatas ka 2:0 kaotuse meeskonna vastu, mida juhtis Cloughi vana liitlane Peter Taylor ja Pearce väljendas väidetavalt oma rahulolematust riietusruumis. Sel päeval loopisid fännid Derby mängijaid müntide ja pudelitega, mis viis kokkupõrgeteni raudteejaama lähedal. Kuigi turvameetmeid on täiustatud, on see mäng Foresti peatreeneri Stuart Pearce'i jaoks eriti oluline, meenutades selle tähtsust Cloughi jaoks. Pearce, kes samastub tugevalt Nottinghamiga, teatas kuulsalt 1989. aastal, et ta pigem taotleks töötuskindlustushüvitisi kui mängiks Derby eest: „Ilma austuseta, aga ma ei saaks kunagi selles klubis mingil ametikohal töötada.’ Ta säilitas laupäeval iPro staadionil rahuliku käitumise, nähes, kuidas tema mängijad reageerisid positiivselt kirglikule eelmängu kõnele. „Sa kas mängid minu heaks, et meeskonna juttu kuulda, või pead maksma palju raha, et tulla mind juhtimiskonverentsile kuulama!’ naljatas ta, kui temalt küsiti tema kõne sisu kohta. „Muidu ma ei ütle teile.’ Pearce'i positsioon Forestis oli olnud ebakindel enne, kui tema mängijad vastulöögi andsid. Nad olid alates septembrist võitnud vaid kaks korda ja ei näidanud mingeid paranemise märke. Pärast hilist võiduväravat ei pidanud Pearce seekord kriisi lahendama. Pearce'ile avaldati suurt survet pärast halbu tulemusi, mis olid viinud nad liigas 13. kohale. „Mõnes mõttes peame võib-olla ehitama ja jäljendama Derbyt,’ tunnistas ta. „Nad on silmapaistev meeskond, ehitatud üle viie aasta, Nigel Cloughi päevadest. Steve (McClaren) on meeskonna üle võtnud ja nad on väga hea meeskond. Neil on selles klubis fantastiline ülesehitus.’ Foresti omanik Fawaz Al-Hasawi avastas pärast mängu, et tema auto rehvid olid tühjaks lastud ja numbrimärk eemaldatud. „Ma ei pahanda üldse. Kolm punkti on olulisemad,’ teatas ta, kuigi Forest võib kahju eest hüvitist nõuda. Külalised näitasid aga vastupidavust, mis näitab, et neil võib olla otsusekindlust, et vastata oma mänedžeri kirele. Pearce otsustas pärast mängu mitte tähistada, selgitades: „Ma lihtsalt lähen endasse, naudin hetke, siis püüan minna ja võita mäng kolmapäeval. Ma ei joo, ma loobusin sellest 11 aastat tagasi.’ Ta oleks võinud lonksu võtta pärast seda, kui ta end äärelt tagasi tõmbas. Derby võib pidada end õnnelikuks, et nad ei lasknud endale varakult väravat lüüa. Seisuga 0:0 jäi Jake Buxtoni tegevus Michail Antonio vastu, mis meenutas rohkem ragbi väljakutset, kohtuniku poolt karistamata. Scunthorpe'il oli õnnetus kaotada oma esiväravavaht Sam Slocombe käeluumurruga nende 2:0 kaotuses Bristol City vastu, ainult selleks, et asendusmängija James Severn kannataks sama vigastuse all enne poolaega. Kaitsja Andrew Boyce mängis väravas 48 minutit ja City lõi oma teise värava alles mängu lõpus. Yeovil tagas lõpuks võidu. Nende eelmine võit oli 13. detsembril, kuid Gozie Ugwu debüütvärav kindlustas Gary Johnsoni meeskonnale muljetavaldava võidu Bradfordi üle. Nädala hümni tiitel läheb Oldham fännidele Fleetwood Townis. Võõrustajaid narriti nende kalanduse pärandi pärast, Oldham toetajad laulsid laulsid: „Pirukad on jätkusuutlikud.” See muutus Graham Alexanderi Cod Armyle hullemaks, kes kaotas 2:0 ja riskib kesktabelisse langemisega.

article_content: Following discussions among G7 foreign ministers in Japan, US Secretary of State Antony Blinken shared crucial requirements for achieving lasting peace and security after the Israel-Gaza war. He emphasized the White House's position that neither Israel nor Hamas should govern Gaza once the current hostilities cease. Blinken highlighted key principles needed to establish a sustainable peace, indicating US interest in discussing strategies for the period following the conflict. He stressed that Palestinians should not be forcibly displaced from Gaza, either during or after the war. Furthermore, Gaza should not serve as a base for terrorist activities or violent attacks, and there should be no reoccupation of Gaza once the conflict concludes. Blinken also cautioned against any attempts to blockade or lay siege to Gaza, or to diminish Gaza's territory. These statements followed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's suggestion that Israel would control security in Gaza post-war, a proposal US officials clarified that President Joe Biden does not support. Blinken reinforced the US stance that Hamas, the current governing body, cannot administer Gaza, arguing that doing so would risk a repeat of the October 7 attack. This attack triggered a severe response, leading to bombardments that resulted in over 10,000 fatalities in Gaza. Blinken acknowledged the potential need for a transitional phase after the conflict but reiterated hearing from Israeli leaders that they do not intend to reoccupy Gaza. In response to the US statements, Hamas asserted that governing Gaza is solely a Palestinian matter. Hamas spokesman Abdul-Latif al-Qanou stated that no external force can alter this reality or impose its will. Al-Qanou described Hamas as a national liberation movement rooted in Palestinian society, affirming its right to resist occupation under international laws and customs.

Ta rõhutas Valge Maja seisukohta, et ei Iisrael ega Hamas ei tohiks Gazat valitseda, kui praegused vaenutegevused lõpevad. Blinken rõhutas peamisi põhimõtteid, mis on vajalikud jätkusuutliku rahu saavutamiseks, viidates USA huvile arutada strateegiaid konfliktijärgseks perioodiks. Ta rõhutas, et palestiinlasi ei tohiks Gazast jõuga ümber asustada ei sõja ajal ega pärast seda. Lisaks ei tohiks Gaza olla terroristliku tegevuse või vägivaldsete rünnakute aluseks ning pärast konflikti lõppu ei tohiks Gazat uuesti okupeerida. Blinken hoiatas ka katsete eest Gazat blokeerida või piirata või Gaza territooriumi vähendada. Need avaldused järgnesid Iisraeli peaministri Benjamin Netanyahu ettepanekule, et Iisrael kontrollib Gaza julgeolekut pärast sõda, ettepanekule, mille USA ametnikud selgitasid, et president Joe Biden seda ei toeta. Blinken tugevdas USA seisukohta, et Hamas, praegune valitsev organ, ei saa Gazat hallata, väites, et see riskiks 7. oktoobri rünnaku kordumisega. See rünnak vallandas tõsise vastuse, mis viis pommitamisteni, mille tagajärjel hukkus Gazas üle 10 000 inimese. Blinken tunnistas, et pärast konflikti võib olla vajalik üleminekufaas, kuid kordas Iisraeli juhtide kinnitusi, et neil ei ole kavatsust Gazat uuesti okupeerida. Vastuseks USA avaldustele kinnitas Hamas, et Gaza valitsemine on ainult Palestiina küsimus. article_content: The Bolshoi Ballet has dismissed claims that one of its dancers, Pavel Dmitrichenko, orchestrated an acid attack to blind artistic director Sergei Filin as 'absurd.' Despite an alleged confession, Bolshoi employees expressed skepticism in an open letter Wednesday, saying that they do not believe Dmitrichenko was behind the attack that severely burned and nearly blinded Filin. The letter stated that 'Unfortunately, the history of our country and our society knows many examples' when results were achieved by 'illegal methods, and evidence and proof often turned out to be a fiction.' The group has urged an independent commission to investigate the incident thoroughly. Moscow police responded by asserting that their 'investigators do their job honestly.' Authorities allege that Dmitrichenko was the main instigator, supposedly retaliating against Filin, who often cast him as villains in productions. It's undisputed that in January, someone threw sulfuric acid at Filin as he arrived at his Moscow residence. According to police, Dmitrichenko had two accomplices, one of whom carried out the attack. Local media quoted ballet members claiming Dmitrichenko was upset because he believed Filin was hindering his girlfriend Anzhelina Vorontsova's career. The Bolshoi's cast and crew wrote that 'For everyone who knows Pavel Dmitrichenko, even the idea that he could be the mastermind and the customer of the crime committed in such a brutal form, is absurd.' The letter further added that 'Having known Pavel personally for many years, we are convinced that despite his notorious temper, his hot-headedness and his straightforwardness, he is a very decent and sympathetic person who is always ready to extend a helping hand.' The ballet members stated they were convinced that disagreements with Filin regarding his artistic and personnel decisions would not have led to illegal actions. They also suggested the investigation was rushed, evidence unconvincing, and Dmitrichenko's testimony potentially coerced. Dmitrichenko and his alleged accomplices remain in custody pending the investigation's conclusion. Filin's recovery from the burns is expected to take at least six months. Doctors performed a skin graft and surgeries that were able to save his eyesight. Filin is reportedly 'coming through the toughest period of his life,' according to the Bolshoi. The ballet hopes 'that the true reasons and circumstances of this crime would be established.' Police have stated that the investigation is ongoing and preliminary results will be disclosed to the ballet and the public. Last week, police announced the case was solved based on Dmitrichenko's confession. In a video released by police, the dancer purportedly said, 'I organized this attack but not to the extent that it happened.' RIA Novosti reported that Filin had been subjected to intimidation for months before the attack, including threatening phone calls, slashed tires, and attempted hacking of his Facebook account.

Vaatamata väidetavale ülestunnistusele väljendasid Bolšoi töötajad kolmapäeval avalikus kirjas skeptilisust, öeldes, et nad ei usu, et Dmitritšenko oli Filini ründamise taga, mis põhjustas raskeid põletushaavu ja peaaegu pimedaksjäämist. Kirjas öeldi, et 'Kahjuks tunneb meie riigi ja meie ühiskonna ajalugu palju näiteid', kus tulemused saavutati 'ebaseaduslike meetoditega ning tõendid ja tõestused osutusid sageli väljamõeldisteks'. Grupp on tungivalt nõudnud sõltumatut komisjoni juhtumi põhjalikuks uurimiseks. Moskva politsei vastas, kinnitades, et nende 'uurijad teevad oma tööd ausalt'. Võimud väidavad, et Dmitritšenko oli peamine õhutaja, väidetavalt kättemaksuks Filinile, kes sageli andis talle lavastustes kurikaela rolli. On vaieldamatu, et jaanuaris viskas keegi Filini pihta väävelhapet, kui ta oma Moskva residentsi saabus. Politsei andmetel oli Dmitritšenkol kaks kaasosalist, kellest üks viis rünnaku läbi. Kohalik meedia tsiteeris balletiliikmeid, kes väitsid, et Dmitritšenko oli ärritunud, sest ta uskus, et Filin takistas tema tüdruksõbra Anželina Vorontsova karjääri. Bolšoi trupp ja meeskond kirjutasid, et 'Kõigile, kes tunnevad Pavel Dmitritšenkot, on isegi mõte, et ta võiks olla sellise jõhkra vormiga toime pandud kuriteo peaideoloog ja tellija, absurdne.' Kirjas lisati veel, et 'Olles Pavelit isiklikult aastaid tundnud, oleme veendunud, et vaatamata tema kurikuulsale temperamendile, kuumapäisusele ja otsekohesusele on ta väga korralik ja sümpaatne inimene, kes on alati valmis abikätt ulatama.' Balletiliikmed kinnitasid, et erimeelsused Filiniga seoses tema kunstiliste ja personalialaste otsustega ei oleks viinud ebaseaduslike tegudeni. Nad vihjasid ka, et uurimine oli kiirustatud, tõendid ei veennud ja Dmitritšenko tunnistus võis olla sunnitud. Dmitritšenko ja tema väidetavad kaasosalised on vahi all kuni uurimise lõpuni. Filini põletushaavadest taastumine võtab eeldatavasti vähemalt kuus kuud. Arstid tegid nahasiirdamise ja operatsioonid, millega õnnestus tema nägemine päästa. Väidetavalt on Filin 'läbimas oma elu kõige raskemat perioodi', teatas Bolšoi. Ballett loodab, 'et selle kuriteo tegelikud põhjused ja asjaolud selgitatakse välja'. Politsei on teatanud, et uurimine on käimas ja esialgsed tulemused avalikustatakse balletile ja avalikkusele. Eelmisel nädalal teatas politsei, et juhtum on lahendatud Dmitritšenko ülestunnistuse alusel. Politsei avaldatud videos ütles tantsija väidetavalt: 'Ma organiseerisin selle rünnaku, aga mitte sellisel määral, nagu see juhtus.' RIA Novosti teatas, et Filinit oli kuid enne rünnakut ähvardatud, sealhulgas ähvardavate telefonikõnede, purustatud rehvide ja katsetega häkkida tema Facebooki kontot.
