article_content: Want to ride an elevator into space? While the idea has been around for over 100 years, a nanotechnology breakthrough could mean space travel on a diamond cable is within reach. Scientists at Penn State University in the US published research showing the potential of ultra-thin 'diamond nanothreads,' exceeding the strength and stiffness of today's best nanotubes and polymers. John Badding, a chemistry professor at Penn State University, told CNN his team made the discovery while studying benzene molecule properties, taking 18 months to understand their findings. 'It's like an incredible jeweler has strung together the smallest diamonds into a miniature necklace,' Badding said. 'Because it is diamond at its core, we expect it to be extraordinarily stiff, strong, and useful.' Benzene breakthrough: The experiments involved compressing benzene -- a liquid -- into a solid. 'We found that compressing benzene much more slowly than previously resulted in new materials,' he said. 'Everyone expected the benzene molecules to link in a disorganized way, like a glassy amorphous material.' 'Instead, our experiments revealed order in the benzene, which was surprising,' he added. The fact that it occurred at room temperature was also unexpected. Under pressure: The scientists tested the hypothesis that benzene molecules break under high pressure and their atoms seek to bind, but are constrained by the lack of space. 'This makes benzene highly reactive, so a slow pressure release causes an orderly polymerization reaction, forming the diamond-core nanothread,' he explained. The result is one of the strongest and stiffest, yet lightweight, materials known. 'One of our biggest hopes for these nanomaterials is their use in super-strong, lightweight cables, enabling the construction of a 'space elevator,' previously only a science-fiction concept,' Badding said. Next stop... outer space: Obayashi, a Japanese construction company, is already exploring a space elevator, envisioning a space station tethered to the equator by a 96,000km carbon nanotechnology cable. The space station would orbit in a geostationary position, with the cable held taut by Earth's rotation, like an Olympic hammer thrower. Robotic cars with magnetic motors would take seven days to reach the space station, transporting cargo and people into space at a fraction of the current cost. The International Space Elevator Consortium (ISEC) estimates space payloads would cost hundreds of dollars per kilogram, compared to the current $20,000 via rocket technology. The key is in the small scale: Nanotechnology is crucial to creating cables from a material stronger and harder than any currently available. ISEC states that a 2.5-inch thick carbon nanotechnology cable could lift the equivalent of three International Space Stations into orbit daily. 'The tensile strength is almost a hundred times stronger than steel, so it's possible,' said Yoji Ishikawa, a research and development manager at Obayashi, to the Australian Broadcasting Corporation. 'Currently, we can only make 3-centimeter-long nanotubes, but we need much more... we think we'll be able to do it by 2030.' Goodbye, rocket man: Space elevators aren't the only non-rocket technology being explored for space travel. NASA has examined methods from high-velocity artillery to rail-launched maglev projects. NASA's Stanley Starr said their focus is on developing in-space exploration technologies. 'There are many challenges,' Starr told CNN. Nevertheless, NASA continues to explore systems, even unusual ones like the Slingatron, that could achieve orbit without fuel-heavy rockets. 'The space elevator is interesting, but requires a material breakthrough or a new concept to work. I don't foresee it working in my lifetime,' Starr said. 'I briefly looked at the Slingatron and don't believe it's feasible.' When physics gets in the way: Starr said aerodynamics and physics present persistent problems. High-velocity concepts, like super artillery, face challenges with aerodynamic forces and heating. 'Launching a small satellite from a cannon at orbital velocity would likely destroy the projectile from heat and stress,' he said. 'Even if it survived, most of its mass would be structure, not payload.' Still, NASA hasn't abandoned non-rocket launches. 'I believe NASA will eventually invest in advanced non-rocket launch technology, but not soon,' Starr said. 'I would like NASA to establish a networked group from several centers to actively research new launch technologies and make recommendations.'
translated_content: Kas sa tahad sõita liftiga kosmosesse? Kuigi see idee on olnud olemas juba üle 100 aasta, võib nanotehnoloogia läbimurre tähendada, et kosmosereis teemantkaabli abil on käeulatuses. USA-s asuva Penn State'i ülikooli teadlased avaldasid uuringu, mis näitab üliõhukeste 'teemantnanoniitide' potentsiaali, mis ületavad tänapäeva parimate nanotorude ja polümeeride tugevuse ja jäikuse. Penn State'i ülikooli keemiaprofessor John Badding ütles CNN-ile, et tema meeskond tegi avastuse benseenimolekulide omadusi uurides, kulutades 18 kuud oma leidude mõistmiseks. "See on nagu uskumatu juveliir oleks kokku lükkinud kõige väiksemad teemandid miniatuurseks kaelakeeks," ütles Badding. "Kuna selle süda on teemant, siis me eeldame, et see on erakordselt jäik, tugev ja kasulik." Benseeni läbimurre: Katsed hõlmasid benseeni – vedeliku – kokkusurumist tahkeks aineks. "Me leidsime, et benseeni palju aeglasem kokkusurumine kui varem, viis uute materjalideni," ütles ta. "Kõik eeldasid, et benseenimolekulid ühinevad korratul viisil, nagu klaasjas amorfne materjal." "Selle asemel näitasid meie katsed, et benseenis on kord, mis oli üllatav," lisas ta. Samuti oli ootamatu, et see toimus toatemperatuuril. Surve all: Teadlased katsetasid hüpoteesi, et benseenimolekulid purunevad kõrge rõhu all ja nende aatomid püüavad seonduda, kuid ruumipuuduse tõttu on see piiratud. "See muudab benseeni väga reaktiivseks, seega põhjustab aeglane rõhu vabastamine korrapärase polümerisatsioonireaktsiooni, moodustades teemantsüdamikuga nanoniidi," selgitas ta. Tulemuseks on üks tugevamaid ja jäigemaid, kuid samas kergeid materjale, mis on teada. "Üks meie suurimaid lootusi nende nanomaterjalide osas on nende kasutamine ülitugevates, kergetes kaablites, mis võimaldavad ehitada 'kosmose lifti', mis varem oli vaid ulmekirjanduse kontseptsioon," ütles Badding. Järgmine peatus... kosmos: Jaapani ehitusettevõte Obayashi uurib juba kosmose lifti, nähes ette kosmosejaama, mis on ekvaatoriga ühendatud 96 000 km pikkuse süsiniknanotehnoloogia kaabliga. Kosmosejaam tiirleks geostatsionaarses asendis, kus kaabel püsib pingul Maa pöörlemise tõttu, nagu olümpia vasaraheitja. Robonautod magnetmootoritega võtaksid kosmosejaama jõudmiseks seitse päeva, transportides lasti ja inimesi kosmosesse murdosa praegusest maksumusest. Rahvusvaheline Kosmose Lifti Konsortsium (ISEC) hindab, et kosmose lastid maksaksid sadu dollareid kilogrammi kohta, võrreldes praeguse 20 000 dollariga raketitehnoloogia kaudu. Võti peitub väikeses mastaabis: Nanotehnoloogia on ülioluline kaablite loomiseks materjalist, mis on tugevam ja kõvem kui ükski praegu saadaval olev materjal. ISEC väidab, et 2,5-tollise paksusega süsiniknanotehnoloogia kaabel suudaks iga päev orbiidile tõsta kolme Rahvusvahelise Kosmosejaama ekvivalendi. "Tõmbetugevus on peaaegu sada korda suurem kui terasel, nii et see on võimalik," ütles Obayashi teadus- ja arendusjuht Yoji Ishikawa Austraalia Ringhäälingukorporatsioonile. "Praegu saame valmistada ainult 3 cm pikkuseid nanotorusid, kuid me vajame palju rohkem... me arvame, et suudame seda teha aastaks 2030." Hüvasti, raketimees: Kosmose liftid ei ole ainus mitte-raketitehnoloogia, mida kosmosereiside jaoks uuritakse. NASA on uurinud meetodeid alates suure kiirusega suurtükiväest kuni raudteel käivitatavate maglevprojektideni. NASA esindaja Stanley Starr ütles, et nende fookus on kosmosesisese uurimistehnoloogia arendamisel. "On palju väljakutseid," ütles Starr CNN-ile. Sellegipoolest jätkab NASA süsteemide uurimist, isegi ebatavaliste, nagu Slingatron, mis võiksid saavutada orbiidi ilma kütuserohkete rakettideta. "Kosmose lift on huvitav, kuid selle toimimiseks on vaja materjalide läbimurret või uut kontseptsiooni. Ma ei näe, et see minu eluajal töötaks," ütles Starr. "Ma vaatasin korraks Slingatroni ja ei usu, et see on teostatav." Kui füüsika saab takistuseks: Starr ütles, et aerodünaamika ja füüsika tekitavad püsivaid probleeme. Suure kiirusega kontseptsioonid, nagu super suurtükivägi, seisavad silmitsi väljakutsetega aerodünaamiliste jõudude ja kuumusega. "Väikese satelliidi suurtükist orbiidile saavutamiseks piisava kiirusega välja laskmine hävitaks tõenäoliselt kuumuse ja pinge tõttu," ütles ta. "Isegi kui see ellu jääks, oleks suurem osa selle massist struktuur, mitte kasulik koormus." Sellegipoolest ei ole NASA mitte-raketilaskmisi hüljanud. "Ma usun, et NASA investeerib lõpuks täiustatud mitte-raketilaskmistehnoloogiasse, kuid mitte niipea," ütles Starr. "Ma sooviksin, et NASA asutaks mitmest keskusest võrgustatud töörühma, et aktiivselt uurida uusi laskmistehnoloogiaid ja teha soovitusi uute uuringute kohta."

article_content: By Associated Press Reporter Sales of existing homes have slipped to their lowest level in about two years as severe winter weather, rising prices, and a tight supply of homes discourage buyers. The National Association of Realtors has revealed that sales declined 0.4 percent in February to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 4.6 million. That was the sixth decline in the past seven months. Freezing temperatures and snowstorms likely kept many buyers from visiting open houses, with higher mortgage rates weighing on sales since last fall. Calculatedriskblog.com mapped the new data in the following graphs. The National Association of Realtors today revealed that home sales have slipped to their lowest level in about two years as severe winter weather, rising prices, and a tight supply of homes discourage buyers. Using NAR data, this graph by calculatedriskblog.com shows US home sales generally peak in the warmer months. Still, there were some signs that the market could pick up in the coming months. Sales improved in the South and West, where weather was less of a factor. And more people decided to sell, boosting the supply of available homes by 6.4 percent to 2 million. 'Once we get past this messy period, housing should assume its role in supporting overall growth,' Jennifer Lee, an economist at BMO Capital Markets, said in a note to clients. Home prices are rising despite the sluggish sales, a sign that the number of homes for sale remains low. The median sales price has risen 9.1 percent in the past year, the Realtors said, to $189,000. Investors are accounting for an increasing share of purchases, while first-time buyers remain at historically low levels. All-cash sales, which are mostly by investors, rose to 35 percent of purchases in February, up from 32 percent a year ago. National Association of Realtors data shows sales declined 0.4 percent last month to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 4.6 million - the sixth decline in the past seven months. First-time buyers accounted for only 28 percent of sales in February, slightly more than in January. That's far below the 40 percent that is typical of a healthy market. First-time buyers are being held back by tight credit standards and high levels of student loan debt, the Realtors said. Sales of existing homes climbed steadily in the first half of last year, reaching an annual pace of 5.38 million in July. And sales totaled 5.1 million in all of 2013, the most in seven years. That's still below the 5.5 million that is consistent with a healthy housing market. The latest National Association of Realtors data has revealed sluggish house sales during the winter period. But sales slowed in the fall as rising mortgage rates and higher home prices began to squeeze some buyers out of the market. Freezing temperatures and winter storms also kept prospective buyers away from open houses. Sales have fallen 14 percent since July. The average interest rate on a 30-year mortgage slipped to 4.32 percent last week from 4.37 percent. Rates have risen about a full percentage point since hitting record lows last spring.

article_content: Amanda Bynes, known for her role in 'Easy A', has been arrested again for DUI. Law enforcement apprehended her around 4 a.m. on Sunday in the San Fernando Valley area of Los Angeles. The California Highway Patrol confirmed the arrest with MailOnline, stating she was charged with driving her Mercedes-Benz while under the influence of a controlled substance. TMZ reported that Bynes was allegedly under the influence of drugs, specifically marijuana, but the CHP has not confirmed this. She was booked on a misdemeanor DUI charge at the LAPD's Van Nuys division. Prior to this, Bynes had been living with her parents, Lynn and Rick, in a Los Angeles suburb while addressing past legal issues. She was last seen publicly in June. After being released from her conservatorship in early September, Bynes moved into an apartment in Orange County. According to a source, problems seemed to escalate once she began living independently. This arrest creates legal complications for Bynes, as she is on probation from a reckless driving conviction last February. Earlier this year, Bynes attended fashion design courses at the Fashion Institute Of Design And Merchandising in Irvine, California, and appeared to be in good health. Her legal issues began in March 2012 with a ticket for using a cell phone while driving. In April 2012, she was arrested for DUI after sideswiping a police car in West Hollywood. In September 2012, she faced charges for two alleged hit-and-run incidents from April and August, which were later dropped. In 2013, after moving to New York City, Bynes' behavior became erratic. In May, she was arrested for drug possession, attempted tampering with evidence, and reckless endangerment, reportedly throwing a bong from her 36th-floor apartment window. In April, Bynes' attorney stated that she was not taking medication and was committed to a healthy lifestyle, with her family's support while granting her independence. Past events include: Retiring from acting at 24, then unretiring weeks later. Being arrested in April 2012 after a minor collision with a police car and reportedly refusing a breathalyzer test. Crashing into another car on the freeway shortly after and allegedly fleeing the scene. In June 2012, attempting to get Barack Obama to intervene in her DUI case via Twitter. Facing charges in September 2012 for hit-and-run incidents and driving with a suspended license. Being kicked out of a spin class and claiming to be doing 'amazing' and planning to start a fashion line in New York City. article_content: In the span of six weeks, with grand displays of importance, India's capital hosted two world leaders who no longer engage with each other: the presidents of Russia and the United States. India finds itself in a delicate position between these two adversaries. Regarding geopolitical issues like Syria, Iran, or Ukraine, Moscow and Washington invariably disagree. New Delhi has observed these conflicts from a distance, remaining neutral. It's pertinent to question the sustainability of India's stance: can it simultaneously maintain close ties with two nations whose foreign policies often undermine one another? Narendra Modi believes it can. In an interview with CNN earlier this year, his only one since taking office, Modi explained his view of the evolving world order. 'If you observe closely, every country seeks to build relationships with others,' he stated. 'They may belong to one bloc, but also engage with staunch opponents.' When questioned specifically about Russia's annexation of Crimea, an action New Delhi declined to condemn, Modi responded, 'Currently, many globally are offering advice. However, examine them closely, and they too have their own transgressions.' The comment could be interpreted as a subtle critique of Washington's foreign policy errors. However, Modi's intention wasn't to reprimand the U.S., but to suggest that all nations possess distinct value systems and perceived shortcomings. India navigates these global players by fostering friendships and creating opportunities. The underlying theme is economics. Modi's extensive travels during his initial months in office – to Rio, New York, Tokyo, Sydney – were primarily driven by a desire to attract business to India, rather than to assume a foreign policy leadership role. Therefore, as you follow Vladimir Putin's state visit to New Delhi this week, focus on the tangible outcomes and agreements reached, rather than the rhetoric. Russia is the world's second-largest arms exporter, while India is the largest importer. Russia is also a major oil and gas producer, and India is a major consumer. This symbiotic relationship sustains both nations, ensuring their continued cooperation, with the United States observing.

article_content: Heather Watson, Britain's top-ranked female tennis player, experienced a setback at the Baku Cup, falling to Kristina Mladenovic of France in the opening round. Despite being seeded seventh in the Azerbaijan tournament, Watson struggled, particularly with her serve, as Mladenovic broke her serve seven times throughout the match. This marked Watson's first appearance on the court since her defeat against Angelique Kerber at Wimbledon. However, the return proved challenging for the 22-year-old, who currently holds the 57th position in the world rankings, as she succumbed to a 6-2, 3-6, 6-0 loss. Mladenovic quickly gained the upper hand, establishing a 3-0 lead early in the first set. The unseeded French player, who recently reached the semi-finals in Istanbul, secured another break to claim the set. Although Watson managed to level the match by winning the second set, which featured numerous service breaks, Mladenovic ultimately dominated the final set, breaking Watson's serve three more times to seal the victory. Despite past successes against Mladenovic, including two wins in their previous four encounters, Watson couldn't replicate that form this time. Watson has faced challenges with injuries and glandular fever in recent years. However, she has demonstrated resilience with a notable comeback in 2014, highlighted by her triumph at the WTA Prague tournament, which contributed to her rise to 57th in the world rankings.

article_content: Authorities are seeking public assistance to find two kidnapped Tennessee girls and Adam Mayes, the man accused of their abduction and the murders of their mother and sister. The FBI has added Mayes to its '10 Most Wanted' list, supplementing the reward for information with $100,000. Mayes is charged with the murders of Jo Ann Bain and her eldest daughter, Adrienne, which occurred in late April. Law enforcement believes he is still holding Bain's younger daughters, Alexandria, 12, and Kyliyah, 8. 'From an investigative perspective, we strongly believe that Adam Mayes is somewhere out there with these two young children,' stated Mark Gwyn, Director of the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation. 'Public cooperation is crucial to bring these children home and apprehend Mayes.' The search is currently concentrated around Guntown, Mississippi, where the bodies of the mother and daughter were discovered over the weekend. 'Our investigation is focused on hunting down Adam Mayes and rescuing the two girls,' stated Aaron Ford, the Special Agent in Charge of the FBI's Memphis office. He urged Mayes to leave the girls in a safe place, such as a police station, church, or hospital, 'and then surrender peacefully.' The federal reward increases the total reward for information leading to Mayes' arrest to $175,000, according to Ford. Mayes' wife, Teresa Mayes, and his mother, Mary Frances Mayes, are in custody, while Adam Mayes remains at large, evading numerous law enforcement agencies and searchers. Court documents reveal the kidnapping involved the killing of the mother and older sister. Adam and Teresa Mayes are each charged with two counts of first-degree murder and two counts of especially aggravated kidnapping. Adam Mayes also faces a charge of making a false report. Teresa Mayes told police that her husband intended to take Alexandria and Kyliyah from their home in Hardeman County, near Memphis. She stated that she was present in the Bains' garage when Adam Mayes killed Jo Ann and Adrienne Bain. Details regarding the time and cause of death have not been released. Investigators stated in affidavits that Adam and Teresa Mayes transported the bodies to Union County in northern Mississippi, where they were found Saturday in a shallow grave behind Adam Mayes' mother's house in Guntown. Mary Frances Mayes faces four counts of conspiracy to commit especially aggravated kidnapping. Authorities describe Mayes as a white male, 6-foot-3, 175 pounds, with blue eyes and brown hair. He recently cut his hair and may have done the same to the missing girls. A convenience store security camera captured Mayes on April 30 with short hair and a goatee. Nick Bargouthi, the clerk, stated that Mayes was a regular customer. 'He bought a Coke and I noticed he cut his hair. He said it was too hot.' He was last seen on May 1 in Guntown. He has connections to Arizona, Texas, Florida, and the Carolinas, according to the FBI. Teresa Mayes' lawyer, Shana Johnson, stated that her client is cooperating with police but would not disclose whether she knows the whereabouts of Adam Mayes or the girls. The Mayes and Bain families are connected through Adam Mayes' sister Pamela, who was previously married to Jo Ann's husband, Gary Bain. Adam and Teresa Mayes have been married for 11 years and lived in Guntown, Johnson said. She has requested a mental health evaluation for her client. Bobbi Booth, Teresa Mayes' sister, described Adam Mayes as 'weird and unusual' and stated that he had been aggressive and untrustworthy. She pleaded with him to release the children. Authorities attempted to interview Mayes shortly after Gary Bain reported his wife and the girls missing on April 27 in Whiteville, Tennessee. However, Mayes fled. Mayes may be using the aliases Christopher Zachery Wylde or Paco Rodrigass, his Facebook profile name, according to the bureau. Ellen Fulghum, a guidance counselor, described a 'dark cloud' over the school and community. 'It's a heaviness. Our hearts are heavy,' she said. 'It's very hard to help children through a grieving process when it is something of this nature.'

Turvakaamera jäädvustas Mayesi 30. aprillil lühikeste juuste ja kitsehabemega. Müüja Nick Bargouthi ütles, et Mayes oli püsiklient. 'Ta ostis Coca-Cola ja ma märkasin, et ta lõikas oma juukseid. Teresa Mayesi advokaat Shana Johnson teatas, et tema klient teeb politseiga koostööd, kuid ei avalikusta, kas ta teab Adam Mayesi või tüdrukute asukohta. Mayesi ja Baini pered on seotud Adam Mayesi õe Pamela kaudu, kes oli varem abielus Jo Ann Baini abikaasa Gary Bainiga. Adam ja Teresa Mayes on olnud abielus 11 aastat ja elanud Guntownis, ütles Johnson. Ta on taotlenud oma kliendile vaimse tervise hindamist. Bobbi Booth, Teresa Mayesi õde, kirjeldas Adam Mayesi kui 'veidrat ja ebatavalist' ning teatas, et ta on olnud agressiivne ja ebausaldusväärne. Ta palus tal lapsed vabastada. Võimud üritasid Mayesiga vestelda vahetult pärast seda, kui Gary Bain teatas oma naise ja tüdrukute kadumisest 27. aprillil Whiteville'is, Tennessee osariigis. Mayes aga põgenes. Mayes võib kasutada varjunimesid Christopher Zachery Wylde või Paco Rodrigass, mis on tema Facebooki profiili nimi, teatas büroo. Ellen Fulghum, koolinõustaja, kirjeldas kooli ja kogukonna kohal olevat 'tumepilve'. 'See on raskus. Meie südamed on rasked,' ütles ta. article_content: From humble beginnings to pop stardom, Dizzee Rascal's journey is truly inspiring. Now, the 24-year-old East London native will share his expertise as a judge on Sky1's 'Must Be The Music', joining Sharleen Spiteri and Jamie Cullum. Dylan Mills, known as Dizzee Rascal, will help discover the UK's next big musical talent. Aspiring musicians from all genres are encouraged to audition for a chance to win a £100,000 prize. Dizzee's fellow musicians are given the chance to show their talents to him and the other judges and the rest of the UK. Dizzee rose to prominence after his debut album 'Boy In Da Corner' won the Mercury Music Prize in 2003. His recent hit, 'Dirtee Disco,' also topped the UK charts, becoming his fourth number one single. Proceeds from his World Cup collaboration with James Corden will benefit Great Ormond Street Hospital. Before fame, he honed his skills on pirate radio and with his former crew, Roll Deep, including Wiley. His debut album, released in 2003, garnered critical acclaim. Dizzee's experience, from overcoming challenges to achieving success, positions him well to advise contestants. He also recorded a World Cup anthem with James Corden. The duo covered Tears for Fears' 'Shout,' and filmed the video at Harlequins' stadium. Simon Cowell orchestrated the track, with royalties benefiting Great Ormond Street Hospital. Other celebrities support the song. Some suggest Dizzee's contribution might surpass John Barnes' rap in the 1990 World In Motion song. The single is available for download.

article_content: Gareth Vaughn, a 59-year-old, tragically died during what was supposed to be an exciting first solo parachute jump. It's believed he suffered a heart attack mid-air. The fatal incident occurred near Durban, South Africa, where he reportedly lost control of his parachute at approximately 1,500 feet, ultimately crashing into a wall. Adding to the horror, Vaughn's wife and son were present and witnessed the devastating event unfold. Police, with assistance from the Parachute Association of South Africa, have initiated a thorough investigation into the circumstances surrounding his death. Vaughn had diligently completed a full day of training, and the jump was organized through a reputable skydiving company. A post-mortem examination is scheduled to definitively determine the precise cause of death. According to reports, fulfilling a long-held dream of skydiving was the impetus behind Vaughn's jump. Doctors at the hospital speculate that a heart attack may have struck him while he was in the air. Both the Durban Skydive Centre and the Parachute Association of South Africa are actively participating in the ongoing inquiry. It is noted that static line parachute jumps, while allowing for quicker solo experiences, inherently carry specific safety risks, as highlighted by the British Parachute Association.

Darren Sweeby was sentenced to two years in jail for orchestrating a parking scam that cost Great Yarmouth Borough Council an estimated £34,000. Three parking wardens were jailed after their scam was exposed, involving switching off pay and display machines and issuing handwritten tickets to holidaymakers. The trio is believed to have stolen £34,000 from visitors to Great Yarmouth, Norfolk, since January 2009.

Norwich Crown Court heard that the men, including a parking supervisor, disabled the machines, told motorists they were out of order, and then issued handwritten tickets, pocketing the money. Parking supervisor Darren Sweeby, 43, and his accomplices, Garry Greensmith, 52, and Antony Crooks, 54, operated in various carparks in Great Yarmouth during bank holidays.

The prosecution stated that the men were discovered after a whistleblower alerted the council, who then observed the trio on CCTV. Sweeby, from Gorleston, who had keys to control the ticket machines, was jailed for two years. Greensmith, from Blundeston, near Lowestoft, Suffolk, received a 12-month sentence. Crooks, from Gorleston, was jailed for four months.

Footage showed Greensmith and Crooks patrolling North Drive car park in Yarmouth in May 2013, while Sweeby was their manager. Greensmith was seen switching off the ticket machine and selling handwritten tickets for cash, alongside Crooks, before reactivating the machine an hour later. They then repeated this at St Nicholas car park. The three were arrested in July 2013, and their computers and mobile phones were seized.

Crooks told police that Sweeby instructed him and Greensmith to act 'when crowds built up on bank holidays,' according to the prosecution. Judge Nicholas Coleman described their actions as 'calculated dishonesty,' stating they 'were expected to protect public revenue, not steal it.' The council believes the scam had been running since January 2009, when Sweeby was promoted. Honest parking wardens have faced increased 'abuse and aggression' from the public who accused them of 'lining their own pockets' following the revelation of the scam.

All three men pleaded guilty to conspiracy to steal. Sweeby's defense lawyer stated he had worked for the council for 14 years, had three young children, and hoped to find work on a wind farm. Crooks's lawyer said he only became involved in 2012, showed genuine remorse, and that the crime was 'out of character' for him. Greensmith's lawyer said he was in poor health and 'remorseful', arguing that Greensmith and Crooks were merely 'footsoldiers' while Sweeby was the 'ringleader'. Judge Nicholas Coleman emphasized that they were all guilty of 'calculated dishonesty'.

He told them: 'You were employed as civil enforcement officers and you were the public face of the local authority. You were expected to protect public revenue, not steal it. You were in positions with a high level of trust.' Great Yarmouth Borough Council stated they had sacked all three wardens and reviewed procedures after the scam. A council spokesman said: 'The borough council welcomes the outcome of this court hearing, which proves that those who conspire to steal from the public cannot escape justice. The borough council always conducts the appropriate checks of anyone it recruits, and takes seriously any breaches of the law and the officers' code of conduct. After the borough council became aware, in June 2013, of potential issues within its parking services operation, officers were suspended pending a full two-month internal investigation, which culminated in dismissal at a disciplinary hearing. The police conducted a separate investigation. The borough council has now tightened up its procedures and training to significantly reduce the risk of this happening again.'

Nähti, kuidas Greensmith lülitas piletiautomaadi välja ja müüs koos Crooksiga sularaha eest käsitsi kirjutatud pileteid, seejärel lülitas tunni aja pärast automaadi uuesti sisse. Seejärel kordasid nad sama tegevust St Nicholas'i parklas. Kolm meest vahistati 2013. aasta juulis ning nende arvutid ja mobiiltelefonid konfiskeeriti.

Crooks tunnistas politseile, et Sweeby käskis tal ja Greensmithil tegutseda 'kui riigipühadel rahvast koguneb', nagu teatas prokuratuur. Kohtunik Nicholas Coleman nimetas nende tegevust 'kalkuleeritud ebaaususeks', öeldes, et 'neilt oodati riigi tulude kaitsmist, mitte nende varastamist'. Linnavolikogu usub, et pettus kestis alates 2009. aasta jaanuarist, kui Sweeby ülendati ametikõrgendusele. Pärast pettuse paljastamist on ausad parkimisvalvurid seisnud silmitsi suurema 'kuritarvitamise ja agressiivsusega' avalikkuse poolt, kes süüdistas neid 'enda taskute täitmises'.

Kõik kolm meest tunnistasid end süüdi vandenõus varguse toimepanemiseks. Sweeby kaitsja märkis, et ta on töötanud linnavolikogus 14 aastat, tal on kolm väikest last ja ta loodab leida tööd tuulepargis. Crooksi advokaat ütles, et ta oli asjaga seotud alles alates 2012. aastast, ta kahetseb siiralt ja see kuritegu oli tema jaoks 'ebatavaline'. Greensmithi advokaat ütles, et ta on kehva tervisega ja 'kahetseb', väites, et Greensmith ja Crooks olid vaid 'käsilased', Sweeby aga 'pealik'. Kohtunik Nicholas Coleman rõhutas, et nad kõik olid süüdi 'kalkuleeritud ebaaususes'.

Ta ütles neile: 'Teid tööle võeti tsiviilkorrakaitseametnikena ja te esindasite kohalikku omavalitsust. Teilt oodati riigi tulude kaitsmist, mitte nende varastamist. Teil oli kõrge usaldusega ametikoht.' Great Yarmouth Borough Council teatas, et nad on pärast pettust vallandanud kõik kolm valvurit ja vaadanud menetlused üle. Linnavolikogu pressiesindaja ütles: 'Linnavolikogu tervitab selle kohtuotsuse tulemust, mis tõestab, et need, kes plaanivad avalikkuselt varastada, ei pääse karistuseta. Linnavolikogu teeb alati asjakohaseid taustakontrolle kõigile uutele töötajatele ja suhtub tõsiselt igasse seaduserikkumisse ning ametnike eetikakoodeksisse. Pärast seda, kui linnavolikogu sai 2013. aasta juunis teadlikuks võimalikest probleemidest oma parkimisteenuste osutamisel, peatati ametnike töö kuni täieliku kahelise sisejuurdluse lõpuni, mis kulmineerus vallandamisega distsiplinaarkomisjoni istungil. Politsei viis läbi eraldi uurimise. Linnavolikogu on nüüd oma menetlusi ja koolitusi karmistanud, et oluliselt vähendada sellise juhtumi kordumise riski.'

article_content: Danny Lopez, CEO of Glasswall, has had a successful international career in banking, marketing, diplomacy, and technology. The headlines surrounding the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on cybersecurity reveal two dominant themes. One concern is that AI could empower threat actors to overcome existing security measures. Some fear a future where networks and data are vulnerable to nation-state adversaries and cybercriminals due to 'bad AI,' which simplifies and amplifies attacks. Additionally, it's enabling individuals without technical expertise to engage in cybercrime, creating new threats. Conversely, many believe AI will significantly enhance cybersecurity as vendors integrate its benefits. In this context, 'good AI' will offer predictive capabilities unmatched by current methods, while automation allows experts to focus on complex issues. The investment community is optimistic about AI-powered cybersecurity, with nearly $6 billion in private AI-focused finance allocated to cybersecurity last year. Most cybersecurity vendors are investing in AI to improve their offerings. The reality likely lies between these extremes. The cybersecurity industry is actively integrating AI. Threat actors are already using AI to advance their objectives. There's a lack of coordination among governments and regulatory bodies on AI-related cybersecurity. Leadership is needed to realize AI's benefits. The global AI Safety Summit at Bletchley Park aimed to establish international coordination. The Bletchley Declaration, signed by 28 countries, commits to AI safety collaboration. Key outcomes included a 'State of the Science' report, AI model testing, and AI safety policy discussions. Proactive, international collaboration is vital to manage AI's risks and opportunities. The implementation of these agreements will test AI governance. A balance of technology, ethics, and regulation is crucial. AI development should follow ethical guidelines to minimize biases and maximize positive outcomes. An international regulatory framework should ensure the secure use of AI in cybersecurity. These regulations should help authorities prevent misuse and protect organizations from AI-powered attacks. Human decision-making remains essential despite increasing automation. Combining AI's data-driven decision-making with human expertise offers a hybrid approach for effective and ethical cybersecurity. To maximize AI's potential in cybersecurity, ongoing dialogue between technologists, policymakers, and ethicists is needed. It is our collective responsibility to ensure that 'good AI' prevails over 'bad AI' in cybersecurity. Forbes Technology Council is an invitation-only community for technology executives.

article_content: It was long thought that the hip bones of whales and dolphins were essentially useless. Scientists have now discovered that, in fact, the opposite is true; they are important for mating. Experts also believe that their shape and size influences a cetacean's sexual attractiveness. Scientists Matthew Dean and Jim Dines discovered that whale and dolphin pelvic bones are important for mating. Both whales and dolphins have pelvic bones, evolutionary remnants from when their ancestors walked on land. Common wisdom held that these bones were simply vestigial. 'Everyone's always assumed that if you gave whales and dolphins a few more million years of evolution, the pelvic bones would disappear. But it appears that's not the case,’ said Matthew Dean. For four years, he and Jim Dines have analysed cetacean pelvic bones. The shape and size of a whale's pelvic bone influences how sexually attractive they are to females. They found that larger testes correlate with larger pelvic bones. Most whale species don't maintain fixed partnerships, and females have several mates each season. Whales use mating calls to attract a partner, and some that travel in pods perform rituals to find a mate. Baleen whales sing unique songs to attract a partner potentially miles away. Sperm whale pods find each other with calls and clicks and battle one another to attract a female. Killer whales develop dialects distinct to pods to locate a suitable mate from outside their own community. The muscles that control a cetacean’s flexible penis attach to its pelvic bones. Scientists theorize that the pelvic bones could affect the level of control over the penis. To test this idea, they examined hundreds of pelvic bones, using a 3D scanner to make digital models to gain detail about their shape and size and to compare them. They then gathered data about testes size relative to whale mass. Promiscuous species where females mate with many males create a competitive mating environment and the males develop larger testes to attract females. Males from more promiscuous species such as dolphins evolve larger penises, so larger pelvic bones appear necessary to attach larger muscles for penis control. Scientists believe that marine animals squeal with delight to express their happiness. Initially, noises emitted by the animals when offered fish treats were thought to signal the presence of food. Whales and dolphins squeal when they hear a whistle associated with a food reward. When dolphins and beluga whales were trained to switch off a sound after making a deep dive, they announced a successful mission by producing the same squeals. It was the equivalent of a human 'whoop' of triumph, according to Dr Sam Ridgway. 'The [squealing] behaviour had transferred over to another stimulus that wasn't food,' he said. To investigate further, Dr Ridgway and his colleagues analysed decades of recordings of experiments. They wanted to understand if the delay before a squeal was mirrored by the release of dopamine. In dolphins, the delay was 151 milliseconds and in beluga whales 250 milliseconds. 'We think we have demonstrated that it [the victory squeal] has emotional content,' said Dr Ridgway. The experts compared the size of pelvic bones to the size of an animal's testes, relative its body size. Males from more promiscuous species also evolve larger penises, so larger pelvic bones appear necessary to attach larger muscles for penis control, they said. 'Our research really changes the way we think about the evolution of whale pelvic bones in particular, but more generally about structures we call vestigial,’ Professor Dean said. ‘As a parallel, we are now learning that our appendix is actually quite important in several immune processes, not a functionally useless structure,’ he added. The duo believe that their new way of measuring and quantifying the complicated 3D structures of bones, could be used to record and study bones held by museums. Last month, scientists found that dolphins squeal with delight to express their happiness and likened it to a human 'whoop' of triumph.
translated_content: Kauaaeti arvati, et vaalade ja delfiinide puusaluud on sisuliselt kasutud. Nüüd on teadlased avastanud, et tegelikult on vastupidi: need on olulised paaritumisel. Eksperdid usuvad ka, et nende kuju ja suurus mõjutavad vaalaliste seksuaalset atraktiivsust. Teadlased Matthew Dean ja Jim Dines avastasid, et vaalade ja delfiinide vaagnaluud on olulised paaritumisel. Nii vaaladel kui ka delfiinidel on vaagnaluud, mis on evolutsioonilised jäänukid ajast, mil nende esivanemad maismaal kõndisid. Üldiselt arvati, et need luud on lihtsalt rudimendid – aegamööda kaduvad, nagu inimestel sabakont. ’Kõik on alati eeldanud, et kui vaaladel ja delfiinidel oleks veel mõni miljon aastat evolutsiooni, siis vaagnaluud kaoksid. Aga paistab, et see pole nii,’ ütles Matthew Dean. Neli aastat on tema ja Jim Dines analüüsinud vaalaliste vaagnaluid. Vaala vaagnaluu kuju ja suurus mõjutavad, kui seksuaalselt atraktiivsed nad emastele on. Nad leidsid, et suuremad munandid on seotud suuremate vaagnaluudega. Enamik vaalaliike ei loo püsivaid paare ja emastel on igal hooajal mitu partnerit. Vaalad kasutavad paaritumiskutseid partneri ligimeelitamiseks ja mõned, kes reisivad parvedes, viivad läbi rituaale partneri leidmiseks. Baleenvaalad laulavad unikaalseid laule, et meelitada partnerit potentsiaalselt miilide kauguselt. Pottvaalaparved leiavad üksteist kutsete ja klõpsudega ning võitlevad omavahel, et emast ligi meelitada. Mõõkvaalad arendavad välja parvedele omased dialektid, et leida sobiv partner väljastpoolt oma kogukonda. Lihased, mis kontrollivad vaalalise painduvat peenist, kinnituvad vaagnaluude külge. Teadlased oletavad, et vaagnaluud võivad mõjutada peenise kontrolli taset. Selle idee testimiseks uurisid nad sadu vaagnaluid, kasutades 3D-skannerit, et teha digitaalseid mudeleid, et saada üksikasjalikku teavet nende kuju ja suuruse kohta ja neid võrrelda. Seejärel kogusid nad andmeid munandite suuruse kohta, võrreldes neid vaala massiga. Promiskuiitsed liigid, kus emased paarituvad paljude isastega, loovad konkurentsitiheda paaritumiskeskkonna ning isastel arenevad suuremad munandid, et emaseid ligi meelitada. Isastel promiskuiitsetel liikidel, nagu delfiinid, arenevad suuremad peenised, seega on suuremad vaagnaluud vajalikud suuremate lihaste kinnitamiseks peenise kontrollimiseks. Teadlased usuvad, et mereloomad kiljatavad rõõmust, et väljendada oma õnne. Esialgu arvati, et loomade poolt kalatoitude pakkumisel tekitatud helid olid signaalid, mis andsid märku toidu olemasolust. Vaalad ja delfiinid kiljatavad, kui nad kuulevad toiduga seotud vilet. Kui delfiine ja beluugasid õpetati pärast sügavsukeldumist heli välja lülitama, teatasid nad edukast missioonist samade kiljatustega. See oli samaväärne inimese triumfihüüdega, ütles dr Sam Ridgway. ’[Kiljatamise] käitumine oli üle kandunud teisele stiimulile, mis ei olnud toit,’ ütles ta. Edasiseks uurimiseks analüüsisid dr Ridgway ja tema kolleegid aastakümnete pikkuseid eksperimentide salvestisi. Nad soovisid mõista, kas kiljatusele eelnev viivitus peegeldab dopamiini vabanemist. Delfiinidel oli viivitus 151 millisekundit ja beluugadel 250 millisekundit. ’Me arvame, et oleme tõestanud, et sellel [võidukiljul] on emotsionaalne sisu,’ ütles dr Ridgway. Eksperdid võrdlesid vaagnaluude suurust looma munandite suurusega, suhteliselt selle keha suurusega. Isastel promiskuiitsetel liikidel arenevad ka suuremad peenised, seega on suuremad vaagnaluud vajalikud suuremate lihaste kinnitamiseks peenise kontrollimiseks, ütlesid nad. ’Meie uuringud muudavad tõesti seda, kuidas me mõtleme vaalade vaagnaluude evolutsioonile, eriti aga üldisemalt struktuuridele, mida me nimetame rudimentideks,’ ütles professor Dean. ’Paralleelselt õpime praegu, et meie ussripik on tegelikult üsna oluline mitmetes immuunprotsessides, mitte funktsionaalselt kasutu struktuur,’ lisas ta. Teadlased usuvad, et nende uut viisi luude keerukate 3D-struktuuride mõõtmiseks ja kvantifitseerimiseks saaks kasutada muuseumides hoitavate luude salvestamiseks ja uurimiseks. Eelmisel kuul leidsid teadlased, et delfiinid kiljatavad rõõmust, et väljendada oma õnne, ja võrdlesid seda inimese triumfihüüdega.

article_content: Poland's former deputy prime minister, Andrzej Lepper, was found dead in his Warsaw apartment on Thursday, according to a statement from his party. Lepper, aged 57, led Poland's populist Self-Defense Party and served as deputy prime minister from 2006 to 2007 in a coalition government led by the Law and Justice Party. He also held the position of agriculture minister. His party honored him as a 'distinguished politician and statesman' who founded and led both the party and the Trade Union of Farmers' Self-Defense. Lepper first gained national attention in the 1990s by organizing large-scale protests by farmers who were affected by a severe drought and lacked state support, as stated on his party's website. He subsequently formed the trade union and then the party. The party's statement expressed that he had left its members 'suddenly,' leaving behind 'a better world of truth and love, as a true Catholic who believed sincerely and warmly.' The party also stated that his legacy was a vision of a more just world. Lepper's 'third way' politics advocated for an alternative approach to capitalism, 'a socio-economic system that would effectively combine freedom of enterprise with the state's social responsibilities,' according to the party's website. CNN's Bharati Naik contributed to this report.

Ta oli ka põllumajandusminister. Tema erakond austas teda kui 'silmapaistvat poliitikut ja riigimeest', kes asutas ja juhtis nii erakonda kui ka Põllumeeste Enesekaitse Ametiühingut. Lepper pälvis esmakordselt üleriigilist tähelepanu 1990. aastatel, korraldades ulatuslikke proteste põllumeeste poolt, keda mõjutas ränk põud ja kellel puudus riigi toetus, nagu on öeldud tema erakonna veebisaidil. Seejärel moodustas ta ametiühingu ja seejärel erakonna. Erakonna avalduses öeldi, et ta lahkus oma liikmete juurest 'äkki', jättes maha 'parema tõe ja armastuse maailma, kui tõeline katoliiklane, kes siiralt ja soojalt uskus'. Erakond teatas ka, et tema pärand oli nägemus õiglasemast maailmast. Lepperi 'kolmas tee' poliitika propageeris alternatiivset lähenemist kapitalismile, 'sotsiaal-majanduslikku süsteemi, mis ühendaks tõhusalt ettevõtlusvabaduse riigi sotsiaalse vastutusega', nagu on öeldud erakonna veebisaidil. CNN-i Bharati Naik panustas sellesse raportisse.

article_content: Once a jewel of the ancient world, Babylon, renowned for its majestic walls and the legendary Hanging Gardens, was considered among the Seven Wonders. This city, established roughly 4,000 years ago, served as the capital for ten Mesopotamian dynasties, a region often hailed as one of civilization's original birthplaces and the origin of writing and literature. However, years of looting, neglect, and conflict have diminished its splendor. Recently, Iraqi authorities have welcomed tourists back to Babylon, with aspirations of attracting global visitors. Yet, despite its significant archaeological importance and breathtaking views, Babylon currently sees only a trickle of tourists, drawn by an intriguing blend of ancient relics and more recent history. Located just 85 kilometers (52 miles) south of Baghdad, a drive of approximately two hours contingent on checkpoint delays, the city still bears the scars of clumsy restoration attempts by former Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein, followed by the U.S. military's occupation in 2003. 'They took over Babylon, restricting all access,' recounts Hussein Saheb, a site guard, recalling the arrival of U.S. tanks and the subsequent establishment of their camp. Following early 20th-century excavations, European archaeologists identified prominent artifacts, such as remnants of the renowned Ishtar Gate—a glazed brick entrance adorned with dragon and auroch images, commissioned around 575 BC by King Nebuchadnezzar II as the inner city's eighth gate. The original now resides in Berlin's Pergamon Museum as part of a gate reconstruction, while visitors in Babylon see a replica. Nevertheless, remnants of Babylon's past magnificence persist, with sections of the city walls still standing. According to archaeologists, later excavations and preservation efforts under Saddam's regime significantly damaged the site. Iraqi archaeologist Hai Katth Moussa noted that during a vast reconstruction initiative in the early 1980s, Saddam initiated the construction of a Nebuchadnezzar II palace replica atop the ancient palace's remains. Like Nebuchadnezzar, he inscribed his name on numerous bricks, proclaiming, 'This was built by Saddam, son of Nebuchadnezzar, to glorify Iraq.' After the Gulf War, Saddam began constructing a modern palace for himself, styled as a Sumerian ziggurat, on top of ancient ruins. Upon the arrival of U.S. forces in 2003, they occupied this palace, located near Nebuchadnezzar's palace overlooking the Euphrates River, and left their own traces. Today, a basketball hoop stands in Babylon, and military-left concertina wire now serves to prevent visitors from climbing on a 2,500-year-old lion statue—an age-old symbol of the city. Even in present-day Iraq, Babylon remains vulnerable. Only 2% of the ancient city has been unearthed, but the buried historical treasures face threats from expanding development. Tour guide Hussein Al-Ammari points out that an oil pipeline traverses the eastern part of the ancient city, stating, 'It runs through the outer wall of Babylon.' Despite these preservation challenges, Babylon still attracts a modest number of Iraqi visitors, even if only to explore Saddam's marble-clad palaces, which remain a novelty a decade after his fall from power. Zained Mohammed, visiting from Karbala with her family for the first time, told CNN, 'We simply sought a change of scenery, wanting the children to experience something different.' Babylon undoubtedly provides that.
translated_content: Kunagi oli Babülon iidse maailma pärl, tuntud oma majesteetlike müüride ja legendaarsete rippuvate aedade poolest, mida peeti seitsme maailmaime hulka. See linn, mis asutati umbes 4000 aastat tagasi, oli kümne Mesopotaamia dünastia pealinn, piirkonda, mida sageli nimetatakse tsivilisatsiooni hälliks ning kirjutamise ja kirjanduse alguseks. Kuid aastatepikkune rüüstamine, hooletussejätmine ja konfliktid on selle hiilgust vähendanud. Hiljuti on Iraagi võimud taas turiste Babüloni tervitanud, soovides meelitada ligi ülemaailmseid külastajaid. Kuid vaatamata selle märkimisväärsele arheoloogilisele tähtsusele ja hingematvatele vaadetele näeb Babülon praegu vaid vähest turistide hulka, keda köidab intrigeeriv segu iidsetest säilmetest ja hilisemast ajaloost. Asub vaid 85 kilomeetrit (52 miili) Bagdadist lõuna pool, umbes kahetunnise autosõidu kaugusel, mis sõltub kontrollpunktide viivitustest, kannab linn endiselt endise Iraagi juhi Saddam Husseini kohmakate taastamiskatsete ja seejärel USA sõjaväe okupatsiooni jälgi 2003. aastal. 'Nad võtsid Babüloni üle, piirates igasuguse juurdepääsu,' jutustab Hussein Saheb, kohapealne valvur, meenutades USA tankide saabumist ja nende laagri hilisemat rajamist. Pärast 20. sajandi alguse väljakaevamisi tuvastasid Euroopa arheoloogid silmapaistvaid artefakte, nagu näiteks kuulsa Ištari värava jäänused – glasuuritud tellistest sissepääs, mis oli kaunistatud draakoni ja uroksi kujutistega ning mille kuningas Nebukadnetsar II lasi umbes 575 eKr ehitada siselinna kaheksanda väravana. Originaal asub nüüd Berliini Pergamoni muuseumis osana värava rekonstruktsioonist, samas kui Babüloni külastajad näevad koopiat. Sellegipoolest on Babüloni mineviku suursugususest säilinud jäänuseid, kusjuures osa linna müüre on veel püsti. Arheoloogide sõnul kahjustasid hilisemad väljakaevamised ja säilitustööd Saddami režiimi ajal paika oluliselt. Iraagi arheoloog Hai Katth Moussa märkis, et 1980. aastate alguses Saddami ulatusliku taastamisprojekti käigus algatas Saddam Nebukadnetsar II palee koopia ehitamise iidse palee jäänuste peale. Nagu Nebukadnetsar, kirjutas ta oma nime paljudele tellistele, kuulutades: 'Selle ehitas Saddam, Nebukadnetsari poeg, et austada Iraaki.' Pärast Lahesõda hakkas Saddam ehitama endale moodsat paleed, mis oli kujundatud Sumeri tsikuraadina, iidsete varemete peale. Kui USA väed 2003. aastal saabusid, hõivasid nad selle palee, mis asub Nebukadnetsari palee lähedal Eufrati jõe ääres, ja jätsid endast maha jälgi. Tänapäeval seisab Babülonis korvpallirõngas ja sõjaväe maha jäetud okastraat takistab külastajaid 2500 aasta vanuse lõviskulptuuri otsa ronimast – see on linna iidne sümbol. Isegi tänapäeva Iraagis on Babülon endiselt haavatav. Vaid 2% iidsest linnast on välja kaevatud, kuid maetud ajaloolisi aardeid ähvardab laienev areng. Reisijuht Hussein Al-Ammari juhib tähelepanu sellele, et naftajuhe läbib iidse linna idaosa, öeldes: 'See läbib Babüloni välismüüri.' Vaatamata nendele säilitamisprobleemidele meelitab Babülon siiski ligi tagasihoidliku hulga Iraagi külastajaid, isegi kui ainult selleks, et uurida Saddami marmorkattega paleesid, mis on kümmekond aastat pärast tema võimult kukutamist endiselt uudiseks. Zained Mohammed, kes külastas oma perega esimest korda Karbalast, ütles CNN-ile: 'Me otsisime lihtsalt vaheldust, soovides, et lapsed näeksid midagi muud.' Babülon seda kahtlemata pakub.

article_content: In Arkansas, a 12-year-old named Kali Hardig is in critical condition, battling a very rare and aggressive brain-eating amoeba. She contracted the infection while swimming at Willow Springs Water Park, located near Little Rock. Sadly, this is the second instance in three years of someone contracting primary amoebic meningoencephalitis after swimming in the lake at Willow Springs Water Park. Since 1962, when the Centers for Disease Control started monitoring, only two individuals worldwide have survived this incredibly rare Naegleria infection. Kali's loved ones are fervently hoping that she will become the third. This devastating condition arises when the Naegleria parasite invades the brain. Typically, this happens when a person accidentally inhales warm, stagnant water through their nose while swimming. According to Ed Barham, a spokesman for the Arkansas Department of Health, the water needs to be forcefully pushed into the nose, such as when diving, being dunked, or using a water slide. Naegleria amoebas are common in almost all freshwater sources, even lakes. However, they only become active when the water temperature rises. Ironically, the risk of infection is highest when people seek relief from the heat by swimming. Kali's mother reports that her condition is improving at Arkansas Children's Hospital, and despite the long odds, her family remains optimistic about her recovery. Following the report of the second case of this deadly disease in three years, the owners of Willow Springs Water Park have decided to close the lake. Primary amoebic meningoencephalitis is both extremely rare and devastating. It's caused by an amoeba that attaches itself to the victim's brain, generally when contaminated water is forced up the nose. The amoeba needs very specific conditions to thrive, preferring the sediment at the bottom of warm, still water, with peak activity around 85 degrees Fahrenheit. For the parasite to reach dangerous levels, the water needs to be relatively warm. Over the past 50 years, health officials have documented only 128 cases of this disease in the United States. Only one person in the U.S. has survived, with another survivor found in Mexico. Health experts suggest swimmers can further reduce their risk by using nose plugs. The CDC reports 128 cases of the disease in the U.S. in the last five decades, highlighting its rarity given the number of Americans who swim in lakes and ponds each summer. The amoebas thrive when water temperatures hit around 85 degrees, according to Barham. Tragically, this isn't the first time this parasite has affected a swimmer at Willow Springs Water Park. In August 2010, 7-year-old Davian Briggs passed away after contracting the disease from swimming in the lake. Because of the two cases linked to the same body of water, state health officials requested the park's closure, which the owners complied with. 'While the chances of contracting Naegleria are very small, they aren't good enough for us to allow our friends or family to swim,' said park owners David and Lou Ann Ratliff. The park, which usually hosts up to 250 swimmers daily and thousands throughout the summer, is considering installing a hard pool bottom and using chlorinated water from Little Rock. Kali's mother, Traci Harding, stated she was unaware of the risks of swimming in warm lakes and had never heard of the disease. She said, 'As parents, you can still take your children swimming. We don't want to frighten anyone, but we want you to know there are precautions you can take to help them, so they can still enjoy being kids.' She advises parents to have their children wear nose plugs while swimming to lower the risk of water entering the nose and contracting the Naegleria parasite. Still, Barham from the health department maintains that swimmers should not be overly concerned. The U.S. has recorded just 128 cases of Naegleria fowleri infections in the past 50 years. Another sorrowful event: Davian Briggs, 7, died from the disease in 2010 after swimming at Willow Springs Water Park, where Kali is believed to have been infected.
translated_content: Arkansas'is on 12-aastane Kali Hardig kriitilises seisundis, võideldes väga haruldase ja agressiivse ajusööja amööbiga. Ta sai nakkuse ujumise ajal Little Rocki lähedal asuvas Willow Springsi veepargis. Kahjuks on see kolme aasta jooksul teine juhtum, kus keegi on nakatunud primaarse amööbilise meningoentsefaliidiga pärast Willow Springsi veepargi järves ujumist. Alates 1962. aastast, kui Haiguste Kontrolli ja Ennetamise Keskused (CDC) hakkasid seiret tegema, on maailmas selle äärmiselt haruldase Naegleria nakkuse üle elanud vaid kaks inimest. Kali lähedased loodavad südamest, et temast saab kolmas. See laastav seisund tekib siis, kui Naegleria parasiit tungib ajju. Tavaliselt juhtub see siis, kui inimene ujumise ajal kogemata sooja, seisva vee nina kaudu sisse hingab. Arkansase tervishoiuministeeriumi pressiesindaja Ed Barhami sõnul peab vesi jõuliselt ninna suruma, näiteks sukeldumisel, vee alla surumisel või veeliumäel sõites. Naegleria amööbid on levinud peaaegu kõikides mageveeallikates, isegi järvedes. Kuid nad muutuvad aktiivseks alles siis, kui vee temperatuur tõuseb. Irooniliselt on nakkusoht kõige suurem siis, kui inimesed otsivad kuumuse eest leevendust ujumisega. Kali ema teatab, et tema seisund Arkansase lastehaiglas paraneb ja hoolimata kasinast paranemislootusest jääb tema perekond optimistlikuks. Pärast teadet teisest surmavast haigusjuhtumist kolme aasta jooksul on Willow Springsi veepargi omanikud otsustanud järve sulgeda. Primaarne amööbiline meningoentsefaliit on nii äärmiselt haruldane kui ka laastav. Seda põhjustab amööb, mis kinnitub ohvri ajju, tavaliselt siis, kui saastunud vesi surutakse ninna. Amööb vajab arenemiseks väga spetsiifilisi tingimusi, eelistades sooja, seisva vee põhjasetteid, kusjuures tippaktiivsus on umbes 29 kraadi Celsiuse järgi. Parasiidi ohtliku taseme saavutamiseks peab vesi olema suhteliselt soe. Viimase 50 aasta jooksul on tervishoiuametnikud registreerinud Ameerika Ühendriikides vaid 128 seda haigusjuhtumit. Üks inimene on USAs ellu jäänud, teine ellujääja leiti Mehhikost. Terviseeksperdid soovitavad ujujatel riski veelgi vähendada nina korkide abil. CDC andmetel on USAs viimase viiekümne aasta jooksul teatatud 128 haigusjuhtumist, mis rõhutab selle haruldust, arvestades ameeriklaste arvu, kes igal suvel järvedes ja tiikides ujuvad. Barhami sõnul arenevad amööbid kõige paremini siis, kui vee temperatuur jõuab umbes 29 kraadini. Traagiliselt pole see esimene kord, kui see parasiit on Willow Springsi veepargis ujujat mõjutanud. 2010. aasta augustis suri 7-aastane Davian Briggs pärast seda, kui ta järves ujumas käies sellesse haigusesse nakatus. Kuna kaks juhtumit on seotud sama veekoguga, palusid riigi tervishoiuametnikud pargi sulgeda, millega omanikud nõustusid. 'Kuigi Naegleriasse nakatumise võimalused on väga väikesed, pole need piisavalt head, et lubada meie sõpradel või pereliikmetel ujuda,' ütlesid pargi omanikud David ja Lou Ann Ratliff. Park, kus tavaliselt käib päevas kuni 250 ujujat ja suve jooksul tuhandeid, kaalub kõva basseini põhja paigaldamist ja Little Rockist klooritud vee kasutamist. Kali ema Traci Harding teatas, et ta ei olnud teadlik soojades järvedes ujumise riskidest ja polnud sellest haigusest kunagi kuulnud. Ta ütles: 'Vanematena saate oma lapsi ikka ujuma viia. Me ei taha kedagi hirmutada, kuid me tahame, et te teaksite, et on olemas ettevaatusabinõud, mida saate laste abistamiseks võtta, et nad saaksid ikka lapsed olla.' Ta soovitab vanematel panna oma lastel ujumise ajal nina korke kandma, et vähendada vee sattumise ohtu nina kaudu ja Naegleria parasiidiga nakatumist. Sellegipoolest kinnitab tervishoiuameti Barham, et ujujad ei tohiks liiga palju muretseda. USA-s on viimase 50 aasta jooksul registreeritud vaid 128 Naegleria fowleri nakkuse juhtumit. Teine kurb sündmus: 7-aastane Davian Briggs suri sellesse haigusesse 2010. aastal pärast Little Rocki Willow Springsi veepargis ujumist, kus arvatakse, et Kali nakatus.

article_content: The Education Secretary, Nicky Morgan, is set to announce a £5 million investment. This funding aims to assist state schools in providing a range of enrichment activities. These encompass debating competitions, sports coaching, theatre productions, and even music lessons. Secretary Morgan will emphasize today that all schools should prioritize activities that build character, alongside the standard academic curriculum. This £5 million fund is specifically designed to enable state schools to offer these opportunities. The primary goal of this initiative is to give state school students the values and personal qualities they need to thrive professionally. It also seeks to level the playing field with students from private schools. Mrs. Morgan intends to expand upon the existing school curriculum reforms. Her aim is to ensure students receive a well-rounded education and cultivate a broader skill set. Schools will be actively encouraged to provide debating, sports, drama, and other clubs during lunch breaks and after school. This is intended to foster attributes such as resilience, perseverance, and teamwork. The government is already promoting the idea of longer school days. This would allow students more time to engage in extracurricular activities and complete their homework with supervision. Today, Mrs. Morgan will be hosting a roundtable discussion. Key figures from the business sector and various charities will attend to explore how schools can better develop a student's character. She will also highlight state schools that already excel in character education. One example is Outwood Academy Portland in Worksop, Nottinghamshire, which provides over 100 after-school classes, from additional English and maths to an orchestra, choir, and debating club. This school has made a significant turnaround. Having been among the worst in the country just two years ago, it now holds an ‘outstanding’ rating from Ofsted. Dr. Phillip Smith, the principal, credits this success to the introduction of a wide array of extracurricular activities. Additionally, School 21, a free school located in Newham, East London, focuses on 21 qualities considered essential for student success. They offer leadership and debating classes to boost students’ assertiveness and public speaking abilities. With a challenging new curriculum being implemented this academic year, Mrs. Morgan wants to underscore the vital role schools play: providing students with a broader range of skills and characteristics. Announcing the £5 million fund, Mrs. Morgan stated, 'Our educational strategy is designed to ensure that all young people are well-prepared for life in modern Britain. This means not only acquiring core academic knowledge but also developing the values and attributes necessary for success in employment, further education, and life in general.' 'Therefore, I want all children to have access to activities that promote character and resilience, both inside and outside the classroom.' 'Whether it's the teamwork and resilience learned from playing sports, the dedication required to master a musical instrument, or the confidence gained on stage, this fund will guarantee that every child has the chance to receive a comprehensive and balanced education.' Mrs. Morgan's predecessor, Michael Gove, expressed a similar desire earlier this year. He wanted debating, orchestra, and drama clubs to be available in state schools, just like they are in private schools. The fund will primarily target schools in disadvantaged areas. It will also support career and mentoring programs, which are believed to aid children in their transition to adulthood. Mr. Gove had previously articulated a vision to elevate state school standards to match those of private schools. This includes the breadth of extracurricular activities offered. In a speech earlier this year, Mr. Gove said, 'I want state schools in England to be the best globally.' 'State schools where most students have the grades and skills to attend university, if they choose to; where a state school student's acceptance to Oxbridge is commonplace, not exceptional; where state school students routinely enjoy excellent extracurricular activities like sports, orchestras, cadets, choir, drama, debating, and the Duke of Edinburgh's scheme.' 'These opportunities are standard in the private sector – why shouldn't state school students also benefit?' A subsequent report from a cross-party parliamentary group stressed that British schools must be 'more than just exam factories.' It argued that schools should prioritize nurturing pupils’ self-belief, perseverance, and ability to recover from setbacks as part of their 'core mission.' Among the attendees at today’s roundtable is Baroness Sue Campbell, chair of the Youth Sport Trust. She said, 'I firmly believe that high-quality physical education and school sport can significantly contribute to developing resilience in young people.' 'At the Youth Sport Trust, we use the power of sport to enhance young people’s confidence and self-esteem, which are essential for success in academics, employment, and throughout life.' 'I hope today’s discussion recognizes the crucial role of PE and sport in fostering these skills.'
translated_content: Haridusminister Nicky Morgan plaanib teatavaks teha 5 miljoni naelsterlingi suuruse investeeringu. Selle rahastuse eesmärk on aidata riigikoolidel pakkuda mitmesuguseid rikastavaid tegevusi, nagu näiteks väitlusvõistlusi, sporditreeninguid, teatrietendusi ja isegi muusikatunde. Minister Morgan rõhutab täna, et kõik koolid peaksid seadma prioriteediks iseloomu arendavad tegevused lisaks tavapärasele akadeemilisele õppekavale. See 5 miljoni naelsterlingi suurune fond on spetsiaalselt mõeldud selleks, et riigikoolid saaksid neid tegevusi pakkuda. Selle algatuse peamine eesmärk on anda riigikoolide õpilastele vajalikud väärtused ja isikuomadused, et nad saaksid edukalt tööturul hakkama. Samuti püütakse sellega võrdsustada võimalusi erakoolide õpilastega. Proua Morgan kavatseb laiendada olemasolevaid kooli õppekava reforme, et tagada õpilastele mitmekülgne haridus ja arendada nende oskusi. Koole julgustatakse pakkuma väitlusringe, spordiklubisid, draama- ja muid huviringe nii lõunaajal kui ka pärast tunde, et edendada selliseid omadusi nagu vastupidavus, visadus ja meeskonnatöö. Valitsus juba soosib pikemate koolipäevade ideed, mis annaks õpilastele rohkem aega osaleda õppekavavälistes tegevustes ja teha kodutöid järelevalve all. Täna juhib proua Morgan ümarlauda, kus osalevad ärisektori ja heategevusorganisatsioonide esindajad, et arutada, kuidas koolid saaksid paremini õpilaste iseloomu arendada. Ta toob esile ka riigikoolid, mis juba paistavad silma iseloomuarendusega. Näiteks Outwood Academy Portland Worksopis, Nottinghamshire'is, pakub üle 100 huviringi pärast tunde, alates lisa-inglise keelest ja matemaatikast kuni orkestri, koori ja väitlusklubini. See kool on teinud läbi märkimisväärse muutuse. Olles vaid paar aastat tagasi riigi üks halvemaid koole, on see nüüd saanud Ofstedilt hinnangu „silmapaistev”. Direktor dr Phillip Smith omistab selle edu mitmekülgsete õppekavaväliste tegevuste pakkumisele. Lisaks keskendub School 21, tasuta kool Newhamis, Ida-Londonis, 21 omadusele, mida peetakse õpilaste eduks hädavajalikuks. Nad pakuvad juhtimis- ja väitlustunde, et suurendada õpilaste enesekehtestamis- ja avaliku esinemise oskusi. Kuna sel õppeaastal rakendatakse uut ja väljakutsuvat õppekava, soovib proua Morgan nüüd rõhutada koolide olulist rolli õpilaste laiemate oskuste ja omaduste arendamisel. 5 miljoni naelsterlingi suuruse fondi väljakuulutamisel ütles proua Morgan: „Meie haridusstrateegia eesmärk on tagada, et kõik noored oleksid hästi ette valmistatud eluks tänapäeva Suurbritannias. See tähendab mitte ainult akadeemiliste teadmiste omandamist, vaid ka selliste väärtuste ja omaduste arendamist, mis on vajalikud edu saavutamiseks nii tööhõives, edasiõppimisel kui ka üldiselt elus. „Seetõttu soovin, et kõik lapsed saaksid osa tegevustest, mis edendavad iseloomu ja vastupidavust nii klassiruumis kui ka väljaspool seda.” „Olgu selleks siis meeskonnatöö ja vastupidavus, mida õpitakse sportides, pühendumus, mida on vaja muusikainstrumendi valdamiseks, või enesekindlus, mida saadakse laval – see fond tagab, et igal lapsel on võimalus saada mitmekülgne ja tasakaalustatud haridus.” Proua Morgani eelkäija Michael Gove väljendas sel aastal sarnast soovi. Ta soovis, et väitlus-, orkestri- ja draamahuviringid oleksid kättesaadavad ka riigikoolides, nagu need on erakoolides. Fond on suunatud peamiselt ebasoodsas olukorras olevate piirkondade koolidele. Samuti toetatakse karjääri- ja mentorlusprogramme, mille eesmärk on aidata noortel täiskasvanuellu sujuvamalt üle minna. Härra Gove oli varem väljendanud visiooni tõsta riigikoolide taset erakoolide tasemele, sealhulgas õppekavaväliste tegevuste osas. Oma selleaastases kõnes ütles härra Gove: „Ma tahan, et Inglismaa riigikoolid oleksid maailma parimad.” „Riigikoolid, kus enamikul õpilastel on hinded ja oskused, et soovi korral ülikooli astuda; kus riigikooli õpilase vastuvõtmine Oxfordi või Cambridge'i ülikooli on tavaline, mitte erand; kus riigikooli õpilased saavad osa suurepärastest õppekavavälistest tegevustest, nagu sport, orkestrid, noorkotkad, koor, draama, väitlus ja Edinburghi hertsogi auhinnaprogramm.” „Need võimalused on erasektoris tavalised – miks ei peaks riigikooli õpilased sellest kasu saama?” Parlamendierakondade ühise komisjoni hiljutises raportis rõhutati, et Briti koolid peavad olema „rohkem kui lihtsalt eksamivabrikud”. Raportis väideti, et koolid peaksid seadma prioriteediks õpilaste eneseusu, visaduse ja oskuse tagasilöökidest taastuda, pidades seda oma „põhiülesandeks”. Tänasel ümarlaual osaleb teiste seas ka noorte spordifondi esimees paruness Sue Campbell. Ta ütles: „Ma usun kindlalt, et kvaliteetne kehaline kasvatus ja koolisport võivad oluliselt kaasa aidata noorte vastupidavuse arendamisele.” „Noorte spordifondis kasutame spordi jõudu, et suurendada noorte enesekindlust ja enesehinnangut, mis on olulised edu saavutamiseks akadeemilises elus, tööhõives ja kogu elu jooksul.” „Ma loodan, et tänasel arutelul tunnustatakse kehalise kasvatuse ja spordi olulist rolli nende oskuste arendamisel.”

Brown subsequently filed lawsuits against both Macy's and the NYPD, claiming discriminatory practices. While Macy's denied the allegations of racial profiling, they confirmed reaching an agreement with Brown to settle the dispute. The lawsuits highlighted concerns regarding a pattern of alleged racial profiling incidents within Macy's stores.

article_content: To combat rising child obesity, schools in Wales are refusing to give students second portions. As part of these strict mealtime policies, children are being denied extra puddings and, in some cases, offered dry bread to control their appetites. These measures are being implemented as figures indicate that childhood obesity rates in Wales are alarmingly high. Statistics show that a significant percentage of children are overweight or obese when they begin primary school. Additionally, children as young as 14 are receiving gastric bands on the NHS. In Cardiff, children who claim to still be hungry are given dry bread, according to The Daily Telegraph. Latest figures reveal that 22% of children are overweight or obese by the time they start primary school, and hospital treatments for weight-related issues have increased by 400%. Since 2007, 45 teenagers have undergone procedures such as gastric bands, bypasses, or stomach staples, with the youngest patient being 14. Schools currently weigh and measure children in their first and last year of primary school to monitor and address the issue. Current guidelines suggest that primary school pupils under 11 should receive 530 calories per two-course meal, while secondary school students receive 646 calories. The Welsh Government plans to release new guidelines on extra portions in the new year to further address the problem. Over 25% of five-year-olds in Wales are overweight, and 12.5% are classified as obese, a figure higher than the average for England and Wales. A government spokesman stated that while they 'did not want to see their children go hungry', they have issued recommended portion sizes. A BBC Wales survey revealed that Powys Council has banned pudding as a second serving, and Cardiff schools offer only extra bread to hungry students. Russell George, the Conservative Assembly Member for Montgomery, questioned whether children were returning from school hungry due to inadequate portions. A survey indicated that over two-thirds of parents felt portions were too small, 93% wanted their children to have seconds, and 10% stopped using school meals because of portion sizes. Mr. George stated that 'Many older children are complaining they remained hungry following their school meal.'

Cardiffis antakse lastele, kes väidavad, et neil on kõht tühi, kuiva leiba, vastavalt The Daily Telegraphile. Alates 2007. aastast on 45 teismelisele tehtud selliseid protseduure nagu maopaelad, möödaviigud või mao klammerdamine, kusjuures noorim patsient oli 14-aastane. Praegu lapsi kaalutakse ja mõõdetakse algkooli esimesel ja viimasel aastal, et probleemi jälgida ja sellega tegeleda. Hr George ütles, et 'Paljud vanemad lapsed kurdavad, et neil on pärast koolilõunat kõht tühi.'

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) -- Grandparents, retirees, and seniors in need have been waiting for months. Seniors will receive their stimulus payments through the same method as their Social Security benefits. Tens of millions of Social Security beneficiaries will see their bank accounts increase by $250 starting Thursday. The government has begun issuing checks and transferring funds as part of the one-time stimulus from the bill passed in February. These payments are being distributed to nearly 55 million seniors and retirees between now and June 4, with a significant number of checks being mailed this week. 'Approximately half of them will be sent out in the next day or two,' Social Security Commissioner Michael Astrue told CNN on Thursday. The funds will be received in the same manner as regular Social Security or Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments. If someone receives a Social Security check by mail, their $250 stimulus payment will also arrive in the mailbox. With an increasing number of people using direct deposit, many seniors and SSI recipients could see the $250 reflected in their accounts immediately. Social Security and SSI recipients comprise the largest group receiving stimulus money, but railroad retirees and disabled veterans will also receive payments. Agencies that serve these groups will distribute the funds separately. In total, the government estimates that approximately 64 million Americans will receive these one-time stimulus checks this year, at a federal budget cost of $13 billion. This initiative occurs as the Obama administration continues its public relations efforts to demonstrate that the $787 billion stimulus act is stimulating the economy. Astrue noted that these $250 payments are being issued weeks ahead of schedule and represent the largest single stimulus payment to individual Americans. 'This is a moment when some of the initial significant portions of stimulus money are entering the economy,' Astrue stated. Meanwhile, there is considerable debate regarding how stimulus payments will be used during these challenging times. Will these checks have a positive impact on the overall economy? Astrue's agency has requested that seniors email them to share their plans for the $250. He acknowledges that some have indicated they plan to save the money or pay off debts, but he maintains that many responses involve immediate spending. 'We have people saying they will purchase paint, and others saying they will buy furniture,' he said. 'Many of our recipients indicate they will buy clothes or school supplies for their grandchildren.'
translated_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) -- Vanavanemad, pensionärid ja abivajavad eakad on seda kuid oodanud. Eakad saavad oma stiimulmaksed samal viisil nagu oma sotsiaalkindlustushüvitised. Kümned miljonid sotsiaalkindlustuse saajad näevad neljapäevast alates oma pangakontode suurenemist 250 dollari võrra. Valitsus on alustanud tšekkide väljastamist ja raha ülekandmist veebruaris vastu võetud seadusest tuleneva ühekordse stiimulina. Neid makseid jagatakse praegu kuni 4. juunini ligi 55 miljonile eakale ja pensionärile ning märkimisväärne hulk tšekke saadetakse välja sel nädalal. 'Ligikaudu pooled neist saadetakse välja järgmise paari päeva jooksul,' ütles sotsiaalkindlustusameti juht Michael Astrue neljapäeval CNN-ile. Raha laekub samal viisil nagu tavalised sotsiaalkindlustus- või täiendava sissetuleku (SSI) maksed. Kui keegi saab sotsiaalkindlustuse tšeki posti teel, siis 250-dollariline stiimulmakse saabub samuti postkasti. Kuna üha rohkem inimesi kasutab otsekorraldust, võivad paljud eakad ja SSI saajad näha 250 dollarit kohe oma kontodel kajastumas. Sotsiaalkindlustuse ja SSI saajad moodustavad suurima stiimulraha saava grupi, kuid makseid saavad ka raudteepensionärid ja puudega veteranid. Neid gruppe teenindavad asutused jagavad raha eraldi. Kokku hindab valitsus, et ligikaudu 64 miljonit ameeriklast saavad sel aastal need ühekordsed stiimultšekid, mille maksumus föderaaleelarvele on 13 miljardit dollarit. See algatus toimub ajal, mil Obama administratsioon jätkab teavitustööd, et näidata, kuidas 787 miljardi dollari suurune stiimulpakett majandust elavdab. Astrue märkis, et neid 250-dollarilisi makseid tehakse nädalaid enne tähtaega ja need on suurim ühekordne stiimulmakse üksikutele ameeriklastele. 'See on hetk, mil esimesed suuremad summad stiimulrahast jõuavad majandusse,' ütles Astrue. Samal ajal arutletakse selle üle, kuidas stiimulmakseid neil keerulistel aegadel kasutatakse. Kas need tšekid avaldavad positiivset mõju majandusele? Astrue'i amet on palunud eakatel saata neile e-kiri ja jagada, kuidas nad plaanivad 250 dollarit kasutada. Ta möönab, et mõned plaanivad raha säästa või võlad tasuda, kuid samas usub ta, et paljud vastused näitavad, et raha kulutatakse kohe. 'Meil on inimesi, kes ütlevad, et ostavad värvi, ja teised ütlevad, et ostavad mööblit,' ütles ta. 'Paljud meie toetusesaajad ütlevad, et ostavad oma lastelastele riideid või koolitarbeid.'
