article_content: Stoke City star Jermaine Pennant is facing charges after allegedly attacking a woman and crashing his car while intoxicated early this morning. The 29-year-old former England Under-21 international has been charged with drink-driving, driving while disqualified, and driving without insurance following a collision at 5:20 am in Sale between his white BMW and a silver Audi. The driver of the Audi was hospitalized with minor back injuries and later discharged. The incident occurred ten minutes from Pennant's residence in Hale, Cheshire. Pennant is scheduled to appear at Trafford Magistrates' Court on Wednesday, May 9, to address the driving-related charges. Prior to the accident, police arrested Pennant following an allegation of assault at a Manchester nightclub around 3:30 am. He was bailed pending further inquiries into the assault. Pennant's career began with a £2 million signing to Arsenal at age 16. He later played for Liverpool and in Spain. His past includes a sixteen-month driving ban in 2004 and a 30-day jail sentence in 2005 for drink-driving. In the 2005 incident, he initially identified himself as Ashley Cole. Despite stating that his troubled past was behind him after having a child, Trey, Pennant faced further issues, including a split from his fiancee Lara Murphy. He joined Stoke in the 2010-11 season and recently played in a 1-1 draw against Arsenal. Additional past incidents include collapsing on a flight from Spain to Stansted after excessive drinking. His history of off-field issues also includes being banned from driving in 2004 and serving jail time in 2005. Arsenal eventually lost patience with him due to poor time-keeping and lack of discipline. After his conviction in 2005, he returned to Birmingham and even played while wearing an electronic tag. His lawyer, Barry Warburton, stated in court in 2005 that Pennant had a difficult childhood in Nottingham, growing up on 'one of the worst estates' and caring for his siblings after his mother left. Pennant had limited schooling and arrived at Arsenal with poor reading and writing skills, which the club addressed. Comments are currently disabled for legal reasons.

article_content: Why are so many young people fascinated by ancient history? In Rome's Largo Argentina, entire families were observed straining to see into what appeared to be simply a hole in the ground. Rome features numerous historically significant sites, yet this one held particular interest. It houses the remnants of the theater and temple linked to Julius Caesar's assassination. However, it wasn't the ancient general who drew the crowds of children, but rather the cats. These are Rome's celebrated 'gatti di Roma'. Rome's historical ruins provide a sanctuary for feral cats, showcased on postcards and calendars city-wide. The ruins at Largo Argentina are home to an open-air cat sanctuary that appeals to both tourists and local children. Since its excavation in the 1920s, the location has provided food and water for the city's stray cats. Enhanced funding in the 1990s enabled the Torre Argentina Roman Cat Sanctuary to trap, neuter, and return a greater number of cats to their colony. Since 2000, they've conducted approximately 30,000 sterilizations. Consider also Japan's 'cat islands'. Tashirojima, located in Miyagi Prefecture, is widely known as Cat Island. Dogs have been prohibited on Tashirojima for a very long time. The cat population significantly exceeds the human population. Local fishermen care for the island's cats, believing that providing offerings at a cat shrine ensures a bountiful catch. The Manga building, the island's most notable structure, features pointy ears as a tribute to these lucky felines. Ainoshima, another Japanese cat island, is slightly more secluded, reachable by a 20-minute ferry from Shingu port in Fukuoka. A group of cats often gathers near the port, awaiting the arrival of the next fishing boat or ferry. The island is a double attraction for cats, as the rugged terrain of Ainoshima is a well-known birdwatching location. Houtong, a riverside town in Taiwan, accidentally achieved fame for its feline residents. Houtong was once the location of Taiwan's biggest coal mine. The town's population decreased when the mine shut down in the 1990s, after which cats began to arrive. The Houtong Coal Mine Ecological Park was created to highlight the area's mining history. However, most visitors come to photograph approximately 120 cats that freely roam the Cat Village. Kalkan, a Turkish resort on the Turquoise Coast, also has a dedicated cat protection organization. KAPSA, founded in 2008, is a volunteer group consisting of locals and expats. They trap, neuter, provide healthcare, and then release stray cats. Visiting animal lovers often assist and share their photos on the Friends of KAPSA Facebook group. KAPSA depends on donations to feed and care for over a thousand cats during the winter tourist off-season. Photographers can find cats relaxing all over Kalkan, including lounging on towels and enjoying air conditioning in stores. Ernest Hemingway, besides being a renowned drinker, was also a cat lover. The Ernest Hemingway Home and Museum in Key West, Florida, houses antique furniture and art. The house maintains the feeling of Hemingway having just left, even decades after his death in 1961. The 1850s house continues to be home to around 50 polydactyl cats. Hemingway received a six-toed cat named Snowball in the 1930s, and some of Snowball's descendants still reside there.
translated_content: Miks on nii paljud noored inimesed vaimustatud iidsest ajaloost? Roomas Largo Argentina väljakul nähti terveid peresid pingutamas, et näha, mis näis olevat lihtsalt auk maas. Rooma ajaloolised varemed pakuvad varjupaika metsikutele kassidele, keda näidatakse postkaartidel ja kalendrites üle kogu linna. Largo Argentina varemed on koduks vabaõhukasside varjupaigale, mis meeldib nii turistidele kui ka kohalikele lastele. Alates selle väljakaevamisest 1920. aastatel on see koht pakkunud toitu ja vett linna hulkuvatele kassidele. 1990. aastatel võimaldas suurem rahastus Torre Argentina Rooma Kasside Varjupaigal püüda, steriliseerida ja tagasi viia suurem hulk kasse oma kolooniasse. Alates 2000. aastast on nad läbi viinud umbes 30 000 steriliseerimist. Mõelge ka Jaapani 'kassisaartele'. Tashirojima, mis asub Miyagi prefektuuris, on laialdaselt tuntud kui Kassisaar. Koerad on Tashirojimal olnud keelatud väga pikka aega. Kasside populatsioon ületab oluliselt inimeste arvu. Kohalikud kalurid hoolitsevad saare kasside eest, uskudes, et ohvriannetused kasside pühamus tagavad rikkaliku saagi. Manga hoone, saare kõige silmapaistvam ehitis, on kaunistatud teravate kõrvadega, austusavaldusena nendele õnnelikele kassidele. Ainoshima, veel üks Jaapani kassisaar, on veidi eraldatum, sinna pääseb 20-minutilise praamisõiduga Shingu sadamast Fukuokas. Sadama lähedal koguneb sageli grupp kasse, oodates järgmise kalalaeva või praami saabumist. Saar on kassidele topeltatraktiivne, kuna Ainoshima karm maastik on tuntud linnuvaatluskoht. Houtong, Taiwani jõeäärne linn, saavutas kogemata kuulsuse oma kassidest elanike tõttu. Houtong oli kunagi Taiwani suurima söekaevanduse asukoht. Linna elanikkond vähenes, kui kaevandus 1990. aastatel suleti, mille järel hakkasid saabuma kassid. Houtongi Söekaevanduse Ökoloogiline Park loodi selleks, et rõhutada piirkonna kaevandusajalugu. Kuid enamik külastajaid tuleb pildistama umbes 120 kassi, kes vabalt Kassikülas ringi uitavad. Kalkan, Türgi kuurort Türkiissinisel rannikul, omab ka pühendunud kasside kaitseorganisatsiooni. KAPSA, mis asutati 2008. aastal, on vabatahtlik rühmitus, mis koosneb kohalikest ja välismaalastest. Nad püüavad kinni, steriliseerivad, pakuvad tervishoiuteenuseid ja vabastavad seejärel hulkuvad kassid. Loomasõpradest külastajad abistavad sageli ja jagavad oma fotosid Friends of KAPSA Facebooki grupis. KAPSA sõltub annetustest, et toita ja hoolitseda üle tuhande kassi eest talvisel turismi madalhooajal. Fotograafid võivad leida kasse lõõgastumas kõikjal Kalkanis, sealhulgas rätikutel lesimas ja poodides konditsioneeritud õhku nautimas. Ernest Hemingway, lisaks sellele, et oli tuntud joodik, oli ka kassisõber. Ernest Hemingway Kodu ja Muuseum Key Westis, Floridas, sisaldab antiikmööblit ja kunsti. Maja säilitab tunde, et Hemingway on just lahkunud, isegi aastakümneid pärast tema surma 1961. aastal. 1850. aastate maja on jätkuvalt koduks umbes 50 polüdaktilsele kassile. Hemingway sai 1930. aastatel kuue varbaga kassi nimega Snowball ja mõned Snowballi järeltulijad elavad seal siiani.

article_content: David Cameron cautioned that the eurozone's inability to stabilize its currency posed a threat to global economic stability. He warned of an impending economic crisis. Cameron stated that the world was on the verge of another economic disaster. Global stock markets experienced a significant downturn, with leading UK companies on the FTSE 100 losing £64 billion in value – marking the index's most challenging day since the 2009 crisis. The Prime Minister attributed the market instability to the eurozone and the United States, urging them to manage their substantial debts effectively. The FTSE 100 in London declined by almost 5%, ending the day 246.8 points lower at 5041.61. Since July, the index has decreased by 17%, resulting in a loss of approximately £265 billion for prominent British firms. Yesterday’s sell-off was the most significant since March 2009 and ranks as the 24th worst in history. Speaking from New York at a United Nations meeting, Cameron strongly criticized eurozone leaders, asserting that their inaction in supporting the single currency jeopardized the world economy. In a speech to the Canadian parliament, Cameron suggested that other world leaders lacked the resolve to implement deficit reduction strategies similar to his coalition government. Cameron emphasized the urgent need for global leadership to address economic challenges. He highlighted that the eurozone's problems were now so substantial that they threatened the stability of the global economy. He said stalled growth in both Europe and America indicated problems. He noted that unresolved eurozone issues undermined business investment and eroded confidence in both the euro area and the broader global economy. In a television interview, Cameron urged against delaying necessary actions, calling for decisive measures. Cameron advocated for German leader Angela Merkel to pressure the eurozone to accelerate the Greek bailout process and demonstrate a commitment to supporting the single currency. Cameron insisted that eurozone countries needed to act quickly to resolve the crisis, implement agreed measures, and show the determination to ensure the system’s stability. He stated that delaying actions only worsened the problem and prolonged global economic uncertainty. Cameron joined leaders from Australia, Canada, Mexico, Indonesia, and South Korea in urging President Barack Obama, as well as German and French leaders, to take immediate action. In a letter to French President Nicolas Sarkozy, they stressed the need for eurozone governments and institutions to resolve the euro crisis promptly and for all European economies to address debt to prevent wider global economic consequences. The letter also mentioned the US, as the world’s largest economy, had an important role to play in restoring confidence and needed to overcome hurdles in restoring medium-term fiscal sustainability. Downing Street officials denied that Cameron was lecturing, stating that these issues directly affected the UK. George Osborne planned to hold discussions with finance ministers at the International Monetary Fund to address the crisis. Sources indicated that Britain sought evidence of a larger eurozone bailout fund. The sharp decline in London’s FTSE 100 was mirrored globally, and the British pound fell to a one-year low against the U.S. dollar amid doubts about the UK’s economic recovery. Stock markets in Paris and Frankfurt also experienced declines of around 5%. In New York, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell by 3.6%. Christine Lagarde, the head of the IMF, warned that the path to recovery was more challenging than after the collapse of Lehman Brothers and that swift action was essential. Lagarde emphasized the importance of budget cuts worldwide but suggested that excessive austerity could hinder potential growth. Osborne was expected to face pressure in Washington to ease austerity measures. The U.S. Federal Reserve had launched a £250 billion economic rescue operation, 'Operation Twist,' to prevent a recession, but it triggered market panic instead. Louise Cooper, a markets analyst, attributed market fears to the uncertainty surrounding the future, citing potential scenarios such as a Greek default, a banking crisis, or even bank failures.

article_content: In Sudan, a British teacher named Gillian Gibbons received a 15-day prison sentence after a court found her guilty of insulting religion. The case stemmed from an incident where she allowed a teddy bear to be named 'Mohammed', according to reports from British authorities and her legal representative. After serving her sentence, Gibbons is expected to be deported from Sudan, her lawyer told CNN. He expressed strong disappointment with the court's decision and indicated Gibbons intends to appeal. While Gibbons was charged with inciting hatred and showing contempt for religious beliefs, she was not convicted on these counts, according to her lawyer. The British Foreign Office stated that Gibbons, 54, was arrested on Sunday after she tasked her class of 7-year-olds in Khartoum with naming a stuffed animal as part of a school activity. She was charged under Article 125 of Sudan's constitution, which addresses insulting religion and inciting hatred. While the Quran doesn't forbid images of Allah or the Prophet Mohammed, Muslims widely consider such representations offensive. Gibbons appeared subdued as she arrived at the Khartoum courthouse for her hearing on Thursday. She was accompanied by a British Embassy staff member and her defense lawyers. Police heavily guarded the courthouse, restricting access to journalists and even one of her attorneys for a period. The Foreign Office said that Gibbons could have faced up to a year in jail, 40 lashes, or a fine. They also expressed Britain's discontent with the verdict. British Foreign Secretary David Miliband said, 'We are very disappointed that the charges against Gillian Gibbons were not dismissed.' He added, 'Our view remains that this was an innocent misunderstanding by a committed teacher. Our priority is now Ms. Gibbons' welfare, and we will continue to assist her. I've called the Sudanese ambassador, Omer Siddig, to discuss the decision and next steps.' The Foreign Office noted Gibbons will receive credit for the four days she's already been in custody, leaving 11 days remaining on her sentence. Earlier, Miliband met with Siddig in London, expressing concern about the case. He stated, 'I explained that we were very concerned by the case and believed this was an innocent misunderstanding.' Miliband added that the Sudanese ambassador assured him he would relay these concerns to Khartoum and emphasize the respect for Islam in Britain. Outside the courthouse, police prevented journalists and British officials from entering. Some journalists were detained, and a CNN cameraman had his camera confiscated. Riot police were present, but there were no reported protests. Staff from Gibbons' school, Unity High School, including head Robert Boulos, were present but declined to comment. Boulos previously stated he was 'horrified' that the complaint originated from a school staff member, Sarah Khawad, rather than a parent. Gibbons had been working at Unity High School since August, having previously served as a deputy head teacher in Liverpool, England. Boulos said Gibbons used the stuffed animal as a teaching aid for lessons about animals and habitats.

article_content: Tess Dunn, a 23-year-old from Tiptree, Essex, is battling a severe heart ailment. Seeking to stay active, she has embraced pole dancing. At 17, Tess experienced chest pain, leading to the discovery of a hole in her heart. Initially, medical professionals cautioned her that her heart was fragile, suggesting she might not live beyond 30. Doctors advised against traditional sports, fearing sudden movements could be fatal. However, Tess discovered that the controlled motions of pole dancing posed no threat to her heart, making it a safe exercise. Tess, who is set to study music therapy in Cambridge, claims that this unique activity has fortified the muscles around her heart. Next year, she will be the face of the British Heart Foundation, appearing on billboards nationwide. Tess mentions that this newfound passion assists her in confronting her daily health challenges. She explains, 'Since I can't engage in activities like running or jogging, I decided to focus on toning my body.' 'I explored options online and found pole fitness to be the most suitable. It immediately felt right for me, and I enjoy it immensely.' She continues, 'I take breaks when I get too breathless, but I manage two hours each week, which is excellent exercise. I hope to continue this in the future. Despite appearing healthy, I face a serious health issue every day.' Born in the Philippines, Tess had a lung operation as a toddler to remove two-thirds of her right lung after inhaling volcanic ash. Adopted at age three by British parents Val and Chris Dunn, both in their 60s, she experienced breathing problems growing up, initially attributed to asthma. The severity of her condition only surfaced when she collapsed while studying for her A-levels and was urgently taken to London’s Royal Brompton Hospital. Doctors reiterated that sports were too risky because of the potential for fatal sudden movements. Her pulmonary hypertension stems from Eisenmenger syndrome, a heart defect caused by a significant opening between the lower heart chambers. This results in abnormal blood circulation, with blood returning to the lungs instead of circulating through the body. This greatly elevates blood pressure in the pulmonary arteries, straining the heart. Tess recalls her reaction to the diagnosis: 'I felt worried and panicked. I was angry, upset, and thought I was going to die.' 'I fixated on the doctor's warning and feared I wouldn't even reach my 18th birthday, which was rapidly approaching.' The talented musician had to abandon playing the trumpet due to the strain it placed on her, and she was informed that physical exertion could be deadly. She will continually grapple with breathlessness, fatigue, chest discomfort, light-headedness, and leg swelling throughout her life. Yet, she persevered, earning top grades in college and a second-class honors degree in music from Southampton University in 2012. Following a period teaching music in the UK and the Middle East, she plans to pursue music therapy studies in Cambridge. She affirms, 'Now, I concentrate on the future and don’t dwell on the past. Life moves forward.' Tess has not allowed her health to impede her, having already secured a second-class honors degree in music at Southampton University in 2012. She states, 'I've achieved more than others with my condition. I earned a music degree, taught music in Qatar, and am now determined to become a music therapist.' Next year, she will be widely recognized across the UK as the star of the British Heart Foundation’s advertising campaign. Tess, from Tiptree, Essex, states, 'I am very pleased to participate because it is crucial to raise awareness. Many are not well-informed about this condition, and it’s important to demonstrate that individuals with heart conditions can still lead fulfilling lives.' Tess emphasizes, 'Now, I focus on the future and don’t let the past hold me back. Life goes on.'
translated_content: Tess Dunn, 23-aastane naine Tiptree'st Essexist, võitleb tõsise südamehaigusega. Soovides aktiivsena püsida, on ta valinud tantsimise. 17-aastaselt tundis Tess valu rinnus, mis viis südames augu avastamiseni. Alguses hoiatasid arstid, et tema süda on nõrk, vihjates, et ta ei pruugi elada kauem kui 30 aastat. Arstid soovitasid vältida tavalisi spordialasid, kartes, et järsud liigutused võivad olla surmavad. Kuid Tess avastas, et tantsimise kontrollitud liigutused ei ole tema südamele ohtlikud, muutes selle ohutuks treeninguks. Tess, kes plaanib õppida muusikateraapiat Cambridge'is, väidab, et see ainulaadne tegevus on tugevdanud tema südamelihaseid. Järgmisel aastal on ta Briti Südameliidu reklaamnägu, ilmudes reklaamtahvlitel üle kogu riigi. Tess mainib, et see uus kirg aitab tal toime tulla igapäevaste terviseprobleemidega. Ta selgitab: 'Kuna ma ei saa tegeleda selliste tegevustega nagu jooksmine, otsustasin keskenduda oma keha vormis hoidmisele.' 'Ma uurisin veebis võimalusi ja leidsin, et tantsutreening sobib mulle kõige paremini. See tundus kohe õige ja ma naudin seda väga.' Ta jätkab: 'Ma teen pause, kui ma liiga hingeldama hakkan, aga ma jõuan trenni teha kaks tundi nädalas, mis on suurepärane treening. Ma loodan sellega tulevikus jätkata. Kuigi ma näen välja terve, on mul iga päev tõsine terviseprobleem.' Filipiinidel sündinud Tessile tehti väikelapsena kopsuoperatsioon, et eemaldada kaks kolmandikku paremast kopsust pärast vulkaanilise tuha sissehingamist. Kolmeaastaselt adopteerisid ta Briti vanemad Val ja Chris Dunn, mõlemad 60ndates eluaastates. Tal esinesid hingamisprobleemid, mis algselt omistati astmale. Tema seisundi tõsidus ilmnes alles siis, kui ta kukkus kokku A-taseme eksamiteks õppides ja viidi kiiresti Londoni Royal Brompton Hospitali. Arstid kordasid, et tavalised spordialad on liiga riskantsed, kuna on olemas potentsiaalselt surmavad järsud liigutused. Tema pulmonaalne hüpertensioon tuleneb Eisenmengeri sündroomist, südamerikkest, mis on põhjustatud suurest august alumiste südamekambrite vahel. See põhjustab ebanormaalset vereringet, kus veri suundub tagasi kopsudesse, selle asemel, et ringelda kehas. See suurendab oluliselt vererõhku kopsuarterites, koormates südant. Tess meenutab oma reaktsiooni diagnoosile: 'Ma tundsin muret ja paanikat. Ma olin vihane, ärritunud ja ma arvasin, et suren.' 'Ma keskendusin arsti hoiatusele ja kartsin, et ma ei ela isegi oma 18. sünnipäevani, mis oli juba peaaegu käes.' Andekas muusik pidi loobuma trompeti mängimisest, kuna see oli liiga kurnav ja talle öeldi, et füüsiline koormus võib olla surmav. Ta peab kogu oma elu jooksul pidevalt võitlema õhupuuduse, väsimuse, valu rinnus, peapöörituse ja jalgade tursumisega. Sellegipoolest oli ta edukas, saades kolledžis häid hindeid ja teise astme kiitusega kraadi muusikas Southamptoni ülikoolis 2012. aastal. Pärast muusika õpetamist Suurbritannias ja Lähis-Idas plaanib ta õppida muusikateraapiat Cambridge'is. Ta kinnitab: 'Nüüd ma keskendun tulevikule ega mõtle minevikule. Elu läheb edasi.' Tess ei ole lasknud oma tervislikul seisundil end takistada, olles juba saanud teise astme kiitusega kraadi muusikas Southamptoni ülikoolis 2012. aastal. Ta ütleb: 'Ma olen saavutanud rohkem kui teised minu seisundiga. Ma sain muusikakraadi, õpetasin muusikat Kataris ja nüüd olen otsustanud saada muusikaterapeudiks.' Järgmisel aastal tuntakse teda laialdaselt üle kogu Suurbritannia kui Briti Südameliidu reklaamikampaania nägu. Tess Tiptree'st Essexist ütleb: 'Mul on väga hea meel osaleda, sest teadlikkuse tõstmine on väga oluline. Paljud inimesed ei ole selle seisundi kohta hästi informeeritud ja oluline on näidata, et südamehaigustega inimesed saavad ikka veel täisväärtuslikku elu elada.' Tess rõhutab: 'Nüüd ma keskendun tulevikule ega lase minevikul end tagasi hoida. Elu läheb edasi.'

article_content: Colorado-based artist Chris Carlson crafts incredible 3D chalk art, drawing inspiration from beloved 80s arcade games. His vibrant chalk creations revive classics such as Space Invaders, Tetris, and Super Mario, bringing them to life in vivid color. Carlson dedicates as much as 45 hours to each of his meticulously planned artworks, investing days in preparation. Using only chalk, he transforms walls into mind-bending 3D illusions showcasing iconic video games. The 27-year-old artist's passion for art blossomed during a European trip, driving him to hone his skills. Carlson embraces the ephemeral quality of chalk art, valuing its inability to be preserved conventionally. He creates custom 3D chalk drawings for promotional events and frequently receives commissions from major brands. Carlson considers his Space Invaders project his most accomplished work, highlighting its captivating three-dimensional effect. He draws inspiration from the styles of M.C. Escher, Vincent Van Gogh, and Tracy Lee Stum, integrating their influence into his art. Beyond the classics, Carlson also integrates more contemporary games like Minecraft into his chalk creations. Carlson greatly appreciates the unwavering support and constructive feedback he receives from friends and family.

Kasutades ainult kriiti, muudab ta seinad mõistust painutavateks 3D illusioonideks, mis näitavad ikoonilisi videomänge. 27-aastase kunstniku kirg kunsti vastu õitses Euroopa reisil, mis ajendas teda oma oskusi lihvima. Carlson peab oma Space Invadersi projekti oma kõige saavutusrikkamaks tööks, rõhutades selle kütkestavat kolmemõõtmelist efekti. Ta ammutab inspiratsiooni M.C. Carlson hindab väga vankumatut toetust ja konstruktiivset tagasisidet, mida ta saab sõpradelt ja perelt.

article_content: Forget your standard Granny Smiths and Golden Delicious; Paul Barnett cultivates an astounding 250 apple varieties, all on a single tree! This passionate horticulturist has spent over two decades meticulously crafting this incredible 'family tree' in his Chidham garden near Chichester, West Sussex, adding new grafts each winter. Barnett's unique tree showcases both well-known favorites and rare cooking apples, like the 1883 Withington Fillbasket and the 1908 Eady’s Magnum. Inspired by his time at a nursery with numerous apple varieties, Barnett created this space-saving 'family tree' to house a diverse collection. He uses budding in the summer and grafting in the winter to expand his arboreal collection annually. Budding involves inserting a bud from another tree into the bark, while grafting uses a small branch with multiple buds. As time passes, these additions meld with the main tree, producing even more apple types. Barnett’s tree boasts cooking, eating, and cider apples, though only a few of each kind appear each year. He enjoys the vibrant display of colors and sizes the apples provide. The sheer weight of the fruit necessitates propping up branches. Barnett harvests his crop next month, displaying them at horticultural shows. For over 20 years, Barnett has continuously grafted different apple varieties onto his singular tree. He favors the Winter Gem apple for its delightful flavor: crisp, crunchy, and sweet. To enrich his collection, he either purchases fruit from the National Fruit Collection in Kent, which houses around 2,200 of the 6,000 known varieties, or trades with fellow apple enthusiasts. Barnett emphasizes the importance of understanding apple varieties, including when to pick, eat, and store them. He stresses the need to conserve these varieties, safeguarding them against potential future threats like global warming and pesticides. Preserving older varieties allows for crossbreeding, enhancing resistance to these challenges. He also cultivates nine smaller family trees with plums, pears, cherries, and apples, inheriting his horticultural passion from his family. His parents assist with gardening tasks, and his great-grandfather excelled with fruits. This autumn, a particularly large and flavorful apple harvest is anticipated. Richard Capper of Stocks Farm in Suckley, Worcestershire, notes that British apples are exceptionally sweet and colorful this year. Favorable weather and summer heat have boosted the fruits' sugar levels. Stocks Farm expects a yield of nearly 2,000 tons from its 100 acres, gathered by 36 pickers over ten days, for distribution to major supermarkets.
translated_content: Unusta tavalised Granny Smithid ja Golden Deliciousid; Paul Barnett kasvatab hämmastavaid 250 õunasorti, kõik ühel puul! See kirglik aiandushuviline on pühendanud üle kahe aastakümne selle uskumatu 'perepuu' meisterdamisele oma Chidhami aias Chichesteri lähedal, Lääne-Sussexis, lisades igal talvel uusi pookimisi. Barnetti ainulaadne puu esitleb nii tuntud lemmikuid kui ka haruldasi toiduõunu, nagu 1883. aasta Withington Fillbasket ja 1908. aasta Eady's Magnum. Inspireerituna oma ajast lasteaias, kus oli palju õunasorte, lõi Barnett selle ruumisäästliku 'perepuu', et mahutada mitmekesist kollektsiooni. Ta kasutab suviti pookimist ja talvel jätkamist, et oma puukollektsiooni igal aastal laiendada. Pookimine hõlmab punga sisestamist teiselt puult koore alla, samas kui jätkamine kasutab väikest oksa, millel on mitu punga. Aja jooksul need lisandused sulanduvad põhipuuga, tootes veelgi rohkem õunatüüpe. Barnetti puul kasvavad nii toidu-, laua- kui ka siidriõunad, kuigi igat sorti saab igal aastal vaid mõne. Talle meeldib õunte värvide ja suuruste elav väljapanek. Puuviljade suur kaal nõuab okste toestamist. Barnett koristab oma ainulaadse saagi järgmisel kuul, eksponeerides neid aiandusnäitustel. Üle 20 aasta on Barnett pidevalt pookinud oma ühele puule erinevaid õunasorte. Ta eelistab Winter Gem õuna selle suurepärase maitse tõttu: krõbe, mahlane ja magus. Oma kollektsiooni täiendamiseks ostab ta kas puuvilju Kenti riiklikust puuviljakollektsioonist, kus on umbes 2200 teadaolevast 6000 sordist, või vahetab neid teiste õunahuvilistega. Barnett rõhutab õunasortide tundmise tähtsust, sealhulgas millal neid korjata, süüa ja säilitada. Ta rõhutab vajadust neid sorte säilitada, kaitstes neid võimalike tulevaste ohtude, nagu kliimamuutused ja pestitsiidid, eest. Vanemate sortide säilitamine võimaldab ristamist, suurendades vastupanuvõimet sellistele ohtudele. Ta kasvatab ka üheksat väiksemat perepuud ploomide, pirnide, kirsside ja õuntega, olles pärinud aianduskire oma perekonnalt. Tema vanemad aitavad aiandustöödes ja tema vanavanaisa oli eriti vilunud puuviljakasvatuses. Sel sügisel on oodata eriti rikkalikku ja maitseküllast õunasaaki. Richard Capper Stocks Farmist Suckleys, Worcestershire'is, märgib, et Briti õunad on sel aastal erakordselt magusad ja värvikirevad. Soodne ilm ja suvine kuumus on tõstnud puuviljade suhkrusisaldust. Stocks Farm ootab oma 100 aakrilt ligi 2000 tonni saaki, mille 36 hooajatöölist korjavad kümne päeva jooksul, et seda suurematele supermarketitele tarnida.

article_content: Police announced Sunday that the remains of Amber DuBois, a 14-year-old girl from the San Diego, California area who had been missing for over a year, have been discovered. Human skeletal remains found early Saturday in Pala, a rugged rural area in northern San Diego County, California, have been positively identified as those of DuBois, Escondido, California, Police Chief Jim Maher said at a news conference. DuBois was last seen on February 13, 2009, walking to school alone. Her family resides in Escondido, a San Diego suburb. Maher did not answer questions at the brief news conference, stating that the investigation into DuBois' death remains ongoing. 'Any detail, no matter how slight, would be inappropriate at this time,' he stated. The Escondido Police Department, the San Diego County Sheriff's Department, and the FBI are jointly handling the investigation. Amber DuBois' parents, who police reported were notified Saturday about the discovery of their daughter's remains, were present at the press conference. 'We'd like to thank everyone involved in the search for Amber... and above all, our huge volunteer corps,' said her father, Moe DuBois. 'They are the most dedicated people you can ever imagine.' 'Without them we could not have accomplished anything,' he added. Last week, authorities stated they were investigating John Albert Gardner III, who pleaded not guilty Wednesday to the rape and murder of Chelsea King, another San Diego-area teen, to determine if he was connected to Amber DuBois' disappearance. 'We have been working closely with the San Diego Sheriff's Office, and our investigators are working with theirs in case there is a connection,' Lt. Robert Benton with the Escondido Police Department said last week. 'We are involved in the daily briefings on the King investigation.' Amber DuBois' father attended Gardner's arraignment on Wednesday. Maher did not mention any suspects during his brief news conference Sunday.
translated_content: Politsei teatas pühapäeval, et Amber DuBoisi, 14-aastase San Diego piirkonnast pärit tüdruku, kes oli kadunud üle aasta, säilmed on leitud. Inimese skeletijäänused, mis leiti laupäeva varahommikul Palas, mis on karm maapiirkond San Diego maakonna põhjaosas Californias, on tuvastatud Amber DuBoisi omadena, ütles Escondido politseiülem Jim Maher pressikonverentsil. DuBoisi nähti viimati 13. veebruaril 2009 üksi kooli minemas. Tema perekond elab Escondidos, San Diego eeslinnas. Maher ei vastanud lühikesel pressikonverentsil küsimustele, öeldes, et uurimine DuBoisi surma asjaolude väljaselgitamiseks on veel pooleli. 'Igasugune detail, ükskõik kui väike, oleks praegu kohatu,' sõnas ta. Escondido politseijaoskond, San Diego maakonna šerifi osakond ja FBI tegelevad ühiselt uurimisega. Amber DuBoisi vanemad, keda politsei oli laupäeval tütre säilmete leidmisest teavitanud, viibisid pressikonverentsil. article_content: In 'Life of a Chalk Stream' (Collins, £16.99), conservationist Simon Cooper invites readers to share his awe of England's chalkstreams. Where others rush, Cooper pauses, often immersed in the wetlands he studies. He views the natural world with an affectionate eye. Cooper revels in the simple act of fishing amid Britain's picturesque landscapes. Even pesky gnats, typically dismissed, are to him wonders of nature, admired for their intricate features. Overgrown riverbank clumps, avoided for their sharp edges, offer vital sanctuary to tiny creatures; a shake can reveal over sixty species. Primarily located in Southern England, chalkstreams are unique, sourced from deep underground reservoirs. As a leading expert, Cooper details the demanding work of preserving these ecosystems: cutting vegetation, clearing blockages, restoring plant life, improving oxygen levels, and more. Cooper finds endless inspiration in nature's offerings, from wildflowers to otters. Undeterred by hazards like wasps, swans, thorny plants, and nettles, he even recounts rescuing a bat – despite rabies concerns – by carefully removing a hook from its mouth. Navigating muddy terrain requires finesse. Rather than striding confidently, which leads to face-plants, Cooper recommends a cautious shuffle until solid ground is reached. Each step in the mud releases a potent mix of methane and decaying plant matter. The pungent aroma of the riverbank, along with the 'awful stench like rotting corpses' from hawthorn hedges, adds to the experience. Invasive species pose a significant threat to chalkstream ecosystems. Cooper battles the aggressive Himalayan Balsam, which eradicates native flora, by pulling it out by the roots. The American mink, an escapee from 1930s fur farms, decimates native mice, voles, and moorhens. Cooper finds wonder in every creature, large or small. Did you know eels make slurping sounds as they feed? He celebrates herons, otters, stickleback mating rituals, mayfly dances, salmon spawning, and the art of angling. Despite nature's occasional harshness and odors, Cooper's passion is contagious. By the end of the book, readers will be eager to explore chalkstreams, shake tussocks, admire hawthorn flies, and spot eels.

article_content: In Boston, a federal court witnessed James 'Whitey' Bulger, a notorious mob figure, showing rare emotion as he chuckled during his former drug dealer's testimony about past events. Simultaneously, the family of Michael Donahue, purportedly murdered by Bulger, reacted to a tearful apology from ex-FBI supervisor John Morris regarding his involvement in two deaths in 1982. John Morris, previously with the FBI, expressed remorse to Michael Donahue's family, a man Bulger is accused of killing. Morris admitted leaking sensitive details that reached Bulger, which, according to accounts, led to Donahue's death. He stated, 'I don't seek forgiveness, yet I want to sincerely apologize for my actions and inactions.' Michael Donahue's widow, Patricia, along with their three sons, attended the proceedings in Boston. Bulger faces charges for the deaths of 19 individuals during an alleged two-decade period of terror in South Boston. Morris confessed to sharing the identity of an informant with John Connolly, Bulger's handler and former FBI informant, who then revealed it to Bulger regarding the 1981 murder of an Oklahoma businessman. Bulger's past associate, John Martorano, previously testified that Bulger fired upon Donahue's vehicle while pursuing drug dealer Brian Halloran. The aim was to prevent Halloran from incriminating Bulger and his associates in the murder. Donahue, unconnected to the gang, was simply giving Halloran a ride home and was fatally shot in May 1982. Morris conveyed to Donahue's widow, 'Not a day goes by that I don't think about this, praying for blessings and solace for your pain.' He concluded with a trembling voice and tears, 'I am deeply sorry; I ask for no forgiveness, as it is too much to ask.' Tommy Donahue, Michael's son, and his mother met Morris's gaze. Tommy Donahue later stated that Morris's apology was insincere. During a break, Tommy Donahue exchanged words with Hank Brennan, Bulger's defense attorney, who had prompted Morris's apology by pointing out the 'families left behind' due to Morris's 'inappropriate actions.' Donahue described their situation as difficult, stating that while they want Bulger imprisoned, they must rely on Bulger's lawyers for the truth, as the government is not forthcoming. Patricia Donahue, speaking for the first time since the trial's start, dismissed Morris's apology as meaningless but believed Morris's guilt would be a lifelong punishment. After a recess, Bulger chuckled noticeably when Joseph Tower, a former drug dealing associate, recounted how Bulger, nicknamed 'Boots,' once saved Tower's brother's life. Tower, testifying under immunity, was brought in to discuss Bulger's extortion activities. Bulger also faces charges of extortion, racketeering, and money laundering. Tower stated that he entered an agreement with Bulger, acknowledging that Bulger received a share of the profits in exchange for 'protection.' Tower told the kidnappers of his brother that they were in 'serious trouble' because of his association with Bulger. Bulger secured Tower's brother's release after a failed money exchange. The two shared smiles during a sidebar. Tower's cross-examination is scheduled for Tuesday.

article_content: The 2012 US presidential race broke spending records, intensified divisions, and sparked numerous online discussions. Though appearing close initially, Ohio proved decisive. Here's what we learned: Obama confronts ongoing issues following his win. 1. Republicans struggle with Latino outreach. Ana Navarro notes potential long-term consequences if the GOP doesn't improve its appeal to Hispanic voters. Ari Fleischer suggests Republicans need a new approach. Exit polls highlight this, showing Latinos increasing their vote share and overwhelmingly supporting Obama, crucial in states like Colorado and Nevada. This trend also solidified New Mexico for Democrats. If this continues, Arizona and Texas might become competitive. The GOP needs to reconsider its stance on immigration. Marco Rubio emphasized the need for Republicans to connect with minority and immigrant communities. 2. Young voters showed up, while the white vote decreased. There was concern if young voters would participate. They did, increasing their share of the electorate. This compensated for Obama's slightly reduced support among youth. Additionally, the white vote's proportion decreased, offsetting Obama's loss of white voters. The African-American percentage remained constant. Some Republicans believed a larger white voter turnout was necessary for a Romney victory. 3. Auto industry support aided Obama in Ohio. Obama's campaign heavily promoted the auto bailouts, seen as crucial in Ohio. Obama emphasized the auto industry's resurgence. While initiated under Bush, Obama managed the program. Romney opposed the bailout, favoring private bankruptcy. Democrats criticized Romney's stance. Support for the bailouts was strong among Ohio voters, who largely voted for Obama. 4. Romney's outreach efforts didn't broaden his support base. Romney and Ryan's visits to Pennsylvania and ad spending aimed to sway voters. A similar effort occurred in Minnesota. Despite these efforts, Romney couldn't win these states. He only flipped Indiana and North Carolina back to red. 5. What did all the money achieve? The 2012 election maintained a divided government despite record spending. Was this spending worthwhile?

article_content: King Harald V of Norway has tested positive for COVID-19, exhibiting mild symptoms. The royal household released a brief statement announcing the diagnosis: 'His Majesty the King has been diagnosed with corona and is on sick leave until he is symptom-free. The king has cold symptoms and remains at home.' King Harald previously tested positive for COVID-19 in March 2022, also with mild symptoms. While officials noted he had received three COVID-19 vaccine doses, it remains unclear if he received any booster shots. Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre conveyed his best wishes for the King's swift recovery. Crown Prince Haakon, Harald's son and heir to the throne, will temporarily take over his duties. The King, who has been seen using crutches, has had multiple hospital stays in recent years. King Harald is Norway’s head of state, a largely ceremonial role without political authority. He ascended to the throne in 1991 after the death of his father, King Olav. The King's health hasn't always kept him from fulfilling his duties. In August 2022, he was hospitalized for three days with a fever, and in December of that year, he was readmitted for an infection treated with intravenous antibiotics. In October 2020, King Harald underwent heart valve surgery following hospitalization for breathing difficulties. Despite these health concerns, he has continued to attend significant public events in Norway and neighbouring Nordic countries. In September, he participated in celebrations in Stockholm marking the 50th anniversary of Sweden’s King Carl XVI Gustaf’s accession to the throne. In May, after being discharged from the hospital, the King appeared on the royal castle’s balcony in Oslo to greet children participating in Norway's Constitution Day festivities.

article_content: California police are requesting public assistance to locate Rico Omarr Harris, a 37-year-old former member of the Harlem Globetrotters. Harris has been missing for over a week, since he was driving to Seattle to visit his girlfriend. The last communication from Harris was on October 10, when he called his mother while traveling. He informed her that he was passing through Sacramento and intended to stop for breakfast and a nap. On October 13, Harris' black Nissan sedan was discovered abandoned in a remote park off State Route 16, approximately 60 miles northwest of Sacramento. Harris was not present at the location. Harris' mother, Margaret Fernandez, held a press conference on Monday to ask for the public's help in finding her son, as reported by KTLA. 'I miss my son,' Fernandez said during the press conference. 'I'm very, very sad.' According to the Yolo County Sheriff's Office, Harris began his 1,100-mile journey from Alhambra, California, to Seattle around 1 a.m. on October 10. Harris was reportedly moving to the northwest to be with his girlfriend, Jennifer Song, and to begin a new sales job, according to his family. Song described Harris as a 'very loving, charismatic, gentle giant' in a Skype interview. She added that they were looking forward to getting married and starting a family. Harris' relatives also mentioned that he suffers from bipolar disorder. Approximately nine hours into his drive on October 10, Harris contacted his mother from the Sacramento area. Shortly before 11 a.m., he left a voicemail for his girlfriend. There have been no communications from him since these calls. On October 13, a sheriff's deputy found Harris' vehicle parked at the Yolo County Regional Parks Lower Site near Cache Creek. Upon running the registration, authorities discovered the vehicle belonged to the missing Harris. A search of the surrounding area resulted in the discovery of Harris' cell phone and a backpack containing jumper cables. Deputies informed Harris' family that his car battery was dead. Harris, who is 6-foot-9 and weighs 280 pounds, has been described by loved ones as a 'gentle giant.' Harris' stepfather, Charles Taylor, told CBS Los Angeles, 'I feel that confident that we’re going to find him, that he’s going to come through, wherever he is. I have to believe that. I have that kind of faith that we’re going to find him.’ Anyone with information regarding Rico Omarr Harris' whereabouts is asked to contact 530-668-5280.

Harrise sugulased mainisid ka, et ta põeb bipolaarset häiret. Umbes üheksa tundi pärast sõidu algust 10. oktoobril võttis Harris Sacramento piirkonnast ühendust oma emaga. Veidi enne kella 11 hommikul jättis ta oma sõbrannale häälsõnumi. Asetäitjad teavitasid Harrise perekonda, et auto aku oli tühi. Harris, kes on 6 jalga 9 tolli pikk ja kaalub 280 naela, on lähedaste poolt kirjeldatud kui 'õrn hiiglane'. article_content: London (CNN) -- As Britain enjoys the feel-good summer heat, from Andy Murray's success to royal baby excitement, let's consider the newborn thrust into the global spotlight due to his lineage. No royal arrival has faced such scrutiny since 1688, when Mary of Modena, wife of James II, gave birth under watch, amid rumors of a Catholic conspiracy to fabricate a male heir. Even the officials' presence couldn't dispel rumors that a child was smuggled in via bedpan; James was soon deposed, and his son lived in exile in France and Rome. The newborn prince and his parents are unlikely to be exiled, though celebrating royalists don't represent a silent majority, more inclined to see the monarchy as a publicly-funded soap opera for American tourists. The article notes the birth inspires hope for some. His mother also avoided the home secretary's presence during delivery, a practice formally ended in 1948. And there have been worse times to be born into European royalty, like Paris in 1789 or St. Petersburg in 1917. Yet, the life of someone third in line for the British crown, possibly seeing the 22nd century on the throne if as long-lived as his great-grandparents, is hardly enviable. The Windsors regained respectability after the 1990s, culminating in Princess Diana's 1997 death, thanks to William and Kate's 2011 wedding and films like 'The Queen' and 'The King's Speech.' Questioning the monarchy still risks media backlash, as Hilary Mantel found after describing the Duchess of Cambridge as a 'plastic princess designed to breed.' This missed Mantel's point: royals, however privileged, are prisoners of their circumstances, bound by obligations to an archaic institution. Mantel stated, 'Our royal family faces different breeding challenges than pandas, but both are expensive to conserve and ill-suited to modern life. But aren't they interesting? Aren't they nice to look at?' Mantel's point applied to Kate Middleton, who married into the 'firm' willingly; the situation is worse for her child, public property from his hospital-steps debut. The media may feign responsibility, respecting boundaries, but constant intrusion remains, a life defined by camera phones. In an age obsessed with 'reality' and celebrity, the young royal will perform a 'gilded simulation' of normality, embracing British establishment conservatism, his personality shaped by public taste. It's 'The Truman Show' with footmen. Royals once lived lives of intrigue, conspiracy, and drama, their lives intertwined with nations' rise and fall. Kings' and queens' deeds inspired Shakespeare. But the British royal family has been largely decorative for centuries, and this heir may wait decades before assuming even diminished duties. Royal heirs traditionally pass time championing causes. Prince Charles promotes environmentalism and architecture, while Prince William supports tackling homelessness. Perhaps, with time, the prince could embrace republicanism. The opinions expressed in this commentary are solely those of Simon Hooper.

Isegi ametnike kohalolek ei suutnud hajutada kuulujutte, et laps smugeldati sisse ööpoti kaudu; James kukutati peagi troonilt ja tema poeg elas paguluses Prantsusmaal ja Roomas. Vastsündinud prints ja tema vanemad tõenäoliselt pagendusse ei saadeta, kuigi tähistavad rojalistid ei esinda vaikivat enamust, kes on pigem kalduv nägema monarhiat kui avalikult rahastatavat seebiooperit Ameerika turistidele. Ometi pole sellise inimese elu, kes on Briti trooni pärimisjärjekorras kolmas ja kes võib-olla näeb 22. sajandit troonil, kui ta on sama pikaealine kui ta vanavanavanemad, vaevalt kadestamisväärne. Windsorid taastasid oma maine pärast 1990. aastaid, kulmineerudes printsess Diana surmaga 1997. aastal, tänu Williami ja Kate'i 2011. aasta pulmadele ning filmidele nagu 'The Queen' ja 'The King's Speech.' Monarhia küsimuse alla seadmine riskib endiselt meedia pahameelega, nagu leidis Hilary Mantel, kui ta kirjeldas Cambridge'i hertsoginnat kui 'plastprintsessi, kes on mõeldud paljunemiseks'. See jättis tähelepanuta Manteli mõtte: kuninglikud, olgu nad kui tahes privilegeeritud, on oma olukorra vangid, keda seovad kohustused arhailise institutsiooni ees. Mantel ütles: 'Meie praegusel kuninglikul perel on teistsugused paljunemisprobleemid kui pandadel, kuid mõlemaid on kallis säilitada ja nad ei sobi hästi tänapäeva ellu. Aga kas nad pole huvitavad? Kas neid pole tore vaadata?' Manteli mõte kehtis Kate Middletoni kohta, kes abiellus 'firmasse' omal vabal tahtel; olukord on hullem tema lapse jaoks, kes on avalik vara alates tema esimesest ilmumisest haigla trepil. Meedia võib teeselda vastutust, austades piire, kuid pidev pealetükkivus jääb, elu, mida määratlevad kaameratelefonid. Ajastul, mis on kinnisideeks 'reaalsusest' ja kuulsusest, esitab noor kuninglik 'kullatud simulatsiooni' normaalsusest, võttes omaks Briti konservatiivseEstablishment'i, tema isiksus on kujundatud avaliku maitse järgi. See on 'The Truman Show' koos lakeidega. Kuninglikud elasid kunagi intriigide, vandenõude ja draama elus, nende elu oli põimunud rahvaste tõusu ja langusega. Kuningate ja kuningannade teod inspireerisid Shakespeare'i. Kuid Briti kuninglik perekond on sajandeid olnud suuresti dekoratiivne ja see pärija peab võib-olla aastakümneid ootama, enne kui ta saab täita ka vähenenud kohuseid. Kuninglikud pärijad veedavad traditsiooniliselt aega heategevuslike eesmärkide toetamisel. article_content: After shedding 5st 6lb, a mother has overcome agoraphobia and celebrated her renewed confidence by posing for photos in her underwear. Diane Bryan, 49, from Sheffield, decided to showcase her size 12 figure in a revealing photoshoot for her husband, Stan, something she wouldn't have considered when she was a size 20. Ashamed of her figure at the time, she developed a fear of leaving the house. Diane said: 'I used to be so embarrassed by my weight that I wouldn't even let Stan see me undressing at night – I'd make him turn off the lights. But now, I couldn't be happier with my figure.' The mother-of-two gained weight after moving from her hometown of Southampton to Sheffield due to her husband's job with the Royal Navy. 'When we moved away from my family, I lost my support network, and Stan was often away for work. As a result, I started indulging in unhealthy habits and relying on frequent takeaways,' she explained. Her weight increased to a size 20, exacerbating her difficulties in settling into the new area as she became too self-conscious to socialize. She admitted that her feelings of shame about her appearance made her reluctant to leave the house, finding interactions with strangers painful. She dropped to a size 12 after following an extreme diet plan but now eats healthily to maintain her shape. Diane admitted that she struggled to make friends when they moved, so she stayed in and ate ice cream and crisps. She added: 'I used to order takeaways so often that my local pizza place recognized my order before I even placed it.' Her weight began to affect her relationship with Stan and her overall health. She experienced shortness of breath while climbing stairs and performing everyday tasks. Her doctor recommended the Cambridge Weight Plan – a very restrictive diet consisting of liquid food for the first 12 weeks – which motivated her to lose weight. Through the diet, she lost three stone in 16 weeks, decreasing from 15st 11lbs to 10st 5lbs. As she lost weight, her agoraphobia also diminished. Diane is now able to go out alone and lead an active life, having replaced junk food with a healthy diet of vegetables and lean meat. She even felt confident enough to create a calendar of underwear photos for her husband. Diane said: 'Losing the extra weight has given me the biggest confidence boost of my life. It has helped me overcome the extreme agoraphobia I had, and I can now live a normal life.' 'I feel absolutely incredible – who knew you could feel this good at 49!'

Aga nüüd ma ei saaks oma figuuriga rohkem rahul olla.' Kahe lapse ema võttis kaalus juurde pärast kodulinnast Southamptonist Sheffieldi kolimist abikaasa töö tõttu kuninglikus mereväes. 'Kui me oma perest ära kolisime, kaotasin oma tugivõrgustiku ja Stan oli tihti tööl ära. Selle tulemusena hakkasin ma ebatervislikult toituma ja tellisin tihti valmistoitu,' selgitas ta. Diane tunnistas, et tal oli kolides raske sõpru leida, nii et ta jäi koju ja sõi jäätist ja kartulikrõpse. Ta lisas: 'Ma tellisin nii tihti valmistoitu, et kohalik pitsakoht teadis mu tellimust juba enne, kui ma seda esitada jõudsin.' Tema kaal hakkas mõjutama tema suhet Staniga ja tema üldist tervist. Diane on nüüd võimeline üksi välja minema ja aktiivset elu elama, olles asendanud rämpstoidu tervisliku köögiviljade ja lahja lihaga. Ta tundis end isegi piisavalt enesekindlalt, et teha oma abikaasale kalender aluspesufotodega. Diane ütles: 'Kaalu kaotamine on andnud mulle mu elu suurima enesekindluse. See on aidanud mul ületada äärmusliku agorafoobia ja ma saan nüüd elada normaalset elu.' 'Ma tunnen end täiesti suurepäraselt – kes teadis, et 49-aastaselt võib end nii hästi tunda!'

article_content: LONDON – At a meeting in Manila on Tuesday, health ministers in the Western Pacific nominated Dr. Saia Ma'u Piukala, a surgeon from Tonga, to lead the World Health Organization's regional office. Piukala's nomination for WHO's top position in the Western Pacific follows the dismissal of the previous director, Dr. Takeshi Kasai, months earlier. Kasai was fired after The Associated Press reported allegations of racism and misconduct last year. WHO stated that Piukala possesses nearly three decades of experience in public health in Tonga and the broader region, focusing on areas such as chronic diseases, climate change, and disaster response. Most recently, Piukala served as Tonga's minister of health. He won against rival candidates from China, the Philippines, the Solomon Islands, and Vietnam. Last January, the AP reported that numerous WHO staffers in the Western Pacific region claimed that Kasai made racist comments to his staff. Kasai allegedly blamed the increase of COVID-19 in some Pacific countries on their 'lack of capacity due to their inferior culture, race, and socioeconomic level.' Kasai denied ever using racist language. Following the AP report, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced an internal investigation into Kasai. In March, WHO announced Kasai's termination after the inquiry revealed 'findings of misconduct.' This marked the first time a regional director had been dismissed in WHO's history. Piukala expressed gratitude for the nomination and credited his experience in Pacific Island countries and his 'fellow villagers' for his success. “I thank you sincerely for the trust you have placed in me today,” Piukala stated. Piukala will be formally appointed for a five-year term at WHO's Executive Board meeting in January. WHO regional directors have considerable influence in public health, and their decisions can aid in containing emerging outbreaks of potentially dangerous new viruses like the coronavirus and bird flu. In January, the AP reported that a senior WHO Fijian doctor, Temo Waqanivalu, with a history of sexual assault allegations, had also planned to stand for election as the Western Pacific's director, with support from his government and some WHO staff. WHO announced Waqanivalu's dismissal months after that report. In recent years, WHO has faced multiple accusations of misconduct across various offices, including its director in Syria and senior managers who were informed of sexual exploitation in Congo during an Ebola outbreak but took insufficient action. ___ The Associated Press health and science department is supported by the Howard Hughes Medical Institute’s Science and Educational Media Group. The AP is solely responsible for all content.

article_content: A chilling figure: 191,369 individuals, including men, women, and children, were reported killed in Syria between March 2011 and the end of April 2014. This figure, derived from a new analysis conducted for the United Nations, represents a significant increase from the last update provided by the organization. However, it likely remains an underestimation of the actual number of fatalities. The situation prompted U.N. High Commissioner for Human Rights Navi Pillay to criticize the U.N. Security Council's inaction, which she stated has allowed the continued slaughter. 'The killers, destroyers, and torturers in Syria have been empowered and emboldened by international paralysis,' she stated on Friday. 'There are serious allegations of repeated war crimes and crimes against humanity committed with total impunity. Yet, the Security Council has failed to refer the case of Syria to the International Criminal Court, where it clearly belongs,' she added. Pillay noted that the total documented killings more than doubled compared to a year prior. She stated, 'Tragically, this is likely an underestimate of the actual number of people killed during the first three years of this devastating conflict.' She added, 'I deeply regret that, with the emergence of numerous other armed conflicts during this period of global instability, the fighting in Syria and its terrible impact on millions of civilians has faded from international attention.' The new U.N. figure is based on analysis of 318,910 reported killings, requiring documentation of the victim's name, date, and location of death. Five different data sources were used to verify details and eliminate redundancies. The Damascus countryside recorded the highest number of documented killings, with nearly 40,000, followed by Aleppo with nearly 32,000, and Homs with just over 28,000. Approximately 85% of those killed were male, and 9.3% were female. The United Nations stated that the analysis could not differentiate between combatants and noncombatants. At least 8,803 children are documented as having been killed, with over a quarter being under 10 years old. However, the statement said that the actual total is probably higher because the victims' ages were not recorded in over 80% of cases. Pillay urged governments to take 'serious measures to halt the fighting and deter the crimes, and above all, stop fueling this monumental and entirely avoidable human catastrophe through the provision of arms and other military supplies.' Russia, a long-standing ally of Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, has consistently blocked U.N. sanction resolutions regarding Syria. Both the Syrian government and the rebels they are fighting have been accused of serious human rights abuses.
translated_content: Õõvastav number: Süürias teatati ajavahemikul märtsist 2011 kuni aprilli 2014 lõpuni tapetud 191 369 inimesest, sealhulgas meestest, naistest ja lastest. See arv, mis on saadud ÜRO jaoks läbiviidud uuest analüüsist, kujutab endast märkimisväärset kasvu võrreldes organisatsiooni viimase uuendusega. Kuid see on tõenäoliselt siiski tegeliku hukkunute arvu alahinnang. Olukord ajendas ÜRO inimõiguste ülemvolinikku Navi Pillay'd kritiseerima ÜRO Julgeolekunõukogu tegevusetust, mis tema sõnul on võimaldanud jätkuvat tapmist. 'Süüria tapjad, hävitajad ja piinajad on rahvusvahelise halvatuse tõttu saanud võimu juurde ja muutunud julgemaks,' teatas ta reedel. 'On tõsiseid väiteid korduvate sõjakuritegude ja inimsusevastaste kuritegude kohta, mis on toime pandud täieliku karistamatusega. Ometi ei ole Julgeolekunõukogu suunanud Süüria juhtumit Rahvusvahelisse Kriminaalkohtusse, kuhu see selgelt kuulub,' lisas ta. Pillay märkis, et dokumenteeritud tapmiste koguarv on rohkem kui kahekordistunud võrreldes eelmise aastaga. Ta teatas: 'Traagiliselt on see tõenäoliselt alahinnang tegelikule hukkunute arvule selle laastava konflikti esimese kolme aasta jooksul.' Ta lisas: 'Mul on sügavalt kahju, et seoses paljude muude relvakonfliktide tekkimisega selle ülemaailmse ebastabiilsuse perioodil on võitlus Süürias ja selle kohutav mõju miljonitele tsiviilisikutele rahvusvahelisest tähelepanust kadunud.' Uus ÜRO arv põhineb 318 910 teatatud tapmise analüüsil, mis nõuab ohvri nime, kuupäeva ja surma koha dokumenteerimist. Üksikasjade kontrollimiseks ja korduste kõrvaldamiseks kasutati viit erinevat andmeallikat. Damaskuse maapiirkonnas registreeriti kõige rohkem dokumenteeritud tapmisi, ligi 40 000, millele järgnes Aleppo ligi 32 000-ga ja Homs veidi üle 28 000-ga. Ligikaudu 85% tapetutest olid mehed ja 9,3% naised. ÜRO teatas, et analüüs ei suutnud eristada võitlejaid ja tsiviilisikuid. Vähemalt 8803 last on dokumenteeritud tapetutena, kusjuures üle veerandi olid alla 10-aastased. Kuid avalduses öeldi, et tegelik koguarv on tõenäoliselt suurem, kuna ohvrite vanust ei registreeritud üle 80% juhtudest. Pillay kutsus valitsusi üles võtma 'tõsiseid meetmeid võitluse peatamiseks ja kuritegude ärahoidmiseks ning ennekõike lõpetama selle monumentaalse ja täielikult välditava inimkatastroofi õhutamist relvade ja muu sõjalise varustuse tarnimise kaudu.' Venemaa, Süüria presidendi Bashar al-Assadi kauaaegne liitlane, on järjekindlalt blokeerinud Süüriat käsitlevaid ÜRO sanktsioonide resolutsioone.
